<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js"></script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {


    const filterForm =
            document.getElementById("dashboardFilterForm");

    const startInput =
            document.getElementById("startDate");

    const endInput =
            document.getElementById("endDate");

    const errorBox =
            document.getElementById("dashboardDateError");

    const errorText =
            document.getElementById("dashboardDateErrorText");

    function clearError() {
        errorBox.style.display = "none";
        errorText.textContent = "";
    }

    if (filterForm && startInput && endInput) {

        startInput.addEventListener("change", clearError);
        endInput.addEventListener("change", clearError);

        filterForm.addEventListener(
            "submit",
            function (event) {

                const start = startInput.value;
                const end = endInput.value;

                let message = "";

                if (!start || !end) {

                    message =
                        "Vui lòng chọn đầy đủ ngày bắt đầu "
                        + "và ngày kết thúc.";

                } else if (start > end) {

                    message =
                        "Ngày bắt đầu không được lớn hơn "
                        + "ngày kết thúc.";
                }

                if (message) {

                    event.preventDefault();

                    errorText.textContent = message;
                    errorBox.style.display = "flex";

                } else {

                    clearError();
                }
            }
        );
    }

    function formatVND(value) {

        return new Intl.NumberFormat("vi-VN", {
            style: "currency",
            currency: "VND",
            maximumFractionDigits: 0
        }).format(value);
    }


    const revenueData = [

        <c:forEach
            var="row"
            items="${revenueByDate}"
            varStatus="loop">

            {
                date: "${row[0]}",
                revenue: ${row[1]}
            }<c:if test="${not loop.last}">,</c:if>

        </c:forEach>

    ];

    const revenueCanvas =
            document.getElementById("revenueChart");

    if (
        typeof Chart !== "undefined"
        && revenueCanvas
        && revenueData.length > 0
    ) {

        const ctx = revenueCanvas.getContext("2d");

        const gradient =
                ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, 325);

        gradient.addColorStop(
            0,
            "rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.22)"
        );

        gradient.addColorStop(
            1,
            "rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.01)"
        );

        const labels = revenueData.map(
            item => item.date
        );

        const values = revenueData.map(
            item => Number(item.revenue)
        );

        new Chart(revenueCanvas, {

            type: "line",

            data: {

                labels: labels,

                datasets: [{

                    label: "Giá trị đơn hoàn thành",

                    data: values,

                    borderColor: "#2563eb",

                    backgroundColor: gradient,

                    borderWidth: 3,

                    tension: 0.35,

                    fill: true,

                    pointRadius: 3,

                    pointHoverRadius: 6,

                    pointBackgroundColor: "#ffffff",

                    pointBorderColor: "#2563eb",

                    pointBorderWidth: 2

                }]
            },

            options: {

                responsive: true,

                maintainAspectRatio: false,

                interaction: {
                    mode: "index",
                    intersect: false
                },

                plugins: {

                    legend: {
                        display: false
                    },

                    tooltip: {

                        callbacks: {

                            label: function (context) {

                                return "Giá trị: "
                                    + formatVND(context.parsed.y);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                },

                scales: {

                    x: {

                        grid: {
                            display: false
                        },

                        ticks: {
                            color: "#64748b",
                            maxTicksLimit: 9
                        }
                    },

                    y: {

                        beginAtZero: true,

                        ticks: {

                            color: "#64748b",

                            callback: function (value) {

                                return new Intl.NumberFormat(
                                    "vi-VN",
                                    {
                                        notation: "compact",
                                        maximumFractionDigits: 1
                                    }
                                ).format(value) + " ₫";
                            }
                        },

                        grid: {
                            color: "#f1f5f9"
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    const orderStatusData = [

        <c:forEach
            var="row"
            items="${orderStatusStatistics}"
            varStatus="loop">

            {
                status: "${row[0]}",
                total: ${row[1]}
            }<c:if test="${not loop.last}">,</c:if>

        </c:forEach>

    ];

    const statusNames = {

        "PENDING_CONFIRMATION": "Chờ xác nhận",

        "PENDING": "Chờ xác nhận",

        "CONFIRMED": "Đã xác nhận",

        "PACKING": "Đang đóng gói",

        "SHIPPING": "Đang giao hàng",

        "COMPLETED": "Hoàn thành",

        "CANCELLED": "Đã hủy"
    };

    const statusColors = {

        "PENDING_CONFIRMATION": "#f59e0b",

        "PENDING": "#f59e0b",

        "CONFIRMED": "#3b82f6",

        "PACKING": "#8b5cf6",

        "SHIPPING": "#06b6d4",

        "COMPLETED": "#22c55e",

        "CANCELLED": "#ef4444"
    };

    const statusCanvas =
            document.getElementById("orderStatusChart");

    if (
        typeof Chart !== "undefined"
        && statusCanvas
        && orderStatusData.length > 0
    ) {

        const statusLabels = orderStatusData.map(
            item => statusNames[item.status] || item.status
        );

        const statusValues = orderStatusData.map(
            item => Number(item.total)
        );

        const colors = orderStatusData.map(
            item => statusColors[item.status] || "#94a3b8"
        );

        const totalOrdersInChart =
            statusValues.reduce(
                (sum, value) => sum + value,
                0
            );


        const centerTotalPlugin = {

            id: "dashboardCenterTotal",

            afterDraw: function (chart) {

                const meta = chart.getDatasetMeta(0);

                if (
                    !meta.data
                    || meta.data.length === 0
                ) {
                    return;
                }

                const ctx = chart.ctx;

                const centerX = meta.data[0].x;
                const centerY = meta.data[0].y;

                ctx.save();

                ctx.textAlign = "center";
                ctx.textBaseline = "middle";

                ctx.fillStyle = "#0f172a";
                ctx.font = "700 29px Inter, sans-serif";

                ctx.fillText(
                    totalOrdersInChart,
                    centerX,
                    centerY - 10
                );

                ctx.fillStyle = "#64748b";
                ctx.font = "12px Inter, sans-serif";

                ctx.fillText(
                    "Tổng đơn",
                    centerX,
                    centerY + 18
                );

                ctx.restore();
            }
        };


        new Chart(statusCanvas, {

            type: "doughnut",

            plugins: [centerTotalPlugin],

            data: {

                labels: statusLabels,

                datasets: [{

                    data: statusValues,

                    backgroundColor: colors,

                    borderColor: "#ffffff",

                    borderWidth: 3,

                    hoverOffset: 8

                }]
            },

            options: {

                responsive: true,

                maintainAspectRatio: false,

                cutout: "68%",

                plugins: {

                    legend: {

                        position: "bottom",

                        labels: {

                            usePointStyle: true,

                            boxWidth: 10,

                            padding: 12,

                            font: {
                                size: 11
                            }
                        }
                    },

                    tooltip: {

                        callbacks: {

                            label: function (context) {

                                const count = context.parsed;

                                const percent =
                                    totalOrdersInChart > 0
                                        ? (
                                            count
                                            / totalOrdersInChart
                                            * 100
                                        ).toFixed(1)
                                        : "0.0";

                                return " "
                                    + context.label
                                    + ": "
                                    + count
                                    + " đơn ("
                                    + percent
                                    + "%)";
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }

});
</script>

                            <p>

                                <button type="button" class="modal-btn modal-btn-secondary"
                                        onclick="closeCancelModal()">
                                    Không, quay lại
                                </button>

                                <button type="button" class="modal-btn modal-btn-danger" onclick="confirmCancelOrder()">
                                    Xác nhận hủy

                    <script>
                        document.querySelectorAll(".notification").forEach(function (message) {
                            setTimeout(function () {
                                message.classList.add("notification-hide");

                                setTimeout(function () {
                                    message.remove();
                                }, 300);
                            }, 3500);
                        });


                        let cancelForm = null;

                        function showCancelModal(event) {
                            event.preventDefault();

                            cancelForm = event.currentTarget;

                            document.getElementById("cancelModal").classList.add("show");

                            return false;
                        }

                        function closeCancelModal() {
                            document.getElementById("cancelModal").classList.remove("show");

                            const button = document.querySelector(".modal-btn-danger");
                            button.disabled = false;
                            button.textContent = "Xác nhận hủy";

                            cancelForm = null;
                        }

                        function confirmCancelOrder() {
                            if (cancelForm) {
                                const form = cancelForm;
                                cancelForm = null;

                                const button = document.querySelector(".modal-btn-danger");
                                button.disabled = true;
                                button.textContent = "Đang xử lý...";

                                form.submit();
                            }
                        }

                        document.getElementById("cancelModal").addEventListener("click", function (event) {
                            if (event.target === this) {
                                closeCancelModal();
                            }
                        });

                        document.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
                            if (event.key === "Escape") {
                                closeCancelModal();
                            }
                        });

                    </script>


                    </body>

                    </html>

                                <c:when test="${row[0] eq 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION'}">

                                    <c:set var="statusColor"
                                           value="#f59e0b" />

                                           value="Chờ xác nhận" />

                                </c:when>

                                    <c:set var="statusColor"
                                           value="#2563eb" />

                                    <c:set var="statusName"
                                           value="Đã xác nhận" />

                                </c:when>

                                <c:when test="${row[0] eq 'PACKING'}">

                                    <c:set var="statusColor"
                                           value="#8b5cf6" />

                                    <c:set var="statusName"
                                           value="Đang đóng gói" />

                                </c:when>

                                <c:when test="${row[0] eq 'SHIPPING'}">

                                    <c:set var="statusColor"
                                           value="#06b6d4" />

                                    <c:set var="statusName"
                                           value="Đang giao hàng" />

                                </c:when>

                            </c:choose>

                            <div class="rp-status-item"
                                 data-status-count="${row[1]}">

                                              style="--dot-color:${statusColor};">
                                        </span>

                                        <c:out value="${statusName}" />

                                              data-number="${row[1]}">
                                            ${row[1]}
                                        </span>

                                            0%
                                        </span>

                                    </span>

                                </div>

                                <div class="rp-progress">

                                    </div>

                    <c:otherwise>

                        <div class="rp-empty">

                            trong khoảng thời gian này.

        <!-- TOP 5 PRODUCTS -->

        <section class="rp-card rp-panel">

                            Xếp hạng theo tổng số lượng đã bán
                        </p>

                </div>

            </div>

            <div class="rp-analytics-body"
                 id="reportTopProducts">

                <c:choose>

                    <c:when test="${not empty topSellingProducts}">

                        <c:forEach
                            var="row"

                            varStatus="loop">

                                     ${loop.index == 0 ? 'rp-rank-first' : ''}

                                            đã bán

<script>
    (function () {

        function initReportPage() {

            const reportPage =
                    document.querySelector(".oecs-report");

            if (!reportPage || reportPage.dataset.initialized === "true") {
                return;
            }

            reportPage.dataset.initialized = "true";

            const filterForm =
                    document.getElementById("reportFilterForm");

            const startInput =
                    document.getElementById("startDate");

            const endInput =
                    document.getElementById("endDate");

            const exportButton =
                    document.getElementById("exportButton");

            const exportMenu =
                    document.getElementById("exportMenu");

            const hasServerFilterError =
    ${not empty filterError};

            // =====================================
            // 1. INITIALIZE DATE PICKERS
            // =====================================

            if (typeof flatpickr === "function") {

                const datePickerOptions = {

                    // Value sent to Java Servlet
                    dateFormat: "Y-m-d",

                    // Show date as DD/MM/YYYY
                    altInput: true,
                    altInputClass: "rp-date-input",
                    altFormat: "d/m/Y",

                    allowInput: false,
                    clickOpens: true,
                    disableMobile: true,

                    locale: flatpickr.l10ns.vn || "default",

                    // Calendar outside cards to avoid clipping
                    appendTo: document.body,

                    onReady: function (
                            selectedDates,
                            dateStr,
                            instance) {

                        if (instance.altInput) {

                            instance.altInput.style.cursor = "pointer";

                            instance.altInput.addEventListener(
                                    "click",
                                    function () {
                                        instance.open();
                                    }
                            );

                        }
                    }
                };

                // Initialize once per input.
                // On every new GET request, JSP renders new inputs.
                if (!startInput._flatpickr) {
                    flatpickr(startInput, datePickerOptions);
                }

                if (!endInput._flatpickr) {
                    flatpickr(endInput, datePickerOptions);
                }

            } else {
                console.warn(
                        "Flatpickr could not be loaded. Date picker unavailable."
                        );
            }

            // =====================================
            // 2. ORIGINAL FILTERED DATES
            // =====================================

            // Original inputs retain Y-m-d values.
            const loadedStart = startInput.value;
            const loadedEnd = endInput.value;

            // =====================================
            // 3. FORMAT MONEY AND NUMBERS
            // =====================================

            const numberFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat(
                    "vi-VN",
                    {
                        maximumFractionDigits: 0
                    }
            );

            reportPage.querySelectorAll(".js-money")
                    .forEach(function (element) {

                        const value =
                                Number(element.dataset.money);

                        if (Number.isFinite(value)) {

                            element.textContent =
                                    numberFormatter.format(value);

                        }
                    });

            reportPage.querySelectorAll(".js-number")
                    .forEach(function (element) {

                        const value =
                                Number(element.dataset.number);

                        if (Number.isFinite(value)) {

                            element.textContent =
                                    numberFormatter.format(value);

                        }
                    });

            // =====================================
            // 4. FORMAT DISPLAYED DATES
            // =====================================

            function formatDisplayDate(isoDate) {

                if (!isoDate) {
                    return "";
                }

                const value = isoDate.trim().substring(0, 10);

                const parts = value.split("-");

                if (parts.length !== 3) {
                    return isoDate;
                }

                return parts[2] + "/"
                        + parts[1] + "/"
                        + parts[0];
            }

            reportPage.querySelectorAll(".js-display-date")
                    .forEach(function (element) {

                        element.textContent =
                                formatDisplayDate(element.textContent);

                    });

            // =====================================
            // 5. VALIDATE DATE RANGE
            // =====================================


            function validateDateRange() {

                const startDate = startInput.value;
                const endDate = endInput.value;

                const errorBox =
                        document.getElementById("dateRangeError");

                const errorText =
                        document.getElementById("dateRangeErrorText");

                if (!startDate || !endDate) {
                    errorText.textContent =
                            "Vui lòng chọn đầy đủ ngày bắt đầu và ngày kết thúc.";

                    errorBox.style.display = "flex";
                    return false;
                }

                if (startDate > endDate) {
                    errorText.textContent =
                            "Ngày bắt đầu không được lớn hơn ngày kết thúc. Vui lòng chọn lại.";

                    errorBox.style.display = "flex";
                    return false;
                }

                errorBox.style.display = "none";
                return true;
            }


            function clearDateError() {
                document.getElementById("dateRangeError")
                        .style.display = "none";
            }

            [startInput, endInput].forEach(function (input) {
                input.addEventListener("change", clearDateError);
            });



            // =====================================
            // 6. SUBMIT FILTER
            // =====================================

            filterForm.addEventListener(
                    "submit",
                    function (event) {

                        if (!validateDateRange()) {
                            event.preventDefault();
                        }

                    }
            );

            // =====================================
            // 7. EXPORT MENU
            // =====================================

            function closeExportMenu() {

                exportMenu.classList.remove("show");

                exportButton.setAttribute(
                        "aria-expanded",
                        "false"
                        );
            }

            exportButton.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    function (event) {

                        event.stopPropagation();

                        if (!validateDateRange()) {
                            closeExportMenu();
                            return;
                        }

                        // Prevent exporting an old filtered range
                        if (
                                hasServerFilterError ||
                                startInput.value !== loadedStart ||
                                endInput.value !== loadedEnd
                                ) {

                            closeExportMenu();

                            alert(
                                    "Vui lòng nhấn Lọc báo cáo trước khi xuất file."
                                    );

                            return;
                        }

                        const isOpen =
                                exportMenu.classList.toggle("show");

                        exportButton.setAttribute(
                                "aria-expanded",
                                String(isOpen)
                                );

                    }
            );

            exportMenu.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    function (event) {
                        event.stopPropagation();
                    }
            );

            document.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    closeExportMenu
                    );

            document.addEventListener(
                    "keydown",
                    function (event) {

                        if (event.key === "Escape") {
                            closeExportMenu();
                        }

                    }
            );

            // =====================================
            // 8. ORDER STATUS PROGRESS
            // =====================================

            const statusItems = Array.from(
                    reportPage.querySelectorAll(".rp-status-item")
                    );

            let totalOrders = 0;

            statusItems.forEach(function (item) {

                const count =
                        Number(item.dataset.statusCount) || 0;

                totalOrders += count;

            });

            statusItems.forEach(function (item) {

                const count =
                        Number(item.dataset.statusCount) || 0;

                const percent = totalOrders > 0
                        ? (count / totalOrders) * 100
                        : 0;

                const progress =
                        item.querySelector(".rp-progress-fill");

                const label =
                        item.querySelector(".rp-percent");

                if (progress) {
                    progress.style.width = percent + "%";
                }

                if (label) {
                    label.textContent =
                            percent.toFixed(1) + "%";
                }

            });

            // =====================================
            // 9. TOP PRODUCTS BARS
            // =====================================

            const productItems = Array.from(
                    reportPage.querySelectorAll(".rp-product-item")
                    );

            let maxSold = 0;

            productItems.forEach(function (item) {

                const sold =
                        Number(item.dataset.productSold) || 0;

                if (sold > maxSold) {
                    maxSold = sold;
                }

            });

            productItems.forEach(function (item) {

                const sold =
                        Number(item.dataset.productSold) || 0;

                const percent = maxSold > 0
                        ? (sold / maxSold) * 100
                        : 0;

                const bar =
                        item.querySelector(".rp-product-fill");

                if (bar) {
                    bar.style.width = percent + "%";
                }

            });

        }

        // Works whether the script loads before or after
        // DOMContentLoaded.
        if (document.readyState === "loading") {

            document.addEventListener(
                    "DOMContentLoaded",
                    initReportPage
                    );

        } else {

            initReportPage();

        }

    })();
</script>

<script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        const form = document.querySelector(
                'form[action$="/staff/banner"]'
                );

        const altText = document.getElementById("altText");
        const targetUrl = document.getElementById("targetUrl");
        const displayOrder = document.getElementById("displayOrder");

        const altTextPattern =
                /^[\p{L}\p{M}\p{N}\s.,!?()'’:;-]*$/u;

        function validateAltText() {
            const value = altText.value.trim();

            const valid = value.length <= 255
                    && altTextPattern.test(value);

            altText.setCustomValidity(
                    valid ? "" : "Mô tả chứa ký tự không được phép."
                    );

            altText.classList.toggle("is-invalid", !valid);

            return valid;
        }

        function validateTargetUrl() {
            const value = targetUrl.value.trim();

            if (value === "") {
                targetUrl.setCustomValidity("");
                targetUrl.classList.remove("is-invalid");
                return true;
            }

            let valid = false;

            if (!value.startsWith("//")
                    && !value.includes("\\")
                    && !/[\s\u0000-\u001F\u007F]/.test(value)
                    && !/%(?:0[0-9a-f]|1[0-9a-f]|7f)/i.test(value)) {

                if (value.startsWith("/")) {
                    try {
                        const parsed = new URL(
                                value,
                                window.location.origin
                                );

                        valid = parsed.origin === window.location.origin;
                    } catch (e) {
                        valid = false;
                    }
                } else {
                    try {
                        const parsed = new URL(value);

                        valid = parsed.protocol === "https:"
                                && parsed.hostname !== ""
                                && parsed.username === ""
                                && parsed.password === "";
                    } catch (e) {
                        valid = false;
                    }
                }
            }

            targetUrl.setCustomValidity(
                    valid ? "" : "Liên kết không hợp lệ."
                    );

            targetUrl.classList.toggle("is-invalid", !valid);

            return valid;
        }

        function validateDisplayOrder() {
            const value = displayOrder.value.trim();
            const number = Number(value);

            const valid = value !== ""
                    && Number.isSafeInteger(number)
                    && number >= 0
                    && number <= 2147483647;

            displayOrder.setCustomValidity(
                    valid ? "" : "Thứ tự phải là số nguyên không âm."
                    );

            displayOrder.classList.toggle("is-invalid", !valid);

            return valid;
        }

        altText.addEventListener("input", validateAltText);
        targetUrl.addEventListener("input", validateTargetUrl);
        displayOrder.addEventListener("input", validateDisplayOrder);

        form.addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
            const valid =
                    validateAltText()
                    && validateTargetUrl()
                    && validateDisplayOrder();

            if (!valid) {
                event.preventDefault();
                form.reportValidity();
            }
        });
    });
</script>

            <div class="table-responsive">

                <table class="table cart-table">


                    <thead>

                        <tr>

                                <input
                                    type="checkbox"
                                    id="selectAll"
                                    class="
                                        form-check-input
                                        cart-check
                                    ">

                            </th>


                            <th>
                                #
                            </th>


                            <th>
                                Sản phẩm
                            </th>


                            <th>
                                SKU
                            </th>


                            <th>
                                Giá
                            </th>


                            <th>
                                Số lượng
                            </th>


                            <th>
                                Tồn kho
                            </th>


                            <th>
                                Thành tiền
                            </th>


                            <th class="text-center">
                                Thao tác
                            </th>

                        </tr>

                    </thead>


                    <tbody>


                        <c:forEach
                            var="item"
                            items="${cartItems}"
                            varStatus="status">


                            <tr>

                                <td>

                                    <input
                                        type="checkbox"
                                        class="
                                            form-check-input
                                            cart-check
                                            cart-checkbox
                                        "
                                        name="selectedItems"
                                        value="${item.cartItemId}"
                                        data-subtotal="${item.subtotal}"
                                        ${selectedItemIds.contains(item.cartItemId) ? 'checked' : ''}
                                        ${item.stockQuantity <= 0 ? 'disabled' : ''}>

                                </td>

                                <td>

                                    <span
                                        class="
                                            badge
                                            bg-light
                                            text-secondary
                                            border
                                        ">

                                        #${status.index + 1}

                                    </span>

                                </td>


                                <td>

                                    <div class="product-name">

                                        ${item.productName}

                                    </div>

                                </td>


                                <td>

                                    <span class="sku-text">

                                        ${item.skuCode}

                                    </span>

                                </td>


                                <td>

                                    <fmt:formatNumber
                                        value="${item.price}"
                                        type="number"
                                        groupingUsed="true"
                                        maxFractionDigits="0"/>

                                    đ

                                </td>


                               
                                <td>


                                    <c:choose>


                                        <c:when test="${item.stockQuantity > 0}">

                                            <form
                                                action="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/cart"
                                                method="post"
                                                class="
                                                    quantity-wrapper
                                                    quantity-form
                                                ">


                                                <input
                                                    type="hidden"
                                                    name="action"
                                                    value="update">


                                                <input

                                                    name="cartItemId"
                                                    value="${item.cartItemId}">


                                                <input

                                                    name="quantity"

                                                    min="1"
                                                    max="${item.stockQuantity}"
                                                    data-old-value="${item.quantity}"
                                                    class="
                                                        form-control

        <div class="cart-fixed-bar">

            <div class="cart-fixed-inner">



                <div class="cart-fixed-left">

                            type="checkbox"

<script>

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    function () {



        const selectAll =
            document.getElementById(
                "selectAll"
            );


        const bottomSelectAll =
            document.getElementById(
                "bottomSelectAll"
            );


        const checkboxes =
            document.querySelectorAll(
                ".cart-checkbox:not(:disabled)"
            );


        const topSelectedCount =
            document.getElementById(
                "topSelectedCount"
            );


        const bottomSelectedCount =
            document.getElementById(
                "bottomSelectedCount"
            );


        const bottomProductCount =
            document.getElementById(
                "bottomProductCount"
            );


        const bottomTotalPrice =
            document.getElementById(
                "bottomTotalPrice"
            );


        const bottomCheckoutForm =
            document.getElementById(
                "bottomCheckoutForm"
            );


        const bottomCheckoutBtn =
            document.getElementById(
                "bottomCheckoutBtn"
            );


        const bottomDeleteSelected =
            document.getElementById(
                "bottomDeleteSelected"
            );


        const quantityInputs =
            document.querySelectorAll(
                ".auto-quantity"
            );


        

        function money(value) {

            return new Intl.NumberFormat(
                "vi-VN"
            ).format(
                Math.round(value)
            ) + " đ";
        }



        function getSelectedCount() {

            let count = 0;


            checkboxes.forEach(
                function (checkbox) {

                    if (checkbox.checked) {

                        count++;
                    }
                }
            );


            return count;
        }


       

        function getSelectedTotal() {

            let total = 0;


            checkboxes.forEach(
                function (checkbox) {

                    if (checkbox.checked) {

                        total += Number(
                            checkbox.dataset.subtotal
                            || 0
                        );
                    }
                }
            );


            return total;
        }



        function updateSummary() {


            const count =
                getSelectedCount();


            const total =
                getSelectedTotal();


            
            if (topSelectedCount) {

                topSelectedCount.textContent =
                    count;
            }


            if (bottomSelectedCount) {

                bottomSelectedCount.textContent =
                    count;
            }


            if (bottomProductCount) {

                bottomProductCount.textContent =
                    count;
            }


           
            if (bottomTotalPrice) {

                bottomTotalPrice.textContent =
                    money(total);
            }


           
            if (bottomCheckoutBtn) {

                bottomCheckoutBtn.disabled =
                    count === 0;
            }


          
            if (selectAll) {


                selectAll.checked =
                    checkboxes.length > 0
                    && count === checkboxes.length;


                selectAll.indeterminate =
                    count > 0
                    && count < checkboxes.length;
            }


          
            if (bottomSelectAll) {


                bottomSelectAll.checked =
                    checkboxes.length > 0
                    && count === checkboxes.length;


                bottomSelectAll.indeterminate =
                    count > 0
                    && count < checkboxes.length;
            }
        }



        if (selectAll) {


            selectAll.addEventListener(
                "change",
                function () {


                    checkboxes.forEach(
                        function (checkbox) {

                            checkbox.checked =
                                selectAll.checked;
                        }
                    );


                    updateSummary();
                }
            );
        }



        if (bottomSelectAll) {


            bottomSelectAll.addEventListener(
                "change",
                function () {


                    checkboxes.forEach(
                        function (checkbox) {

                            checkbox.checked =
                                bottomSelectAll.checked;
                        }
                    );


                    updateSummary();
                }
            );
        }


        checkboxes.forEach(
            function (checkbox) {


                checkbox.addEventListener(
                    "change",
                    function () {

                        updateSummary();
                    }
                );
            }
        );



        quantityInputs.forEach(
            function (input) {


                let timer = null;


                input.addEventListener(
                    "input",
                    function () {


                        clearTimeout(timer);


                        const value =
                            Number(
                                input.value
                            );


                        const min =
                            Number(
                                input.min
                                || 1
                            );


                        const max =
                            Number(
                                input.max
                                || 0
                            );


                        const oldValue =
                            Number(
                                input.dataset.oldValue
                                || 0
                            );


                      
                        if (!Number.isInteger(value)
                                || value < min
                                || value > max) {

                            return;
                        }


                        if (value === oldValue) {

                            return;
                        }


                     
                        timer =
                            setTimeout(
                                function () {

                                    if (input.form) {

                                        input.form.submit();
                                    }

                                },
                                500
                            );

                    }
                );


                input.addEventListener(
                    "blur",
                    function () {


                        let value =
                            Number(
                                input.value
                            );


                        const min =
                            Number(
                                input.min
                                || 1
                            );


                        const max =
                            Number(
                                input.max
                                || 1
                            );


                        if (!Number.isFinite(value)
                                || value < min) {

                            input.value =
                                min;

                        } else if (value > max) {

                            input.value =
                                max;
                        }
                    }
                );
            }
        );


        function attachSelectedItems(
                form) {


            form.querySelectorAll(
                ".dynamic-selected-item"
            ).forEach(
                function (input) {

                    input.remove();
                }
            );


            const selected =
                document.querySelectorAll(
                    ".cart-checkbox:checked:not(:disabled)"
                );


            
            selected.forEach(
                function (checkbox) {


                    const input =
                        document.createElement(
                            "input"
                        );


                    input.type =
                        "hidden";


                    input.name =
                        "selectedItems";


                    input.value =
                        checkbox.value;


                    input.className =
                        "dynamic-selected-item";


                    form.appendChild(
                        input
                    );
                }
            );


            return selected.length;
        }


       

        if (bottomCheckoutForm) {


            bottomCheckoutForm.addEventListener(
                "submit",
                function (event) {


                    const selectedLength =
                        attachSelectedItems(
                            bottomCheckoutForm
                        );


                    if (selectedLength === 0) {


                        event.preventDefault();


                        alert(
                            "Vui lòng chọn ít nhất một sản phẩm để đặt hàng."
                        );
                    }
                }
            );
        }


        

        if (bottomDeleteSelected) {


            bottomDeleteSelected.addEventListener(
                "click",
                function () {


                    const selected =
                        document.querySelectorAll(
                            ".cart-checkbox:checked:not(:disabled)"
                        );


                 
                    if (selected.length === 0) {


                        alert(
                            "Vui lòng chọn sản phẩm cần xóa."
                        );


                        return;
                    }


                    if (!confirm(
                            "Bạn có chắc muốn xóa "
                            + selected.length
                            + " sản phẩm đã chọn?"
                    )) {


                        return;
                    }


                    
                    const form =
                        document.createElement(
                            "form"
                        );


                    form.method =
                        "post";


                    form.action =
                        "${pageContext.request.contextPath}/cart";


                    
                    const actionInput =
                        document.createElement(
                            "input"
                        );


                    actionInput.type =
                        "hidden";


                    actionInput.name =
                        "action";


                    actionInput.value =
                        "removeSelected";


                    form.appendChild(
                        actionInput
                    );


                  
                    selected.forEach(
                        function (checkbox) {


                            const input =
                                document.createElement(
                                    "input"
                                );


                            input.type =
                                "hidden";


                            input.name =
                                "selectedItems";


                            input.value =
                                checkbox.value;


                            form.appendChild(
                                input
                            );
                        }
                    );


                    document.body.appendChild(
                        form
                    );


                    form.submit();

                }
            );
        }



        updateSummary();

    }
);

</script>

                <div class="card-body p-4 p-md-5 text-center">

                    <c:choose>
                        <c:when test="${not empty category}">

                            <div class="bg-danger bg-opacity-10 text-danger rounded-circle d-inline-flex align-items-center justify-content-center mb-4"
                                 style="width: 80px; height: 80px;">
                                <i class="bi bi-trash3 fs-1"></i>
                            </div>

                            <h4 class="fw-bold text-dark mb-2">
                                Bạn chắc chắn chứ?
                            </h4>

                            <p class="text-muted mb-4">
                                Bạn đang chuẩn bị xóa danh mục
                                <strong class="text-dark fs-5">
                                    <c:out value="${category.categoryName}"/>
                                </strong>.
                                Vui lòng kiểm tra thông tin trước khi tiếp tục.
                            </p>

                            <div class="bg-light border rounded-3 p-3 mb-4 text-start">
                                <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center gap-3 py-2 border-bottom">
                                    <span class="text-muted">Mã danh mục</span>
                                    <strong><c:out value="${category.categoryId}"/></strong>
                                </div>

                                <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center gap-3 py-2 border-bottom">
                                    <span class="text-muted">Số sản phẩm</span>
                                    <strong><c:out value="${productCount}"/></strong>
                                </div>

                                <div class="d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center gap-3 py-2">
                                    <span class="text-muted">Số danh mục con</span>
                                    <strong><c:out value="${childCount}"/></strong>
                                </div>
                            </div>

                            <c:choose>
                                <c:when test="${productCount > 0 or childCount > 0}">
                                    <div class="alert alert-danger text-start mb-4">
                                        <div class="fw-bold mb-2">
                                            <i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle me-1"></i>
                                            Không thể xóa danh mục này
                                        </div>

                                        <c:if test="${productCount > 0}">
                                            <p class="mb-1">
                                                Danh mục đang chứa
                                                <strong><c:out value="${productCount}"/></strong>
                                                sản phẩm.
                                            </p>
                                        </c:if>

                                        <c:if test="${childCount > 0}">
                                            <p class="mb-1">
                                                Danh mục đang có
                                                <strong><c:out value="${childCount}"/></strong>
                                                danh mục con.
                                            </p>
                                        </c:if>

                                        <p class="mb-0 mt-2">
                                            Vui lòng chuyển sản phẩm hoặc xử lý
                                            danh mục con trước khi xóa.
                                        </p>
                                    </div>
                                </c:when>

                                <c:otherwise>
                                    <div class="alert alert-warning text-start mb-4">
                                        <i class="bi bi-exclamation-circle me-1"></i>
                                        Danh mục này không có sản phẩm hoặc danh mục con.
                                        Hành động xóa không thể hoàn tác.
                                    </div>
                                </c:otherwise>
                            </c:choose>

                            <c:if test="${not empty param.error}">
                                <div class="alert alert-danger text-start mb-4"
                                     role="alert">
                                    <c:choose>
                                        <c:when test="${param.error == 'hasProducts'}">
                                            Không thể xóa danh mục vì vẫn còn sản phẩm
                                            hoặc danh mục con. Vui lòng xử lý dữ liệu
                                            liên quan trước.
                                        </c:when>

                                        <c:when test="${param.error == 'delete'}">
                                            Không thể xóa danh mục.
                                            Vui lòng thử lại.
                                        </c:when>

                                        <c:when test="${param.error == 'server'}">
                                            Đã xảy ra lỗi hệ thống khi xóa danh mục.
                                            Vui lòng thử lại sau.
                                        </c:when>

                                        <c:otherwise>
                                            Đã xảy ra lỗi khi xử lý danh mục.
                                            Vui lòng thử lại.
                                        </c:otherwise>
                                    </c:choose>
                                </div>
                            </c:if>

                            <div class="d-flex gap-2 justify-content-center flex-wrap mt-3">

                                <a href="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/category?view=list"
                                   class="btn btn-light btn-lg border text-dark fs-6 px-4">
                                    Hủy bỏ
                                </a>

                                <c:if test="${productCount == 0 and childCount == 0}">
                                    <form action="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/category"
                                          method="post">

                                        <input type="hidden" name="action" value="delete">
                                        <input type="hidden" name="id" value="${category.categoryId}">

                                        <button type="submit"
                                                class="btn btn-danger btn-lg fs-6 px-4 shadow-sm">
                                            <i class="bi bi-trash3 me-1"></i>
                                            Đúng, xóa nó!
                                        </button>
                                    </form>
                                </c:if>

                            </div>

                        </c:when>

                        <c:otherwise>
                            <div class="py-4">
                                <i class="bi bi-exclamation-circle text-warning fs-1 mb-3 d-block"></i>

                                <h5 class="fw-bold">Lỗi truy xuất!</h5>

                                <p class="text-muted mb-4">
                                    Không tìm thấy danh mục cần xóa.
                                </p>

                                <a href="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/category?view=list"
                                   class="btn btn-primary">
                                    Quay lại danh sách
                                </a>
                            </div>
                        </c:otherwise>
                    </c:choose>

                </div>
            </div>

        </div>
    </div>
</div>
