                            success
                            ? "alert alert-success mx-3 mt-3 mb-0"
                            : "alert alert-danger mx-3 mt-3 mb-0";
                }



                async function postAddressAction(
                        data
                        ) {

                    const response =
                            await fetch(
                                    checkoutUrl,
                                    {
                                        method: "POST",

                                        credentials:
                                                "same-origin",

                                        headers: {

                                            "Accept":
                                                    "application/json",

                                            "Content-Type":
                                                    "application/x-www-form-urlencoded;charset=UTF-8"
                                        },

                                        body:
                                                new URLSearchParams(
                                                        data
                                                        ).toString()
                                    }
                            );


                    let result;


                    try {

                        result =
                                await response.json();

                    } catch (e) {

                        throw new Error(
                                "Phản hồi từ server không hợp lệ."
                                );
                    }


                    if (!response.ok
                            || !result.success) {

                        throw new Error(
                                result.message
                                || "Không thể thực hiện thao tác."
                                );
                    }


                    return result;
                }



                function getOptions() {

                    if (!addressList) {
                        return [];
                    }


                    return Array.from(
                            addressList.querySelectorAll(
                                    ".address-option"
                                    )
                            );
                }


                function updateAddressListState() {

                    const options =
                            getOptions();


                    if (addressListEmpty) {

                        addressListEmpty.style.display =
                                options.length === 0
                                ? ""
                                : "none";
                    }


                    if (openAddressModalButton) {

                        openAddressModalButton.disabled =
                                options.length === 0;
                    }


                    if (confirmAddressButton) {

                        confirmAddressButton.disabled =
                                options.length === 0;
                    }
                }



                function updateDeleteButtons() {

                    getOptions().forEach(
                            function (option) {

                                const id =
                                        option.dataset
                                        .addressId;


                                const button =
                                        option.querySelector(
                                                ".delete-address-button"
                                                );


                                if (!button) {
                                    return;
                                }


                                button.disabled =
                                        addressRequestBusy
                                        || id === committedAddressId;
                            }
                    );
                }



                function updateSelectedAddress(
                        address,
                        setDefaultBadge
                        ) {

                    if (!address) {
                        return;
                    }


                    committedAddressId =
                            String(
                                    address.addressId
                                    );


                    if (addressInput) {

                        addressInput.value =
                                committedAddressId;
                    }


                    if (selectedName) {

                        selectedName.textContent =
                                address.recipientName
                                + " | "
                                + address.phoneNumber;
                    }


                    if (selectedLine) {

                        selectedLine.textContent =
                                address.addressLine;
                    }


                    if (selectedCard) {

                        selectedCard.style.display =
                                "";
                    }


                    if (noAddressMessage) {

                        noAddressMessage.style.display =
                                "none";
                    }


                    if (needAddressMessage) {

                        needAddressMessage.style.display =
                                "none";
                    }


                    if (placeOrderButton) {

                        placeOrderButton.disabled =
                                false;
                    }


                    if (selectedDefaultBadge) {

                        selectedDefaultBadge.style.display =
                                setDefaultBadge
                                && address.defaultAddress
                                ? ""
                                : "none";
                    }


                    updateDeleteButtons();
                }



                function closeEditMode() {

                    editingOption =
                            null;


                    if (editAddressForm) {

                        editAddressForm.reset();

                        editAddressForm.classList.add(
                                "d-none"
                                );
                    }


                    if (addressList) {

                        addressList.classList.remove(
                                "d-none"
                                );
                    }


                    if (addressListFooter) {

                        addressListFooter.classList.remove(
                                "d-none"
                                );
                    }


                    if (modalMessage) {

                        modalMessage.className =
                                "alert mx-3 mt-3 mb-0 d-none";
                    }
                }



                if (addressList) {

                    addressList.addEventListener(
                            "click",
                            function (event) {

                                const button =
                                        event.target.closest(
                                                ".edit-address-button"
                                                );


                                if (!button
                                        || addressRequestBusy) {

                                    return;
                                }


                                editingOption =
                                        button.closest(
                                                ".address-option"
                                                );


                                if (!editingOption) {

                                    return;
                                }


                                editAddressId.value =
                                        editingOption.dataset
                                        .addressId;


                                editRecipientName.value =
                                        editingOption
                                        .querySelector(
                                                ".address-recipient"
                                                )
                                        .textContent
                                        .trim();


                                editPhoneNumber.value =
                                        editingOption
                                        .querySelector(
                                                ".address-phone"
                                                )
                                        .textContent
                                        .trim();


                                editAddressLine.value =
                                        editingOption
                                        .querySelector(
                                                ".address-line"
                                                )
                                        .textContent
                                        .trim();


                                addressList.classList.add(
                                        "d-none"
                                        );


                                addressListFooter.classList.add(
                                        "d-none"
                                        );


                                editAddressForm.classList.remove(
                                        "d-none"
                                        );
                            }
                    );
                }



                if (cancelEditAddressButton) {

                    cancelEditAddressButton.addEventListener(
                            "click",
                            function () {

                                closeEditMode();
                            }
                    );
                }



                if (editAddressForm) {

                    editAddressForm.addEventListener(
                            "submit",
                            async function (event) {

                                event.preventDefault();


                                if (addressRequestBusy) {
                                    return;
                                }


                                editRecipientName.value =
                                        editRecipientName.value
                                        .trim();


                                editPhoneNumber.value =
                                        editPhoneNumber.value
                                        .trim();


                                editAddressLine.value =
                                        editAddressLine.value
                                        .trim();


                                if (!editAddressForm
                                        .reportValidity()) {

                                    return;
                                }


                                addressRequestBusy =
                                        true;


                                saveEditAddressButton.disabled =
                                        true;


                                saveEditAddressButton.textContent =
                                        "Đang lưu...";


                                updateDeleteButtons();


                                try {

                                    const result =
                                            await postAddressAction(
                                                    {
                                                        action:
                                                                "editAddress",

                                                        addressId:
                                                                editAddressId.value,

                                                        recipientName:
                                                                editRecipientName.value,

                                                        phoneNumber:
                                                                editPhoneNumber.value,

                                                        addressLine:
                                                                editAddressLine.value,

                                                        addressActionToken:
                                                                addressActionToken
                                                    }
                                            );


                                    const address =
                                            result.address;


                                    editingOption
                                            .querySelector(
                                                    ".address-recipient"
                                                    )
                                            .textContent =
                                            address.recipientName;


                                    editingOption
                                            .querySelector(
                                                    ".address-phone"
                                                    )
                                            .textContent =
                                            address.phoneNumber;


                                    editingOption
                                            .querySelector(
                                                    ".address-line"
                                                    )
                                            .textContent =
                                            address.addressLine;

                                    if (String(
                                            address.addressId
                                            ) === committedAddressId) {

                                        updateSelectedAddress(
                                                address,
                                                false
                                                );
                                    }


                                    closeEditMode();


                                    showModalMessage(
                                            "Đã cập nhật địa chỉ.",
                                            true
                                            );


                                } catch (error) {

                                    showModalMessage(
                                            error.message,
                                            false
                                            );


                                } finally {

                                    addressRequestBusy =
                                            false;


                                    saveEditAddressButton.disabled =
                                            false;


                                    saveEditAddressButton.textContent =
                                            "Lưu thay đổi";


                                    updateDeleteButtons();
                                }
                            }
                    );
                }


                if (addressModal) {

                    addressModal.addEventListener(
                            "show.bs.modal",
                            function () {

                                closeEditMode();


                                if (addressList) {

                                    addressList
                                            .querySelectorAll(
                                                    'input[name="modalAddressId"]'
                                                    )
                                            .forEach(
                                                    function (radio) {

                                                        radio.checked =
                                                                radio.value
                                                                === committedAddressId;
                                                    }
                                            );


                                    const currentOption =
                                            getOptions()
                                            .find(
                                                    function (option) {

                                                        return option.dataset
                                                                .addressId
                                                                === committedAddressId;
                                                    }
                                            );


                                    if (currentOption) {

                                        addressList.prepend(
                                                currentOption
                                                );
                                    }
                                }


                                updateDeleteButtons();
                            }
                    );
                }



                if (addressList) {

                    addressList.addEventListener(
                            "change",
                            function (event) {

                                if (event.target.matches(
                                        'input[name="modalAddressId"]'
                                        )) {

                                    updateDeleteButtons();
                                }
                            }
                    );
                }



                if (confirmAddressButton) {

                    confirmAddressButton.addEventListener(
                            "click",
                            async function () {

                                if (addressRequestBusy
                                        || !addressList) {

                                    return;
                                }


                                const selectedRadio =
                                        addressList
                                        .querySelector(
                                                'input[name="modalAddressId"]:checked'
                                                );


                                if (!selectedRadio) {

                                    showModalMessage(
                                            "Vui lòng chọn địa chỉ giao hàng.",
                                            false
                                            );

                                    return;
                                }


                                const id =
                                        selectedRadio.value;


                                addressRequestBusy =
                                        true;


                                updateDeleteButtons();


                                try {

                                    const result =
                                            await postAddressAction(
                                                    {
                                                        action:
                                                                "selectAddress",

                                                        addressId:
                                                                id,

                                                        addressActionToken:
                                                                addressActionToken
                                                    }
                                            );


                                    const option =
                                            selectedRadio
                                            .closest(
                                                    ".address-option"
                                                    );


                                    updateSelectedAddress(
                                            result.selectedAddress,
                                            true
                                            );


                                    if (option) {

                                        addressList.prepend(
                                                option
                                                );
                                    }


                                    bootstrap.Modal
                                            .getOrCreateInstance(
                                                    addressModal
                                                    )
                                            .hide();


                                } catch (error) {

                                    showModalMessage(
                                            error.message,
                                            false
                                            );


                                } finally {

                                    addressRequestBusy =
                                            false;


                                    updateDeleteButtons();
                                }
                            }
                    );
                }



                if (addressList) {

                    addressList.addEventListener(
                            "submit",
                            async function (event) {

                                const form =
                                        event.target.closest(
                                                ".delete-address-form"
                                                );


                                if (!form) {
                                    return;
                                }


                                event.preventDefault();


                                if (addressRequestBusy) {
                                    return;
                                }


                                const option =
                                        form.closest(
                                                ".address-option"
                                                );


                                if (!option) {
                                    return;
                                }


                                const id =
                                        option.dataset
                                        .addressId;


                                if (id === committedAddressId) {

                                    showModalMessage(
                                            "Không thể xóa địa chỉ đang sử dụng. "
                                            + "Vui lòng xác nhận địa chỉ khác trước.",
                                            false
                                            );

                                    return;
                                }


                                if (!window.confirm(
                                        "Bạn chắc chắn muốn xóa địa chỉ này?"
                                        )) {

                                    return;
                                }


                                addressRequestBusy =
                                        true;


                                updateDeleteButtons();


                                try {

                                    await postAddressAction(
                                            {
                                                action:
                                                        "deleteAddress",

                                                addressId:
                                                        id,

                                                addressActionToken:
                                                        addressActionToken
                                            }
                                    );


                                    option.remove();


                                    updateAddressListState();


                                    showModalMessage(
                                            "Đã xóa địa chỉ thành công.",
                                            true
                                            );


                                } catch (error) {

                                    showModalMessage(
                                            error.message,
                                            false
                                            );


                                } finally {

                                    addressRequestBusy =
                                            false;


                                    updateDeleteButtons();
                                }
                            }
                    );
                }



                const addAddressForm =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "addAddressForm"
                                );


                const saveAddressButton =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "saveAddressButton"
                                );


                if (addAddressForm) {

                    addAddressForm.addEventListener(
                            "submit",
                            function (event) {

                                if (addAddressForm
                                        .dataset
                                        .submitting
                                        === "true") {

                                    event.preventDefault();

                                    return;
                                }


                                if (!addAddressForm
                                        .checkValidity()) {

                                    return;
                                }


                                addAddressForm
                                        .dataset
                                        .submitting =
                                        "true";


                                if (saveAddressButton) {

                                    saveAddressButton.disabled =
                                            true;


                                    saveAddressButton.textContent =
                                            "Đang lưu...";
                                }
                            }
                    );
                }


                const orderForm =
                        document.getElementById(
                                "orderForm"
                                );


                if (orderForm) {

                    orderForm.addEventListener(
                            "submit",
                            function (event) {

                                if (orderForm
                                        .dataset
                                        .submitting
                                        === "true") {

                                    event.preventDefault();

                                    return;
                                }


                                if (!orderForm
                                        .checkValidity()) {

                                    return;
                                }


                                orderForm
                                        .dataset
                                        .submitting =
                                        "true";


                                if (placeOrderButton) {

                                    placeOrderButton.disabled =
                                            true;


                                    placeOrderButton.textContent =
                                            "Đang xử lý đơn hàng...";
                                }
                            }
                    );
                }


                updateAddressListState();

                updateDeleteButtons();

            }
    );

</script>

            <h2 id="payment-action-title">Thanh toán đơn hàng</h2>
            <p class="payment-muted">Bạn sẽ được chuyển đến cổng <strong><c:out value="${order.paymentMethod}"/></strong> để hoàn tất giao dịch.</p>
            <c:if test="${not empty sessionScope.paymentError}">
                <div class="alert alert-warning" role="alert"><c:out value="${sessionScope.paymentError}"/></div>
                <c:remove var="paymentError" scope="session"/>
            </c:if>

                        Lượt sử dụng voucher của đơn đã đặt vẫn được giữ.
                    </p>
                </c:when>

                <c:when test="${order.orderStatus != 'CANCELLED'}">
                    <p class="purchase-cancel-note">
                        Không thể tự hủy đơn ở trạng thái hiện tại.
                    </p>
                </c:when>
            </c:choose>
        </aside>
    </div>
</div>

<script>
    function closeCustomerToast(button) {
        const toast = button.closest(".customer-toast");

        if (toast) {
            toast.classList.add("hide");

            setTimeout(function () {
                toast.remove();
            }, 250);
        }
    }

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        document.querySelectorAll(".customer-toast").forEach(function (toast) {
            setTimeout(function () {
                if (toast.isConnected) {
                    toast.classList.add("hide");

                    setTimeout(function () {
                        toast.remove();
                    }, 250);
                }
            }, 4000);
        });
    });
</script>

    <c:if test="${not empty orderingRestriction}">

    </div>

    </div>

    <div class="ph-filters">
        <nav class="ph-tabs" aria-label="Lọc đơn hàng theo trạng thái">
            <c:forEach var="tab" items="${tabs}">
                <c:url var="tabUrl" value="/my-orders">
                    <c:param name="status" value="${tab.key}" />
                    <c:param name="q" value="${query}" />
                </c:url>

                <a href="<c:out value='${tabUrl}' />"
                   class="ph-tab ${activeTab == tab.key ? 'is-active' : ''}"
                   ${activeTab == tab.key ? 'aria-current="page"' : ''}>
                    <c:out value="${tab.value}" />
                    <span class="ph-count">
                        <c:out value="${tabCounts[tab.key]}" />
                    </span>
                </a>
            </c:forEach>
        </nav>

        <form class="ph-search"
              method="get"
              action="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/my-orders"
              role="search">
            <input type="hidden"
                   name="status"
                   value="<c:out value='${activeTab}' />">

            <i class="bi bi-search" aria-hidden="true"></i>

            <input type="search"
                   name="q"
                   maxlength="100"
                   aria-label="Tìm theo mã đơn, tên sản phẩm hoặc mã SKU"
                   value="<c:out value='${query}' />"
                   placeholder="Tìm mã đơn, tên sản phẩm hoặc mã SKU">

            <button type="submit">Tìm kiếm</button>
        </form>
    </div>

    <div class="ph-results">
        <span>
            <strong><c:out value="${resultCount}" /></strong> đơn hàng
            <c:if test="${not empty query}">
                cho “<c:out value="${query}" />”
            </c:if>
        </span>

        <c:choose>
            <c:when test="${not empty query}">
                <c:url var="clearUrl" value="/my-orders">
                    <c:param name="status" value="${activeTab}" />
                </c:url>
                <a href="<c:out value='${clearUrl}' />">Xóa tìm kiếm</a>
            </c:when>
            <c:otherwise>
                <span>Mới nhất trước</span>
            </c:otherwise>
        </c:choose>
    </div>

    <c:if test="${empty orders}">

            <h2>

                    : 'Không tìm thấy đơn hàng'}

            <p>
                ${empty query

                                       default="Sản phẩm đã đặt" />

                            <p>
                                Mã sản phẩm:
                                <c:out value="${item.skuCode}"
                                       default="${item.skuId}" />
                            </p>
                            <span>
                                Số lượng:
                                <c:out value="${item.quantity}" />
                            </span>
                        </div>

                        <div class="ph-price">
                            <fmt:formatNumber value="${item.price}"
                                              pattern="#,##0" />đ
                            <small>Đơn giá lúc đặt</small>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </c:forEach>

                <c:if test="${empty orderItems[order.orderId]}">
                    <p class="ph-missing">
                        Chưa có thông tin sản phẩm cho đơn này.
                    </p>
                </c:if>
            </div>

            <div class="ph-order-foot">
                <div class="ph-total">
                    <span>Thành tiền</span>
                    <strong>
                        <fmt:formatNumber value="${order.totalAmount}"
                                          pattern="#,##0" />đ
                    </strong>
                </div>

                <c:url var="detailUrl" value="/my-orders/detail">
                    <c:param name="id" value="${order.orderId}" />
                </c:url>

                <a class="ph-button"
                   href="<c:out value='${detailUrl}' />">
                    <c:choose>
                        <c:when test="${order.orderStatus == 'CANCELLED'
                                        || order.orderStatus == 'COMPLETED'
                                        || order.orderStatus == 'DELIVERED'}">
                            Xem chi tiết
                        </c:when>
                        <c:otherwise>
                            Theo dõi đơn hàng
                        </c:otherwise>
                    </c:choose>
                    <i class="bi bi-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                </a>
            </div>
        </article>
    </c:forEach>

    <c:if test="${pageCount > 1}">
        <nav class="ph-pagination"
             aria-label="Phân trang lịch sử mua hàng">

            <c:if test="${currentPage > 1}">
                <c:url var="prevUrl" value="/my-orders">
                    <c:param name="status" value="${activeTab}" />
                    <c:param name="q" value="${query}" />
                    <c:param name="page" value="${currentPage - 1}" />
                </c:url>

                <a class="ph-secondary"
                   href="<c:out value='${prevUrl}' />">
                    <i class="bi bi-arrow-left" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                    Trang trước
                </a>
            </c:if>

            <span>
                Trang <c:out value="${currentPage}" />
                / <c:out value="${pageCount}" />
            </span>

            <c:if test="${currentPage < pageCount}">
                <c:url var="nextUrl" value="/my-orders">
                    <c:param name="status" value="${activeTab}" />
                    <c:param name="q" value="${query}" />
                    <c:param name="page" value="${currentPage + 1}" />
                </c:url>

                <a class="ph-secondary"
                   href="<c:out value='${nextUrl}' />">
                    Trang sau
                    <i class="bi bi-arrow-right" aria-hidden="true"></i>
                </a>
            </c:if>
        </nav>
    </c:if>

</main>

<script>

    document.querySelectorAll(".notification").forEach(function (message) {
        setTimeout(function () {
            message.classList.add("notification-hide");

            setTimeout(function () {
                message.remove();
            }, 300);
        }, 3500);
    });


    function showValidationToast(message) {
        document.querySelectorAll(".validation-toast").forEach(function (toast) {
            toast.remove();
        });

        const toast = document.createElement("div");
        toast.className = "validation-toast";
        toast.setAttribute("role", "alert");

        const icon = document.createElement("span");
        icon.className = "notification-icon";
        icon.textContent = "!";

        const text = document.createElement("span");
        text.textContent = message;

        toast.appendChild(icon);
        toast.appendChild(text);

        document.querySelector(".return-form-page").appendChild(toast);

        setTimeout(function () {
            toast.classList.add("notification-hide");

            setTimeout(function () {
                toast.remove();
            }, 300);
        }, 3500);
    }


    const requestType = document.getElementById("requestType");
    const form = document.getElementById("returnExchangeForm");

    function updateExchangeFields() {
        const isExchange = requestType.value === "EXCHANGE";

        document.querySelectorAll(".exchange-field").forEach(function (field) {
            field.style.display = isExchange ? "block" : "none";

            const select = field.querySelector("select");

            const checkbox = document.querySelector(
                '.item-checkbox[value="' + field.dataset.orderItemId + '"]'
            );

            select.required = isExchange && checkbox.checked;
            select.disabled = !isExchange;
        });
    }

    document.querySelectorAll(".item-checkbox").forEach(function (checkbox) {
        checkbox.addEventListener("change", function () {
            const field = document.querySelector(
                '.exchange-field[data-order-item-id="' + checkbox.value + '"]'
            );

            if (!field) {
                return;
            }

            const select = field.querySelector("select");

            select.required =
                requestType.value === "EXCHANGE" && checkbox.checked;
        });
    });

    requestType.addEventListener("change", updateExchangeFields);


    form.addEventListener("submit", function (event) {
        const selectedItems = document.querySelectorAll(
            ".item-checkbox:checked"
        );

        if (selectedItems.length === 0) {
            event.preventDefault();
            showValidationToast("Vui lòng chọn ít nhất một sản phẩm.");
            return;
        }

        if (requestType.value === "EXCHANGE") {
            for (const checkbox of selectedItems) {
                const field = document.querySelector(
                    '.exchange-field[data-order-item-id="' + checkbox.value + '"]'
                );

                if (!field) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    showValidationToast(
                        "Không tìm thấy thông tin phiên bản sản phẩm."
                    );
                    return;
                }

                const select = field.querySelector("select");

                if (!select.value) {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    showValidationToast(
                        "Vui lòng chọn phiên bản muốn đổi cho từng sản phẩm."
                    );
                    select.focus();
                    return;
                }
            }
        }
    });

    updateExchangeFields();
</script>

        <script>
            function escapeHTML(str) {
                if (!str)
                    return '';
                return String(str).replace(/[&<>'"]/g, function (tag) {
                    const charsToReplace = {
                        '&': '&amp;',
                        '<': '&lt;',
                        '>': '&gt;',
                        "'": '&#39;',
                        '"': '&quot;'
                    };
                    return charsToReplace[tag] || tag;
                });
            }

            document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
                const searchInput = document.getElementById('headerSearchInput');
                const searchSuggestions = document.getElementById('searchSuggestions');
                let timeoutId = null;

                searchInput.addEventListener('input', function () {
                    const keyword = this.value.trim();
                    clearTimeout(timeoutId);

                    if (keyword.length < 2) {
                        searchSuggestions.classList.add('d-none');
                        return;
                    }

                    timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
                        fetch(`${pageContext.request.contextPath}/api/search?q=` + encodeURIComponent(keyword))
                                .then(response => response.json())
                                .then(data => {
                                    searchSuggestions.innerHTML = '';

                                    if (data.length === 0) {
                                        searchSuggestions.innerHTML = '<div class="suggestion-empty">Không tìm thấy sản phẩm nào!</div>';
                                    } else {
                                        data.forEach(item => {
                                            const priceStr = item.price > 0
                                                    ? new Intl.NumberFormat('vi-VN').format(item.price) + ' ₫'
                                                    : 'Liên hệ';

                                            const safeName = escapeHTML(item.name);

                                            let imageHtml = '';
                                            if (item.imageUrl && item.imageUrl.trim() !== '') {
                                                const safeImgUrl = escapeHTML(item.imageUrl);
                                                imageHtml = `<img src="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/\${safeImgUrl}" alt="\${safeName}" style="width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: contain; border-radius: 4px;">`;
                                            } else {
                                                imageHtml = `<i class="bi bi-box-seam fs-5 text-secondary"></i>`;
                                            }

                                            const html = `
                                <a href="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/shop?action=detail&id=\${item.id}" class="suggestion-item">
                                    <div class="suggestion-img d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center bg-light border p-1">
                                        \${imageHtml}
                                    </div>
                                    <div class="suggestion-info">
                                        <span class="suggestion-name">\${safeName}</span>
                                        <span class="suggestion-price">\${priceStr}</span>
                                    </div>
                                </a>
                                `;
                                            searchSuggestions.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', html);
                                        });
                                    }
                                    searchSuggestions.classList.remove('d-none');
                                })
                                .catch(err => console.error("Lỗi search API:", err));
                    }, 300);
                });

                document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
                    if (!searchInput.contains(e.target) && !searchSuggestions.contains(e.target)) {
                        searchSuggestions.classList.add('d-none');
                    }
                });

                document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
                    if (e.ctrlKey && e.key === 'k') {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        searchInput.focus();
                    }
                });
            });
        </script>
        <c:if test="${not empty sessionScope.loggedInUser
                      and sessionScope.loggedInUser.customer}">
              <script>
                  (() => {
                      const contextPath = '${pageContext.request.contextPath}';
                      const bell = document.getElementById('notificationBell');
                      const panel = document.getElementById('notificationPanel');
                      const badge = document.getElementById('notificationBadge');
                      const list = document.getElementById('notificationList');
                      const total = document.getElementById('notificationTotal');

                      if (!bell || !panel || !badge || !list)
                          return;

                      async function loadCount() {
                          try {
                              const response = await fetch(
                                      contextPath + '/notification?action=count',
                                      {credentials: 'same-origin'}
                              );

                              if (!response.ok)
                                  return;

                              const data = await response.json();
                              const count = Number(data.count) || 0;

                              badge.textContent = count > 99 ? '99+' : String(count);
                              badge.hidden = count === 0;
                          } catch (error) {
                              console.error('Cannot load notification count.', error);
                          }
                      }

                      async function loadList() {
                          list.replaceChildren();

                          const loading = document.createElement('p');
                          loading.className = 'notification-empty';
                          loading.textContent = 'Đang tải thông báo...';
                          list.appendChild(loading);

                          try {
                              const response = await fetch(
                                      contextPath + '/notification?action=list',
                                      {credentials: 'same-origin'}
                              );

                              if (!response.ok) {
                                  throw new Error('Không thể tải thông báo.');
                              }

                              const notifications = await response.json();
                              list.replaceChildren();

                              if (notifications.length === 0) {
                                  const empty = document.createElement('p');
                                  empty.className = 'notification-empty';
                                  empty.textContent = 'Bạn chưa có thông báo nào.';
                                  list.appendChild(empty);
                                  total.textContent = '';
                                  return;
                              }

                              const unread = notifications.filter(n => !n.read).length;
                              total.textContent = unread > 0
                                      ? unread + ' chưa đọc'
                                      : '';

                              notifications.forEach(n => {
                                  const item = document.createElement('button');
                                  item.type = 'button';
                                  item.className = 'notification-item'
                                          + (n.read ? '' : ' unread');

                                  const title = document.createElement('span');
                                  title.className = 'notification-item-title';
                                  title.textContent = n.title || 'Thông báo';

                                  const message = document.createElement('span');
                                  message.className = 'notification-item-message';
                                  message.textContent = n.message || '';

                                  const time = document.createElement('span');
                                  time.className = 'notification-item-time';
                                  time.textContent = n.createdAt || '';

                                  item.append(title, message, time);

                                  item.addEventListener('click', async () => {
                                      try {
                                          const body = new URLSearchParams({
                                              action: 'read',
                                              id: String(n.id)
                                          });

                                          const readResponse = await fetch(
                                                  contextPath + '/notification',
                                                  {
                                                      method: 'POST',
                                                      credentials: 'same-origin',
                                                      headers: {
                                                          'Content-Type':
                                                                  'application/x-www-form-urlencoded'
                                                      },
                                                      body: body.toString()
                                                  }
                                          );

                                          if (!readResponse.ok) {
                                              throw new Error(
                                                      'Không thể cập nhật trạng thái đã đọc.'
                                                      );
                                          }

                                          await loadCount();

                                          if (n.orderId != null) {
                                              window.location.href =
                                                      contextPath + '/my-orders/detail?id='
                                                      + encodeURIComponent(n.orderId);
                                          } else {
                                              await loadList();
                                          }
                                      } catch (error) {
                                          console.error(error);
                                      }
                                  });

                                  list.appendChild(item);
                              });
                          } catch (error) {
                              list.replaceChildren();

                              const failed = document.createElement('p');
                              failed.className = 'notification-empty';
                              failed.textContent = 'Không tải được thông báo. Vui lòng thử lại.';
                              list.appendChild(failed);

                              console.error(error);
                          }
                      }

                      bell.addEventListener('click', async () => {
                          const isOpening = panel.hidden;
                          panel.hidden = !isOpening;
                          bell.setAttribute('aria-expanded', String(isOpening));

                          if (isOpening) {
                              await loadList();
                              await loadCount();
                          }
                      });

                      document.addEventListener('click', event => {
                          if (!event.target.closest('.notification-wrapper')) {
                              panel.hidden = true;
                              bell.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
                          }
                      });

                      loadCount();
                  })();
              </script>
        </c:if>
        <main class="page-main"><%@page contentType="text/html" pageEncoding="UTF-8"%>

<script>
    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

        const ratings = document.querySelectorAll(
                'input[name="rating"]'
                );
        const ratingText =
                document.getElementById("oeRatingText");

        const ratingMessages = {
            1: "1 sao · Rất không hài lòng",
            2: "2 sao · Không hài lòng",
            3: "3 sao · Bình thường",
            4: "4 sao · Hài lòng",
            5: "5 sao · Rất hài lòng"
        };

        ratings.forEach(function (radio) {
            radio.addEventListener("change", function () {
                ratingText.textContent =
                        ratingMessages[this.value];
            });
        });

        const comment =
                document.getElementById("oeReviewComment");

        const commentCount =
                document.getElementById("oeCommentCount");

        function updateCommentCount() {
            commentCount.textContent = comment.value.length;
        }

        comment.addEventListener(
                "input",
                updateCommentCount
                );

        document.querySelectorAll(
                ".oe-review-suggestion"
                ).forEach(function (button) {

            button.addEventListener("click", function () {

                const suggestion =
                        this.dataset.suggestion;

                const current = comment.value.trim();

                if (current.includes(suggestion)) {
                    return;
                }

                const separator = current ? ". " : "";
                const next =
                        current + separator + suggestion;

                comment.value = next.slice(0, 2000);

                updateCommentCount();
                comment.focus();

            });

        });

        const imageInput =
                document.getElementById("oeReviewImages");

        const imagePreview =
                document.getElementById("oeImagePreview");

        const imageCount =
                document.getElementById("oeImageCount");

        const maxImages = 3;
        const maxSize = 5 * 1024 * 1024;

        let previewUrls = [];

        function clearPreview() {
            previewUrls.forEach(function (url) {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            });

            previewUrls = [];
            imagePreview.innerHTML = "";
            imageCount.textContent = "0/3 ảnh đã chọn";
        }

        imageInput.addEventListener(
                "change",
                function () {

                    clearPreview();

                    const files = Array.from(this.files);

                    if (files.length > maxImages) {
                        alert("Chỉ được chọn tối đa 3 ảnh.");
                        this.value = "";
                        return;
                    }

                    const allowedTypes = [
                        "image/jpeg",
                        "image/png",
                        "image/webp"
                    ];

                    for (const file of files) {

                        if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
                            alert(
                                    "Chỉ hỗ trợ ảnh JPG, PNG và WEBP."
                                    );
                            this.value = "";
                            clearPreview();
                            return;
                        }

                        if (file.size > maxSize) {
                            alert(
                                    "Mỗi ảnh không được vượt quá 5MB."
                                    );
                            this.value = "";
                            clearPreview();
                            return;
                        }
                    }

                    files.forEach(function (file, index) {

                        const url = URL.createObjectURL(file);
                        previewUrls.push(url);

                        const img = document.createElement("img");
                        img.src = url;
                        img.alt = "Ảnh đánh giá " + (index + 1);

                        imagePreview.appendChild(img);

                    });

                    imageCount.textContent =
                            files.length + "/3 ảnh đã chọn";
                }
        );

        const form =
                document.getElementById("oeReviewForm");

        const submitButton =
                document.getElementById("oeReviewSubmit");

        form.addEventListener("submit", function () {

            if (!form.checkValidity()) {
                return;
            }

            submitButton.disabled = true;
            submitButton.textContent = "Đang gửi...";

        });

        window.addEventListener("pagehide", function () {
            previewUrls.forEach(function (url) {
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
            });
        });

    });
</script>

<script>
    function changeMainImage(thumbElement) {
        document.getElementById('mainProductImage').src = thumbElement.src;

        let allThumbs = document.querySelectorAll('.gallery-thumb');
        allThumbs.forEach(t => {
            t.style.border = '1px solid #dee2e6';
            t.classList.add('opacity-50');
        });

        thumbElement.style.border = '2px solid #0d6efd';
        thumbElement.classList.remove('opacity-50');
    }

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        const skuRadios = document.querySelectorAll('.sku-radio');
        const displayPrice = document.getElementById('displayPrice');
        const displayStock = document.getElementById('displayStock');
        const btnAddToCart = document.getElementById('btnAddToCart');

        skuRadios.forEach(radio => {
            radio.addEventListener('change', function () {
                const price = parseFloat(this.getAttribute('data-price'));
                const stock = parseInt(this.getAttribute('data-stock'));

                const formattedPrice = price.toLocaleString('vi-VN') + ' ₫';
                displayPrice.innerHTML = formattedPrice;

                if (stock > 0) {
                    displayStock.innerHTML = `<i class="bi bi-box-seam me-1"></i>Còn \${stock} sản phẩm`;
                    displayStock.className = "text-success fw-medium mt-1";
                    btnAddToCart.disabled = false;
                } else {
                    displayStock.innerHTML = `<i class="bi bi-x-circle me-1"></i>Hết hàng`;
                    displayStock.className = "text-danger fw-medium mt-1";
                    btnAddToCart.disabled = true;
                }
            });
        });

        const descContent = document.getElementById('descContent');
        const descOverlay = document.getElementById('descOverlay');
        const btnToggleDesc = document.getElementById('btnToggleDesc');

        if (descContent.scrollHeight > descContent.clientHeight) {
            btnToggleDesc.style.display = 'inline-block'; 
        } else {
            descOverlay.classList.add('hidden'); 
        }

        btnToggleDesc.addEventListener('click', function () {
            if (descContent.classList.contains('collapsed')) {
                descContent.classList.remove('collapsed');
                descContent.style.maxHeight = descContent.scrollHeight + "px";
                descOverlay.classList.add('hidden');
                btnToggleDesc.innerHTML = 'Ẩn bớt <i class="bi bi-chevron-up ms-1"></i>';
            } else {
                descContent.classList.add('collapsed');
                descContent.style.maxHeight = "250px"; 
                descOverlay.classList.remove('hidden');
                btnToggleDesc.innerHTML = 'Xem thêm <i class="bi bi-chevron-down ms-1"></i>';

                document.getElementById('descContainer').scrollIntoView({behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start'});
            }
        });
    });
</script>

<script>
    function formatPrice(input) {
        let value = input.value.replace(/\D/g, '');

        if (value !== '') {
            input.value = value.replace(/\B(?=(\d{3})+(?!\d))/g, ".");
        } else {
            input.value = '';
        }
    }

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
        const priceInputs = document.querySelectorAll('input[name="priceStr"]');
        priceInputs.forEach(input => {
            input.value = input.value.replace(/,/g, '.');
        });
    });
</script>

<div class="return-detail">

    <c:if test="${not empty param.message}">
        <div class="success-message notification" role="status">

            <span>
                <c:choose>
                    <c:when test="${param.message == 'approved'}">
                        Yêu cầu đã được chấp nhận thành công. Khách hàng có thể theo dõi kết quả xử lý.
                    </c:when>
                    <c:when test="${param.message == 'rejected'}">
                        Yêu cầu đã được từ chối thành công. Lý do từ chối đã được lưu lại.
                    </c:when>
                    <c:otherwise>
                        Thao tác đã được thực hiện thành công.
                    </c:otherwise>
                </c:choose>
            </span>
        </div>
    </c:if>

    <c:if test="${not empty param.error}">
        <div class="error-message notification" role="alert">
            <span class="notification-icon">!</span>
            <span>
                <c:choose>
                    <c:when test="${param.error == 'noteRequired'}">
                        Chưa thể từ chối yêu cầu. Vui lòng nhập lý do từ chối.
                    </c:when>
                    <c:when test="${param.error == 'alreadyReviewed'}">
                        Yêu cầu đã được xử lý. Vui lòng tải lại trang để xem kết quả mới nhất.
                    </c:when>
                    <c:when test="${param.error == 'invalidId'}">
                        Mã yêu cầu không hợp lệ. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại.
                    </c:when>
                    <c:when test="${param.error == 'invalidAction'}">
                        Thao tác không hợp lệ. Vui lòng chọn Chấp nhận hoặc Từ chối.
                    </c:when>
                    <c:when test="${param.error == 'invalid'}">
                        Không thể cập nhật yêu cầu vì dữ liệu không hợp lệ.
                    </c:when>
                    <c:when test="${param.error == 'system'}">
                        Hệ thống đang gặp sự cố. Vui lòng thử lại sau.
                    </c:when>
                    <c:otherwise>
                        Đã xảy ra lỗi khi xử lý yêu cầu. Vui lòng thử lại.
                    </c:otherwise>
                </c:choose>
            </span>
        </div>
    </c:if>

<script>
    let reviewAction = null;

    function showReviewModal(action) {
        const note = document.getElementById("staffNote");
        const error = document.getElementById("noteError");

        if (action === "reject" && note.value.trim() === "") {
            if (error) {
                error.classList.add("show");
            }

            note.focus();
            return;
        }

        if (error) {
            error.classList.remove("show");
        }

        reviewAction = action;

        const modal = document.getElementById("reviewModal");
        const icon = document.getElementById("reviewModalIcon");
        const title = document.getElementById("reviewModalTitle");
        const message = document.getElementById("reviewModalMessage");
        const confirmButton = document.getElementById("confirmReviewButton");

        confirmButton.disabled = false;

        if (action === "approve") {
            icon.className = "review-modal-icon";
            icon.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-check-circle-fill"></i>';

            title.textContent = "Xác nhận chấp nhận";
            message.textContent =
                    "Bạn có chắc chắn muốn chấp nhận yêu cầu này không?";

            confirmButton.className =
                    "review-modal-btn review-modal-btn-approve";

            confirmButton.textContent = "Chấp nhận";

        } else {
            icon.className = "review-modal-icon reject";
            icon.innerHTML = '<i class="bi bi-exclamation-triangle-fill"></i>';

            title.textContent = "Xác nhận từ chối";
            message.textContent =
                    "Bạn có chắc chắn muốn từ chối yêu cầu này không? Vui lòng kiểm tra lý do trước khi tiếp tục.";

            confirmButton.className =
                    "review-modal-btn review-modal-btn-reject";

            confirmButton.textContent = "Từ chối";
        }

        modal.classList.add("show");
        confirmButton.focus();
    }

    function closeReviewModal() {
        const modal = document.getElementById("reviewModal");

        modal.classList.remove("show");
        reviewAction = null;
    }

    function confirmReview() {
        if (reviewAction === null) {
            return;
        }

        const note = document.getElementById("staffNote");
        const error = document.getElementById("noteError");

        if (reviewAction === "reject" && note.value.trim() === "") {
            closeReviewModal();

            if (error) {
                error.classList.add("show");
            }

            note.focus();
            return;
        }

        const form = document.getElementById("reviewForm");
        const actionInput = document.getElementById("reviewAction");
        const confirmButton = document.getElementById("confirmReviewButton");

        actionInput.value = reviewAction;

        confirmButton.disabled = true;
        confirmButton.textContent = "Đang xử lý...";

        form.submit();
    }

    document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

        const note = document.getElementById("staffNote");
        const error = document.getElementById("noteError");

        if (note && error) {
            note.addEventListener("input", function () {
                if (this.value.trim() !== "") {
                    error.classList.remove("show");
                }
            });
        }

        document.querySelectorAll(".notification").forEach(function (message) {
            setTimeout(function () {
                message.classList.add("notification-hide");

                setTimeout(function () {
                    message.remove();
                }, 300);

            }, 3500);
        });

    });

    const reviewModal = document.getElementById("reviewModal");

    if (reviewModal) {
        reviewModal.addEventListener("click", function (event) {
            if (event.target === this) {
                closeReviewModal();
            }
        });
    }

    document.addEventListener("keydown", function (event) {
        if (event.key === "Escape") {
            closeReviewModal();
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
    const searchInput = document.getElementById("searchRequest");
    const typeFilter = document.getElementById("filterType");
    const statusFilter = document.getElementById("filterStatus");
    const fromDateFilter = document.getElementById("filterFromDate");
    const toDateFilter = document.getElementById("filterToDate");
    const resetButton = document.getElementById("resetFilters");
    const resultLabel = document.getElementById("filterResult");
    const noResultRow = document.getElementById("noFilterResult");

    const rows = document.querySelectorAll(".request-row");

    function filterRequests() {
        const keyword = searchInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
        const selectedType = typeFilter.value;
        const selectedStatus = statusFilter.value;
        const fromDate = fromDateFilter.value;
        const toDate = toDateFilter.value;

        let visibleCount = 0;

        rows.forEach(function (row) {
            const customerName = row.cells[2].innerText.trim().toLowerCase();
            const rowType = row.dataset.type;
            const rowStatus = row.dataset.status;

            const dateElement = row.querySelector(".filter-date");
            const rowDate = dateElement
                    ? dateElement.textContent.trim()
                    : "";

            const matchesKeyword = customerName.includes(keyword);

            const matchesType =
                    selectedType === "" || rowType === selectedType;

            const matchesStatus =
                    selectedStatus === "" || rowStatus === selectedStatus;

            const matchesFromDate =
                    fromDate === "" || rowDate >= fromDate;

            const matchesToDate =
                    toDate === "" || rowDate <= toDate;

            const isMatched =
                    matchesKeyword &&
                    matchesType &&
                    matchesStatus &&
                    matchesFromDate &&
                    matchesToDate;

            row.style.display = isMatched ? "" : "none";

            if (isMatched) {
                visibleCount++;
            }
        });

        if (noResultRow) {
            noResultRow.style.display =
                    rows.length > 0 && visibleCount === 0 ? "" : "none";
        }

        resultLabel.textContent =
                "Hiển thị " + visibleCount + " / " + rows.length + " yêu cầu";
    }

    searchInput.addEventListener("input", filterRequests);
    typeFilter.addEventListener("change", filterRequests);
    statusFilter.addEventListener("change", filterRequests);
    fromDateFilter.addEventListener("change", filterRequests);
    toDateFilter.addEventListener("change", filterRequests);

    resetButton.addEventListener("click", function () {
        searchInput.value = "";
        typeFilter.value = "";
        statusFilter.value = "";
        fromDateFilter.value = "";
        toDateFilter.value = "";

        filterRequests();
    });

    filterRequests();
});
</script>

                            </td>

                            <td>
                                <c:choose>
                                    <c:when test="${user.active}">

                                    </span>
                                </c:when>
                                <c:otherwise>
                                    <span class="badge bg-danger-subtle text-danger border border-danger-subtle">
                                        Locked
                                    </span>
                                </c:otherwise>
                            </c:choose>
                            </td>

                            <td>
                            <span class="text-muted">
                                ${user.createdAt}
                            </span>
                            </td>

                            <td class="text-end">

                                <c:choose>

                                    <c:when test="${user.userId eq sessionScope.loggedInUser.userId}">

                                    <span class="text-muted small">
                                        <i class="bi bi-person-check me-1"></i>
                                        Tài khoản hiện tại
                                    </span>

                                </c:when>

                                <c:otherwise>
                                    <div class="d-inline-flex gap-1">

                                        <form action="${pageContext.request.contextPath}/user"
                                              method="post"
                                              class="d-inline">

                                            <input type="hidden"
                                                   name="action"
                                                   value="toggleStatus">

                                            <input type="hidden"
                                                   name="id"
                                                   value="${user.userId}">

                                            <c:choose>

                                                <c:when test="${user.active}">

                                                    <input type="hidden"
                                                           name="active"
                                                           value="false">

                                                    <button type="submit"
                                                            class="btn btn-sm btn-light text-danger border rounded-2"
                                                            title="Khóa tài khoản">

                                                        <i class="bi bi-lock"></i>

                                                    </button>

                                                </c:when>

                                                <c:otherwise>

                                                    <input type="hidden"
                                                           name="active"
                                                           value="true">

                                                    <button type="submit"
                                                            class="btn btn-sm btn-light text-success border rounded-2"
                                                            title="Mở khóa tài khoản">

                                                        <i class="bi bi-unlock"></i>

                                                    </button>

                                                </c:otherwise>

                                            </c:choose>

                                        </form>
                                    </div>
                                </c:otherwise>

                            </c:choose>

                            </td>
                            </tr>
                        </c:forEach>
                    </c:when>

                    <c:otherwise>
                        <tr>
                        <td colspan="8" class="text-center py-5">
                            <i class="bi bi-people fs-1 text-secondary"></i>

<script>
    const discountType = document.getElementById("discountType");
    const discountValue = document.getElementById("discountValue");
    const maxDiscountGroup = document.getElementById("maxDiscountGroup");

    function updateDiscountForm() {
        if (discountType.value === "PERCENT") {
            maxDiscountGroup.style.display = "block";
            discountValue.max = "100";
        } else {
            maxDiscountGroup.style.display = "none";
            discountValue.removeAttribute("max");
        }
    }

    discountType.addEventListener("change", updateDiscountForm);
    updateDiscountForm();
</script>

<script>

    document.addEventListener(
        "DOMContentLoaded",
        function () {

            const searchInput =
                document.getElementById(
                    "usageSearch"
                );


            const rows =
                document.querySelectorAll(
                    ".usage-row"
                );


            const searchEmpty =
                document.getElementById(
                    "searchEmpty"
                );


            if (!searchInput) {
                return;
            }


            searchInput.addEventListener(
                "input",
                function () {

                    const keyword =
                        this.value
                            .trim()
                            .toLowerCase();


                    let visibleCount = 0;


                    rows.forEach(
                        function (row) {

                            const text =
                                row.textContent
                                    .toLowerCase();


                            const matched =
                                text.includes(
                                    keyword
                                );


                            row.style.display =
                                matched
                                ? ""
                                : "none";


                            if (matched) {

                                visibleCount++;
                            }

                        }
                    );


                    if (searchEmpty) {

                        searchEmpty.style.display =
                            visibleCount === 0
                            ? "block"
                            : "none";
                    }

                }
            );

        }
    );

</script>
