<script>
    (function () {
        const slider = document.getElementById("homeSlider");
        if (!slider)
            return;

        const slides = slider.querySelectorAll(".slide");
        const dots = slider.querySelectorAll(".slider-dot");
        const prevButton = slider.querySelector(".prev");
        const nextButton = slider.querySelector(".next");

        let currentIndex = 0;
        let timer = null;

        function showSlide(index) {
            currentIndex = (index + slides.length) % slides.length;
            slides.forEach(function (slide, i) {
                slide.classList.toggle("active", i === currentIndex);
            });
            dots.forEach(function (dot, i) {
                dot.classList.toggle("active", i === currentIndex);
            });
        }

        function stopAutoPlay() {
            if (timer !== null) {
                clearInterval(timer);
                timer = null;
            }
        }

        function startAutoPlay() {
            stopAutoPlay();
            timer = setInterval(function () {
                showSlide(currentIndex + 1);
            }, 4000);
        }

        prevButton.addEventListener("click", function () {
            showSlide(currentIndex - 1);
            startAutoPlay();
        });

        nextButton.addEventListener("click", function () {
            showSlide(currentIndex + 1);
            startAutoPlay();
        });

        dots.forEach(function (dot, index) {
            dot.addEventListener("click", function () {
                showSlide(index);
                startAutoPlay();
            });
        });

        slider.addEventListener("mouseenter", stopAutoPlay);
        slider.addEventListener("mouseleave", startAutoPlay);

        showSlide(0);
        startAutoPlay();
    })();
</script>

<script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const togglePassword = document.getElementById('togglePassword');
        const password = document.getElementById('password');
        const toggleIcon = document.getElementById('toggleIcon');

        if (togglePassword && password && toggleIcon) {
            togglePassword.addEventListener('click', function () {
                const type = password.getAttribute('type') === 'password' ? 'text' : 'password';
                password.setAttribute('type', type);

                toggleIcon.classList.toggle('bi-eye');
                toggleIcon.classList.toggle('bi-eye-slash');
            });
        }
    });
</script>

<script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
        const pwdForm = document.getElementById('changePasswordForm');
        const newPassword = document.getElementById('newPassword');
        const confirmPassword = document.getElementById('confirmPassword');
        const pwdMismatchError = document.getElementById('pwdMismatchError');

        function validatePasswordMatch() {
            if (confirmPassword.value && newPassword.value !== confirmPassword.value) {
                pwdMismatchError.classList.remove('d-none');
                confirmPassword.setCustomValidity("Mật khẩu không trùng khớp");
            } else {
                pwdMismatchError.classList.add('d-none');
                confirmPassword.setCustomValidity("");
            }
        }

        newPassword.addEventListener('change', validatePasswordMatch);
        confirmPassword.addEventListener('keyup', validatePasswordMatch);

        pwdForm.addEventListener('submit', function (e) {
            validatePasswordMatch();
            if (!pwdForm.checkValidity()) {
                e.preventDefault();
                e.stopPropagation();
            }
        });

        <c:if test="${not empty pwdSuccess || not empty pwdError}">
            const pwdTabTrigger = new bootstrap.Tab(document.querySelector('#v-pills-password-tab'));
            pwdTabTrigger.show();
        </c:if>
    });
</script>

<script>
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {

        const toggleNewPassword =
                document.getElementById('toggleNewPassword');

        const newPassword =
                document.getElementById('newPassword');

        const newPasswordIcon =
                document.getElementById('newPasswordIcon');

        const toggleConfirmPassword =
                document.getElementById('toggleConfirmPassword');

        const confirmPassword =
                document.getElementById('confirmPassword');

        const confirmPasswordIcon =
                document.getElementById('confirmPasswordIcon');

        if (toggleNewPassword && newPassword && newPasswordIcon) {

            toggleNewPassword.addEventListener('click', function () {

                const type =
                        newPassword.getAttribute('type') === 'password'
                        ? 'text'
                        : 'password';

                newPassword.setAttribute('type', type);

                newPasswordIcon.classList.toggle('bi-eye');
                newPasswordIcon.classList.toggle('bi-eye-slash');
            });
        }

        if (toggleConfirmPassword
                && confirmPassword
                && confirmPasswordIcon) {

            toggleConfirmPassword.addEventListener('click', function () {

                const type =
                        confirmPassword.getAttribute('type') === 'password'
                        ? 'text'
                        : 'password';

                confirmPassword.setAttribute('type', type);

                confirmPasswordIcon.classList.toggle('bi-eye');
                confirmPasswordIcon.classList.toggle('bi-eye-slash');
            });
        }

    });
</script>

package controller;

import dao.AuditLogDAO;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import model.AuditLog;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;

@WebServlet(name = "AuditLogServlet",
        urlPatterns = {"/admin/audit-log"})
public class AuditLogServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private final AuditLogDAO auditLogDAO
            = new AuditLogDAO();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        String keyword
                = request.getParameter("keyword");

        String action
                = request.getParameter("action");

        String entityType
                = request.getParameter("entityType");

        List<AuditLog> logs
                = auditLogDAO.search(
                        keyword,
                        action,
                        entityType
                );

        request.setAttribute("auditLogs", logs);
        request.setAttribute("keyword", keyword);
        request.setAttribute("selectedAction", action);
        request.setAttribute("selectedEntityType", entityType);

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/admin/audit-log.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }
}

package controller;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.OutputStream;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;

@WebServlet(
        name = "BannerImageServlet",
        urlPatterns = {"/uploads/banners/*"}
)
public class BannerImageServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private Path getUploadDirectory() {
        return Paths.get(
                System.getProperty("user.home"),
                "OECS-uploads",
                "banners"
        ).toAbsolutePath().normalize();
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        String pathInfo = request.getPathInfo();

        if (pathInfo == null || pathInfo.length() < 2) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND);
            return;
        }

        String fileName = pathInfo.substring(1);

        if (fileName.contains("/")
                || fileName.contains("\\")
                || fileName.contains("..")) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST);
            return;
        }

        Path uploadDirectory = getUploadDirectory();
        Path imagePath = uploadDirectory.resolve(fileName)
                .normalize();

        if (!imagePath.startsWith(uploadDirectory)
                || !Files.isRegularFile(imagePath)) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND);
            return;
        }

        String extension = fileName.substring(
                fileName.lastIndexOf('.') + 1
        ).toLowerCase();

        String contentType;

        if (extension.equals("jpg") || extension.equals("jpeg")) {
            contentType = "image/jpeg";
        } else if (extension.equals("png")) {
            contentType = "image/png";
        } else if (extension.equals("gif")) {
            contentType = "image/gif";
        } else if (extension.equals("webp")) {
            contentType = "image/webp";
        } else {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND);
            return;
        }

        response.setContentType(contentType);
        response.setContentLengthLong(Files.size(imagePath));
        response.setHeader("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff");
        response.setHeader("Cache-Control", "no-cache");

        try (OutputStream output = response.getOutputStream()) {
            Files.copy(imagePath, output);
        }
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.BannerDAO;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.MultipartConfig;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.Part;
import model.Banner;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.InputStream;
import java.net.URI;
import java.nio.file.Files;
import java.nio.file.Path;
import java.nio.file.Paths;
import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Locale;
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

@WebServlet(name = "BannerServlet", urlPatterns = {"/staff/banner"})
@MultipartConfig(
        fileSizeThreshold = 1024 * 1024,
        maxFileSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024,
        maxRequestSize = 20 * 1024 * 1024
)
public class BannerServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private final BannerDAO bannerDAO = new BannerDAO();

    private static final Pattern ALT_TEXT_PATTERN = Pattern.compile(
            "^[\\p{L}\\p{M}\\p{N}\\s.,!?()'’:;-]*$"
    );

    private Path getUploadDirectory() throws IOException {
        Path uploadDirectory = Paths.get(
                System.getProperty("user.home"),
                "OECS-uploads",
                "banners"
        ).toAbsolutePath().normalize();

        Files.createDirectories(uploadDirectory);

        return uploadDirectory;
    }

    private void deleteOldImage(String imageUrl) {
        if (imageUrl == null || !imageUrl.startsWith("uploads/banners/")) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            Path uploadDirectory = getUploadDirectory();

            String fileName = Paths.get(imageUrl)
                    .getFileName()
                    .toString();

            Path oldImage = uploadDirectory.resolve(fileName).normalize();

            if (oldImage.startsWith(uploadDirectory)) {
                Files.deleteIfExists(oldImage);
            }
        } catch (IOException e) {
            log("Cannot delete old banner image", e);
        }
    }

    private boolean isValidAltText(String altText) {
        if (altText == null) {
            return true;
        }

        altText = altText.trim();

        return altText.length() <= 255
                && ALT_TEXT_PATTERN.matcher(altText).matches();
    }

    private boolean isValidTargetUrl(String targetUrl) {
        if (targetUrl == null || targetUrl.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return true;
        }

        targetUrl = targetUrl.trim();

        if (targetUrl.length() > 2048
                || targetUrl.startsWith("//")
                || targetUrl.contains("\\")
                || targetUrl.matches("(?i).*%(0[0-9a-f]|1[0-9a-f]|7f).*")) {
            return false;
        }

        if (targetUrl.chars().anyMatch(
                c -> Character.isWhitespace(c)
                || Character.isISOControl(c))) {
            return false;
        }

        try {
            URI uri = URI.create(targetUrl);

            if (targetUrl.startsWith("/")) {
                return !uri.isAbsolute()
                        && uri.getRawAuthority() == null
                        && uri.getRawPath() != null
                        && uri.getRawPath().startsWith("/");
            }

            return "https".equalsIgnoreCase(uri.getScheme())
                    && uri.getHost() != null
                    && !uri.getHost().isEmpty()
                    && uri.getUserInfo() == null;

        } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
            return false;
        }
    }

    private void redirectError(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            String error
    ) throws IOException {

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath()
                + "/staff/banner?error="
                + error
        );
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        if ("edit".equals(action)) {
            try {
                int bannerId = Integer.parseInt(
                        request.getParameter("id")
                );

                if (bannerId <= 0) {
                    throw new NumberFormatException();
                }

                Banner banner = bannerDAO.getById(bannerId);

                if (banner == null) {
                    response.sendError(
                            HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND,
                            "Không tìm thấy banner."
                    );
                    return;
                }

                request.setAttribute("banner", banner);

                request.getRequestDispatcher(
                        "/WEB-INF/banner/edit.jsp"
                ).forward(request, response);

                return;

            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                        "ID banner không hợp lệ."
                );
                return;
            }
        }

        if ("delete".equals(action)) {
            String idValue = request.getParameter("id");

            try {
                int bannerId = Integer.parseInt(idValue);

                if (bannerId <= 0) {
                    throw new NumberFormatException();
                }

                bannerDAO.delete(bannerId);

            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                        "ID banner không hợp lệ."
                );
                return;
            }

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/staff/banner"
            );
            return;
        }

        if ("toggle".equals(action)) {
            String idValue = request.getParameter("id");

            try {
                int bannerId = Integer.parseInt(idValue);

                if (bannerId <= 0) {
                    throw new NumberFormatException();
                }

                boolean active = "1".equals(
                        request.getParameter("active")
                );

                bannerDAO.updateActive(bannerId, active);

            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                        "ID banner không hợp lệ."
                );
                return;
            }

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/staff/banner"
            );
            return;
        }

        List<Banner> banners = bannerDAO.getAll();
        request.setAttribute("banners", banners);

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/banner/list.jsp"
        ).forward(request, response);
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        if ("update".equals(action)) {
            updateBanner(request, response);
            return;
        }

        String altText = request.getParameter("altText");
        String targetUrl = request.getParameter("targetUrl");
        String orderValue = request.getParameter("displayOrder");

        if (!isValidAltText(altText)) {
            redirectError(request, response, "invalidAlt");
            return;
        }

        if (!isValidTargetUrl(targetUrl)) {
            redirectError(request, response, "invalidUrl");
            return;
        }

        int displayOrder = 0;

        try {
            if (orderValue == null
                    || orderValue.trim().isEmpty()) {
                redirectError(request, response, "invalidOrder");
                return;
            }

            displayOrder = Integer.parseInt(orderValue.trim());

            if (displayOrder < 0) {
                redirectError(request, response, "invalidOrder");
                return;
            }

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            redirectError(request, response, "invalidOrder");
            return;
        }

        Part imagePart = request.getPart("imageFile");

        if (imagePart == null || imagePart.getSize() == 0) {
            redirectError(request, response, "upload");
            return;
        }

        String contentType = imagePart.getContentType();

        if (contentType == null
                || !(contentType.equals("image/jpeg")
                || contentType.equals("image/png")
                || contentType.equals("image/gif")
                || contentType.equals("image/webp"))) {

            redirectError(request, response, "upload");
            return;
        }

        String originalName = imagePart.getSubmittedFileName();

        if (originalName == null || originalName.trim().isEmpty()) {
            redirectError(request, response, "upload");
            return;
        }

        originalName = Paths.get(originalName)
                .getFileName()
                .toString();

        int dotIndex = originalName.lastIndexOf('.');

        if (dotIndex < 0) {
            redirectError(request, response, "upload");
            return;
        }

        String extension = originalName.substring(dotIndex)
                .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

        if (!(extension.equals(".jpg")
                || extension.equals(".jpeg")
                || extension.equals(".png")
                || extension.equals(".gif")
                || extension.equals(".webp"))) {

            redirectError(request, response, "upload");
            return;
        }

        String fileName = UUID.randomUUID() + extension;

        Path uploadDirectory = getUploadDirectory();

        Path destination = uploadDirectory.resolve(fileName)
                .normalize();

        if (!destination.startsWith(uploadDirectory)) {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                    "Đường dẫn file không hợp lệ."
            );
            return;
        }

        try (InputStream input = imagePart.getInputStream()) {
            Files.copy(
                    input,
                    destination,
                    StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING
            );
        }

        Banner banner = new Banner();

        banner.setImageUrl("uploads/banners/" + fileName);
        banner.setAltText(
                altText == null || altText.trim().isEmpty()
                ? null : altText.trim()
        );
        banner.setTargetUrl(
                targetUrl == null || targetUrl.trim().isEmpty()
                ? null : targetUrl.trim()
        );
        banner.setActive(true);
        banner.setDisplayOrder(displayOrder);

        if (!bannerDAO.insert(banner)) {
            Files.deleteIfExists(destination);

            redirectError(request, response, "database");
            return;
        }

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath() + "/staff/banner?success=create"
        );
    }

    private void updateBanner(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response
    ) throws ServletException, IOException {

        int bannerId;

        try {
            bannerId = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("bannerId"));

            if (bannerId <= 0) {
                throw new NumberFormatException();
            }
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                    "ID banner không hợp lệ."
            );
            return;
        }

        Banner oldBanner = bannerDAO.getById(bannerId);

        if (oldBanner == null) {
            response.sendError(
                    HttpServletResponse.SC_NOT_FOUND,
                    "Không tìm thấy banner."
            );
            return;
        }

        String altText = request.getParameter("altText");
        String targetUrl = request.getParameter("targetUrl");
        String orderValue = request.getParameter("displayOrder");

        if (!isValidAltText(altText)) {
            redirectError(request, response, "invalidAlt");
            return;
        }

        if (!isValidTargetUrl(targetUrl)) {
            redirectError(request, response, "invalidUrl");
            return;
        }

        int displayOrder;

        try {
            if (orderValue == null || orderValue.trim().isEmpty()) {
                redirectError(request, response, "invalidOrder");
                return;
            }

            displayOrder = Integer.parseInt(orderValue.trim());

            if (displayOrder < 0) {
                redirectError(request, response, "invalidOrder");
                return;
            }
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            redirectError(request, response, "invalidOrder");
            return;
        }

        Part imagePart = request.getPart("imageFile");

        String imageUrl = oldBanner.getImageUrl();
        Path newImagePath = null;

        if (imagePart != null && imagePart.getSize() > 0) {

            String contentType = imagePart.getContentType();

            if (contentType == null
                    || !(contentType.equals("image/jpeg")
                    || contentType.equals("image/png")
                    || contentType.equals("image/gif")
                    || contentType.equals("image/webp"))) {

                redirectError(request, response, "upload");
                return;
            }

            String originalName = imagePart.getSubmittedFileName();

            if (originalName == null || originalName.trim().isEmpty()) {
                redirectError(request, response, "upload");
                return;
            }

            originalName = Paths.get(originalName)
                    .getFileName()
                    .toString();

            int dotIndex = originalName.lastIndexOf('.');

            if (dotIndex < 0) {
                redirectError(request, response, "upload");
                return;
            }

            String extension = originalName.substring(dotIndex)
                    .toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);

            if (!(extension.equals(".jpg")
                    || extension.equals(".jpeg")
                    || extension.equals(".png")
                    || extension.equals(".gif")
                    || extension.equals(".webp"))) {

                redirectError(request, response, "upload");
                return;
            }

            String fileName = UUID.randomUUID() + extension;

            Path uploadDirectory = getUploadDirectory();

            newImagePath = uploadDirectory.resolve(fileName).normalize();

            if (!newImagePath.startsWith(uploadDirectory)) {
                response.sendError(
                        HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                        "Đường dẫn file không hợp lệ."
                );
                return;
            }

            try (InputStream input = imagePart.getInputStream()) {
                Files.copy(
                        input,
                        newImagePath,
                        StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING
                );
            }

            imageUrl = "uploads/banners/" + fileName;
        }

        Banner banner = new Banner();

        banner.setBannerId(bannerId);
        banner.setImageUrl(imageUrl);
        banner.setAltText(
                altText == null || altText.trim().isEmpty()
                ? null : altText.trim()
        );
        banner.setTargetUrl(
                targetUrl == null || targetUrl.trim().isEmpty()
                ? null : targetUrl.trim()
        );

        banner.setActive(oldBanner.isActive());

        banner.setDisplayOrder(displayOrder);

        if (!bannerDAO.update(banner)) {
            if (newImagePath != null) {
                Files.deleteIfExists(newImagePath);
            }

            redirectError(request, response, "database");
            return;
        }

        if (newImagePath != null) {
            deleteOldImage(oldBanner.getImageUrl());
        }

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath() + "/staff/banner?success=update"
        );
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.BrandDAO;
import model.Brand;
import service.AuditLogService;
import model.User;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(name = "BrandServlet", urlPatterns = {"/brand"})
public class BrandServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(BrandServlet.class.getName());

    private final AuditLogService auditLogService
            = new AuditLogService();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        String view = request.getParameter("view");
        BrandDAO dao = new BrandDAO();
        String contextPath = request.getContextPath();

        if (view == null || view.equals("list")) {

            final int pageSize = 10;

            String keyword = request.getParameter("keyword");
            keyword = keyword == null ? "" : keyword.trim();

            int page = 1;

            try {
                String pageText = request.getParameter("page");

                if (pageText != null) {
                    page = Integer.parseInt(pageText);
                }

                if (page < 1) {
                    page = 1;
                }
            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                page = 1;
            }

            int totalBrands;

            if (keyword.isEmpty()) {
                totalBrands = dao.countBrands();
            } else {
                totalBrands = dao.countSearchResults(keyword);
            }

            int totalPages = Math.max(
                    1,
                    (int) Math.ceil((double) totalBrands / pageSize)
            );

            if (page > totalPages) {
                page = totalPages;
            }

            List<Brand> brandList;

            if (keyword.isEmpty()) {
                brandList = dao.getListByPage(page, pageSize);
            } else {
                brandList = dao.searchByNameAndPage(
                        keyword, page, pageSize
                );
            }

            Map<Integer, Integer> productCounts
                    = dao.getProductCounts(brandList);

            int startItem = totalBrands == 0
                    ? 0
                    : (page - 1) * pageSize + 1;

            int endItem = Math.min(page * pageSize, totalBrands);

            request.setAttribute("brandList", brandList);
            request.setAttribute("keyword", keyword);
            request.setAttribute("productCounts", productCounts);
            request.setAttribute("currentPage", page);
            request.setAttribute("totalPages", totalPages);
            request.setAttribute("totalBrands", totalBrands);
            request.setAttribute("startItem", startItem);
            request.setAttribute("endItem", endItem);

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/brand/list.jsp")
                    .forward(request, response);

        } else if ("create".equals(view)) {

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/brand/create.jsp")
                    .forward(request, response);

        } else if ("edit".equals(view)) {

            try {
                int id = Integer.parseInt(
                        request.getParameter("id")
                );

                if (id <= 0) {
                    throw new NumberFormatException();
                }

                Brand selectedBrand = dao.getById(id);

                if (selectedBrand == null) {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=list&error=notFound");
                    return;
                }

                request.setAttribute("brand", selectedBrand);

                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/brand/edit.jsp")
                        .forward(request, response);

            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.WARNING,
                        "Invalid ID when opening Edit Brand",
                        e
                );

                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=list&error=invalidId");
            }

        } else if ("delete".equals(view)) {

            try {
                int id = Integer.parseInt(
                        request.getParameter("id")
                );

                if (id <= 0) {
                    throw new NumberFormatException();
                }

                Brand selectedBrand = dao.getById(id);

                if (selectedBrand == null) {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=list&error=notFound");
                    return;
                }

                int productCount = dao.countProductsByBrandId(id);

                request.setAttribute("brand", selectedBrand);
                request.setAttribute("productCount", productCount);

                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/brand/delete.jsp")
                        .forward(request, response);

            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.WARNING,
                        "Invalid ID when opening Delete Brand",
                        e
                );

                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=list&error=invalidId");

            } catch (Exception e) {
                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Cannot open Delete Brand page",
                        e
                );

                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=list&error=server");
            }

        } else {
            response.sendRedirect(contextPath + "/brand?view=list");
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        String action = request.getParameter("action");
        BrandDAO dao = new BrandDAO();
        String contextPath = request.getContextPath();

        if ("create".equals(action)) {

            String name = request.getParameter("name");
            String logoUrl = request.getParameter("logoUrl");

            name = name == null ? "" : name.trim();
            logoUrl = logoUrl == null ? "" : logoUrl.trim();

            if (name.isEmpty()) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=create&error=empty");
                return;
            }

            if (name.length() > 100) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=create&error=length");
                return;
            }

            if (!isValidBrandName(name)) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=create&error=special");
                return;
            }

            if (logoUrl.isEmpty()) {
                logoUrl = null;
            } else if (logoUrl.length() > 2048
                    || !logoUrl.matches("(?i)^https?://.+")) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=create&error=logo");
                return;
            }

            try {
                if (dao.isNameExists(name, 0)) {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=create&error=duplicate");
                    return;
                }

                Brand brand = new Brand(0, name, logoUrl);
                int result = dao.insert(brand);

                if (result == 1) {
                    User loggedInUser
                            = (User) request.getSession()
                                    .getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                    auditLogService.log(
                            loggedInUser,
                            "CREATE_BRAND",
                            "BRAND",
                            null,
                            "Created brand: " + name,
                            request
                    );

                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=list&success=create");
                } else {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=create&error=save");
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot create brand", e);

                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=create&error=server");
            }

        } else if ("edit".equals(action)) {

            String idText = request.getParameter("id");
            String name = request.getParameter("name");
            String logoUrl = request.getParameter("logoUrl");

            name = name == null ? "" : name.trim();
            logoUrl = logoUrl == null ? "" : logoUrl.trim();

            int id;

            try {
                id = Integer.parseInt(idText);

                if (id <= 0) {
                    throw new NumberFormatException();
                }
            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=list&error=invalidId");
                return;
            }

            if (name.isEmpty()) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=edit&id=" + id + "&error=empty");
                return;
            }

            if (name.length() > 100) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=edit&id=" + id + "&error=length");
                return;
            }

            if (!isValidBrandName(name)) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=edit&id=" + id + "&error=special");
                return;
            }

            if (logoUrl.isEmpty()) {
                logoUrl = null;
            } else if (logoUrl.length() > 2048
                    || !logoUrl.matches("(?i)^https?://.+")) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=edit&id=" + id + "&error=logo");
                return;
            }

            try {
                Brand existing = dao.getById(id);

                if (existing == null) {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=list&error=notFound");
                    return;
                }

                if (dao.isNameExists(name, id)) {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=edit&id=" + id
                            + "&error=duplicate");
                    return;
                }

                Brand brand = new Brand(id, name, logoUrl);
                int result = dao.edit(brand);

                if (result == 1) {
                    User loggedInUser
                            = (User) request.getSession()
                                    .getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                    auditLogService.log(
                            loggedInUser,
                            "UPDATE_BRAND",
                            "BRAND",
                            null,
                            "Updated brand: " + name,
                            request
                    );

                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=list&success=edit");
                } else {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=edit&id=" + id
                            + "&error=save");
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot edit brand", e);

                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=edit&id=" + id
                        + "&error=server");
            }

        } else if ("delete".equals(action)) {

            String idText = request.getParameter("id");
            int id;

            try {
                id = Integer.parseInt(idText);

                if (id <= 0) {
                    throw new NumberFormatException();
                }
            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=list&error=invalidId");
                return;
            }

            try {
                Brand existing = dao.getById(id);

                if (existing == null) {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=list&error=notFound");
                    return;
                }

                int productCount = dao.countProductsByBrandId(id);

                if (productCount > 0) {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=delete&id=" + id
                            + "&error=hasProducts");
                    return;
                }

                int result = dao.delete(existing);

                if (result == 1) {

                    User loggedInUser
                            = (User) request.getSession()
                                    .getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                    auditLogService.log(
                            loggedInUser,
                            "DELETE_BRAND",
                            "BRAND",
                            null,
                            "Deleted brand: " + existing.getBrandName(),
                            request
                    );

                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=list&success=delete");
                } else {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/brand?view=delete&id=" + id
                            + "&error=delete");
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE, "Cannot delete brand", e);

                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/brand?view=delete&id=" + id
                        + "&error=server");
            }

        } else {
            response.sendRedirect(contextPath + "/brand?view=list");
        }
    }

    private boolean isValidBrandName(String name) {
        return name != null
                && name.matches("^[\\p{L}\\p{M}\\p{N} ]+$");
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.CartDAO;
import dao.VoucherDAO;

import model.CartItem;
import model.User;
import model.Voucher;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;

import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.io.IOException;

import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

@WebServlet(
        name = "CartServlet",
        urlPatterns = {"/cart"}
)
public class CartServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private final CartDAO cartDAO
            = new CartDAO();

    private final VoucherDAO voucherDAO
            = new VoucherDAO();


    
    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        User user
                = getLoggedInUser(request);

        if (user == null) {

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath()
                    + "/login"
            );

            return;
        }


      
        String action
                = request.getParameter(
                        "action"
                );


        if ("remove".equals(action)) {

            removeItem(
                    request,
                    response,
                    user
            );

            return;
        }


        if ("clear".equals(action)) {

            clearCart(
                    request,
                    response,
                    user
            );

            return;
        }


        showCart(
                request,
                response,
                user
        );
    }


   
    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding(
                "UTF-8"
        );

        User user
                = getLoggedInUser(request);


        if (user == null) {

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath()
                    + "/login"
            );

            return;
        }


        String action
                = request.getParameter(
                        "action"
                );


        if ("add".equals(action)) {

            addItem(
                    request,
                    response,
                    user
            );

        } else if ("update".equals(action)) {

            updateItem(
                    request,
                    response,
                    user
            );

        } else if ("remove".equals(action)) {

            removeItem(
                    request,
                    response,
                    user
            );

        } else if ("clear".equals(action)) {

            clearCart(
                    request,
                    response,
                    user
            );

        } else if ("applyVoucher".equals(action)) {

            applyVoucher(
                    request,
                    response,
                    user
            );

        } else if ("removeVoucher".equals(action)) {

            removeVoucher(
                    request,
                    response,
                    user
            );

        } else {

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath()
                    + "/cart"
            );
        }
    }


    
    private void showCart(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        HttpSession session
                = request.getSession();


        int cartId
                = cartDAO.getCartIdByUserId(
                        user.getUserId()
                );


        List<CartItem> cartItems
                = new ArrayList<>();


        if (cartId > 0) {

            cartItems
                    = cartDAO.getCartItems(
                            cartId
                    );
        }


        double total = 0;

        if (cartId > 0) {

            total
                    = cartDAO.getCartTotal(
                            cartId
                    );
        }


        

        List<Integer> selectedIds
                = getSelectedIdsFromSession(
                        session
                );


        selectedIds
                = sanitizeSelectedIds(
                        cartItems,
                        selectedIds
                );


        
        if (selectedIds.isEmpty()
                && !cartItems.isEmpty()) {

            for (CartItem item : cartItems) {

                if (item.getStockQuantity() > 0) {

                    selectedIds.add(
                            item.getCartItemId()
                    );
                }
            }
        }


        session.setAttribute(
                "checkoutSelectedItemIds",
                selectedIds
        );


        

        double selectedTotal = 0;


        if (cartId > 0
                && !selectedIds.isEmpty()) {

            selectedTotal
                    = cartDAO.getCartTotalByIds(
                            cartId,
                            selectedIds
                    );
        }


        

        List<Voucher> availableVouchers
                = voucherDAO
                        .getAvailableVouchers(
                                selectedTotal,
                                user.getUserId()
                        );


        

        Voucher appliedVoucher
                = (Voucher)
                        session.getAttribute(
                                "appliedVoucher"
                        );


        double discount = 0;


        if (appliedVoucher != null) {

            Voucher valid
                    = voucherDAO.getValidVoucher(
                            appliedVoucher.getCode(),
                            selectedTotal,
                            user.getUserId()
                    );


            if (valid == null) {

                session.removeAttribute(
                        "appliedVoucher"
                );

                appliedVoucher = null;

            } else {

                appliedVoucher
                        = valid;


                session.setAttribute(
                        "appliedVoucher",
                        valid
                );


                discount
                        = voucherDAO
                                .calculateDiscount(
                                        valid,
                                        selectedTotal
                                );
            }
        }


        double finalSelectedTotal
                = Math.max(
                        0,
                        selectedTotal
                        - discount
                );



        request.setAttribute(
                "cartItems",
                cartItems
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "total",
                total
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "selectedItemIds",
                selectedIds
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "selectedTotal",
                selectedTotal
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "availableVouchers",
                availableVouchers
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "voucher",
                appliedVoucher
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "appliedVoucher",
                appliedVoucher
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "discount",
                discount
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "finalTotal",
                finalSelectedTotal
        );


        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/cart/cart.jsp"
        ).forward(
                request,
                response
        );
    }


    
    private void addItem(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user)
            throws IOException {

        HttpSession session
                = request.getSession();


        int skuId
                = parsePositiveInt(
                        request.getParameter(
                                "skuId"
                        )
                );


        int quantity
                = parsePositiveInt(
                        request.getParameter(
                                "quantity"
                        )
                );


        if (quantity <= 0) {
            quantity = 1;
        }


        if (skuId <= 0) {

            session.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Sản phẩm không hợp lệ."
            );

            redirectCart(
                    request,
                    response
            );

            return;
        }


        int cartId
                = cartDAO.getOrCreateCart(
                        user.getUserId()
                );


        boolean success
                = cartDAO.addToCart(
                        cartId,
                        skuId,
                        quantity
                );


        if (success) {

            session.setAttribute(
                    "successMessage",
                    "Đã thêm sản phẩm vào giỏ hàng."
            );

            
            session.removeAttribute(
                    "checkoutSelectedItemIds"
            );

        } else {

            session.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Không thể thêm sản phẩm. "
                    + "Vui lòng kiểm tra số lượng tồn kho."
            );
        }


        redirectCart(
                request,
                response
        );
    }



    private void updateItem(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user)
            throws IOException {

        HttpSession session
                = request.getSession();


        int cartId
                = cartDAO.getCartIdByUserId(
                        user.getUserId()
                );


        int cartItemId
                = parsePositiveInt(
                        request.getParameter(
                                "cartItemId"
                        )
                );


        int quantity
                = parsePositiveInt(
                        request.getParameter(
                                "quantity"
                        )
                );


        if (cartId <= 0
                || cartItemId <= 0
                || quantity <= 0) {

            session.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Thông tin cập nhật không hợp lệ."
            );

            redirectCart(
                    request,
                    response
            );

            return;
        }


        boolean success
                = cartDAO.updateQuantity(
                        cartItemId,
                        cartId,
                        quantity
                );


        if (success) {

            session.setAttribute(
                    "successMessage",
                    "Đã cập nhật số lượng."
            );

        } else {

            session.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Không thể cập nhật số lượng. "
                    + "Có thể số lượng vượt quá tồn kho."
            );
        }


        redirectCart(
                request,
                response
        );
    }


   
    private void removeItem(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user)
            throws IOException {

        HttpSession session
                = request.getSession();


        int cartId
                = cartDAO.getCartIdByUserId(
                        user.getUserId()
                );


        int cartItemId
                = parsePositiveInt(
                        request.getParameter(
                                "cartItemId"
                        )
                );


        if (cartId <= 0
                || cartItemId <= 0) {

            session.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Sản phẩm không hợp lệ."
            );

            redirectCart(
                    request,
                    response
            );

            return;
        }


        boolean success
                = cartDAO.deleteCartItem(
                        cartItemId,
                        cartId
                );


        if (success) {

            removeSelectedId(
                    session,
                    cartItemId
            );

            session.setAttribute(
                    "successMessage",
                    "Đã xóa sản phẩm khỏi giỏ hàng."
            );

        } else {

            session.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Không thể xóa sản phẩm."
            );
        }


        redirectCart(
                request,
                response
        );
    }


   
    private void clearCart(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user)
            throws IOException {

        HttpSession session
                = request.getSession();


        int cartId
                = cartDAO.getCartIdByUserId(
                        user.getUserId()
                );


        if (cartId > 0) {

            cartDAO.clearCart(
                    cartId
            );
        }


        session.removeAttribute(
                "checkoutSelectedItemIds"
        );

        session.removeAttribute(
                "appliedVoucher"
        );


        session.setAttribute(
                "successMessage",
                "Đã xóa toàn bộ giỏ hàng."
        );


        redirectCart(
                request,
                response
        );
    }


    
    private void applyVoucher(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user)
            throws IOException {

        HttpSession session
                = request.getSession();


        String code
                = request.getParameter(
                        "voucherCode"
                );


        List<Integer> selectedIds
                = parseSelectedIds(
                        request.getParameterValues(
                                "selectedItems"
                        )
                );


        if (selectedIds.isEmpty()) {

            session.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Vui lòng chọn ít nhất một sản phẩm."
            );

            redirectCart(
                    request,
                    response
            );

            return;
        }


        int cartId
                = cartDAO.getCartIdByUserId(
                        user.getUserId()
                );


        if (cartId <= 0) {

            redirectCart(
                    request,
                    response
            );

            return;
        }


        List<CartItem> selectedItems
                = cartDAO.getCartItemsByIds(
                        cartId,
                        selectedIds
                );


        if (selectedItems.size()
                != selectedIds.size()) {

            session.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Danh sách sản phẩm được chọn không hợp lệ."
            );

            redirectCart(
                    request,
                    response
            );

            return;
        }


        double subtotal
                = calculateSubtotal(
                        selectedItems
                );


        Voucher voucher
                = voucherDAO.getValidVoucher(
                        code,
                        subtotal,
                        user.getUserId()
                );


        if (voucher == null) {

            session.removeAttribute(
                    "appliedVoucher"
            );

            session.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Voucher không khả dụng cho các sản phẩm đã chọn."
            );

        } else {

            session.setAttribute(
                    "checkoutSelectedItemIds",
                    selectedIds
            );


            session.setAttribute(
                    "appliedVoucher",
                    voucher
            );


            session.setAttribute(
                    "successMessage",
                    "Đã áp dụng Voucher "
                    + voucher.getCode()
                    + "."
            );
        }


        redirectCart(
                request,
                response
        );
    }


  
    private void removeVoucher(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user)
            throws IOException {

        HttpSession session
                = request.getSession();


        List<Integer> selectedIds
                = parseSelectedIds(
                        request.getParameterValues(
                                "selectedItems"
                        )
                );


        if (!selectedIds.isEmpty()) {

            int cartId
                    = cartDAO.getCartIdByUserId(
                            user.getUserId()
                    );


            if (cartId > 0) {

                List<CartItem> items
                        = cartDAO.getCartItemsByIds(
                                cartId,
                                selectedIds
                        );


                if (items.size()
                        == selectedIds.size()) {

                    session.setAttribute(
                            "checkoutSelectedItemIds",
                            selectedIds
                    );
                }
            }
        }


        session.removeAttribute(
                "appliedVoucher"
        );


        session.setAttribute(
                "successMessage",
                "Đã gỡ Voucher."
        );


        redirectCart(
                request,
                response
        );
    }


    
    private List<Integer> sanitizeSelectedIds(
            List<CartItem> cartItems,
            List<Integer> selectedIds) {

        List<Integer> result
                = new ArrayList<>();


        if (selectedIds == null) {

            return result;
        }


        for (CartItem item : cartItems) {

            if (item.getStockQuantity() > 0
                    && selectedIds.contains(
                            item.getCartItemId()
                    )) {

                result.add(
                        item.getCartItemId()
                );
            }
        }


        return result;
    }



    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    private List<Integer> getSelectedIdsFromSession(
            HttpSession session) {

        Object value
                = session.getAttribute(
                        "checkoutSelectedItemIds"
                );


        if (value instanceof List<?>) {

            return new ArrayList<>(
                    (List<Integer>) value
            );
        }


        return new ArrayList<>();
    }


   
    private void removeSelectedId(
            HttpSession session,
            int cartItemId) {

        List<Integer> selectedIds
                = getSelectedIdsFromSession(
                        session
                );


        selectedIds.remove(
                Integer.valueOf(
                        cartItemId
                )
        );


        session.setAttribute(
                "checkoutSelectedItemIds",
                selectedIds
        );
    }


    
    private List<Integer> parseSelectedIds(
            String[] values) {

        List<Integer> ids
                = new ArrayList<>();


        if (values == null) {
            return ids;
        }


        for (String value : values) {

            int id
                    = parsePositiveInt(
                            value
                    );


            if (id > 0
                    && !ids.contains(id)) {

                ids.add(id);
            }
        }


        return ids;
    }


  
    private double calculateSubtotal(
            List<CartItem> items) {

        double total = 0;


        for (CartItem item : items) {

            total
                    += item.getPrice()
                    * item.getQuantity();
        }


        return total;
    }


   
    private User getLoggedInUser(
            HttpServletRequest request) {

        HttpSession session
                = request.getSession(false);


        if (session == null) {
            return null;
        }


        Object value
                = session.getAttribute(
                        "loggedInUser"
                );


        return value instanceof User
                ? (User) value
                : null;
    }


  
    private int parsePositiveInt(
            String value) {

        try {

            int result
                    = Integer.parseInt(
                            value
                    );

            return result > 0
                    ? result
                    : -1;

        } catch (Exception e) {

            return -1;
        }
    }


    private void redirectCart(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath()
                + "/cart"
        );
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.CategoryDAO;
import model.Category;
import model.User;
import service.AuditLogService;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(name = "CategoryServlet", urlPatterns = {"/category"})
public class CategoryServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(CategoryServlet.class.getName());

    private final AuditLogService auditLogService
            = new AuditLogService();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        String view = request.getParameter("view");
        CategoryDAO dao = new CategoryDAO();

        if (view == null || view.equals("list")) {

            String keyword = request.getParameter("keyword");
            keyword = keyword == null ? "" : keyword.trim();

            List<Category> allCategories = dao.getList();
            Map<Integer, Integer> categoryDepths = new HashMap<>();

            List<Category> treeList = buildCategoryTree(
                    allCategories, categoryDepths
            );

            Set<Integer> matchedIds = new HashSet<>();

            if (keyword.isEmpty()) {
                for (Category category : treeList) {
                    matchedIds.add(category.getCategoryId());
                }
            } else {
                String searchKeyword = keyword.toLowerCase();

                for (Category category : treeList) {
                    String name = category.getCategoryName();

                    if (name != null
                            && name.toLowerCase().contains(searchKeyword)) {

                        matchedIds.add(category.getCategoryId());

                        Integer parentId = category.getParentId();
                        Set<Integer> visitedParents = new HashSet<>();

                        while (parentId != null
                                && visitedParents.add(parentId)) {

                            matchedIds.add(parentId);

                            Category parent = null;

                            for (Category item : allCategories) {
                                if (item.getCategoryId() == parentId) {
                                    parent = item;
                                    break;
                                }
                            }

                            if (parent == null) {
                                break;
                            }

                            parentId = parent.getParentId();
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            List<Category> categoryList = new ArrayList<>();

            for (Category category : treeList) {
                if (matchedIds.contains(category.getCategoryId())) {
                    categoryList.add(category);
                }
            }

            int totalCategories = categoryList.size();

            Map<Integer, Integer> productCounts
                    = dao.getProductCounts(categoryList);

            Map<Integer, Integer> childCounts
                    = dao.getChildCounts(categoryList);

            Map<Integer, String> categoryNames
                    = dao.getCategoryNames();

            request.setAttribute("categoryList", categoryList);
            request.setAttribute("categoryDepths", categoryDepths);
            request.setAttribute("keyword", keyword);
            request.setAttribute("productCounts", productCounts);
            request.setAttribute("childCounts", childCounts);
            request.setAttribute("categoryNames", categoryNames);
            request.setAttribute("totalCategories", totalCategories);

            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/category/list.jsp"
            ).forward(request, response);

        } else if ("create".equals(view)) {

            request.setAttribute("categoryList", dao.getList());

            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/category/create.jsp"
            ).forward(request, response);

        } else if ("edit".equals(view)) {

            try {
                int id = Integer.parseInt(
                        request.getParameter("id")
                );

                Category category = dao.getById(id);

                if (category == null) {
                    response.sendRedirect(
                            request.getContextPath()
                            + "/category?view=list"
                    );
                    return;
                }

                request.setAttribute("category", category);
                request.setAttribute("categoryList", dao.getList());

                request.getRequestDispatcher(
                        "/WEB-INF/category/edit.jsp"
                ).forward(request, response);

            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath()
                        + "/category?view=list"
                );
            }

        } else if ("delete".equals(view)) {

            try {
                int id = Integer.parseInt(
                        request.getParameter("id")
                );

                if (id <= 0) {
                    throw new NumberFormatException();
                }

                Category category = dao.getById(id);

                if (category == null) {
                    response.sendRedirect(
                            request.getContextPath()
                            + "/category?view=list&error=notFound"
                    );
                    return;
                }

                int productCount
                        = dao.countProductsByCategoryId(id);

                int childCount
                        = dao.countChildCategories(id);

                request.setAttribute("category", category);
                request.setAttribute("productCount", productCount);
                request.setAttribute("childCount", childCount);

                request.getRequestDispatcher(
                        "/WEB-INF/category/delete.jsp"
                ).forward(request, response);

            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.WARNING,
                        "Invalid ID when opening Delete Category",
                        e
                );

                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath()
                        + "/category?view=list&error=invalidId"
                );
            }

        } else {
            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath()
                    + "/category?view=list"
            );
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        String action = request.getParameter("action");
        CategoryDAO dao = new CategoryDAO();
        String contextPath = request.getContextPath();

        if ("create".equals(action)) {

            try {
                String name = request.getParameter("name");
                String parentIdText
                        = request.getParameter("parentId");

                if (name == null || name.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    forwardCreateWithError(
                            request, response, dao,
                            "Vui lòng nhập tên danh mục.",
                            name
                    );
                    return;
                }

                name = name.trim();

                if (!isValidCategoryName(name)) {
                    forwardCreateWithError(
                            request, response, dao,
                            "Tên danh mục chỉ được chứa chữ cái, chữ số và khoảng trắng.",
                            name
                    );
                    return;
                }

                if (dao.isCategoryNameExists(name)) {
                    forwardCreateWithError(
                            request, response, dao,
                            "Tên danh mục đã tồn tại. Vui lòng nhập tên khác.",
                            name
                    );
                    return;
                }

                Integer parentId = null;

                if (parentIdText != null
                        && !parentIdText.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    parentId = Integer.parseInt(parentIdText);
                }

                if (parentId != null
                        && dao.getById(parentId) == null) {

                    forwardCreateWithError(
                            request, response, dao,
                            "Danh mục cha không tồn tại.",
                            name
                    );
                    return;
                }

                Category category = new Category(
                        0, name, parentId
                );

                int result = dao.insert(category);

                if (result > 0) {

                    User loggedInUser
                            = (User) request.getSession()
                                    .getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                    auditLogService.log(
                            loggedInUser,
                            "CREATE_CATEGORY",
                            "CATEGORY",
                            null,
                            "Created category: " + name,
                            request
                    );

                    response.sendRedirect(
                            contextPath + "/category?view=list"
                    );
                } else {
                    forwardCreateWithError(
                            request, response, dao,
                            "Không thể thêm danh mục. Vui lòng thử lại.",
                            name
                    );
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Cannot create category",
                        e
                );

                forwardCreateWithError(
                        request, response, dao,
                        "Đã xảy ra lỗi khi thêm danh mục.",
                        request.getParameter("name")
                );
            }

        } else if ("edit".equals(action)) {

            int id = 0;

            try {
                id = Integer.parseInt(
                        request.getParameter("id")
                );

                String name = request.getParameter("name");
                String parentIdText
                        = request.getParameter("parentId");

                Category currentCategory = dao.getById(id);

                if (currentCategory == null) {
                    response.sendRedirect(
                            contextPath + "/category?view=list"
                    );
                    return;
                }

                if (name == null || name.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    forwardEditWithError(
                            request, response, dao, currentCategory,
                            "Vui lòng nhập tên danh mục.",
                            name
                    );
                    return;
                }

                name = name.trim();

                if (!isValidCategoryName(name)) {
                    forwardEditWithError(
                            request, response, dao, currentCategory,
                            "Tên danh mục chỉ được chứa chữ cái, chữ số và khoảng trắng.",
                            name
                    );
                    return;
                }

                if (dao.isCategoryNameExists(name, id)) {
                    forwardEditWithError(
                            request, response, dao, currentCategory,
                            "Tên danh mục đã tồn tại. Vui lòng nhập tên khác.",
                            name
                    );
                    return;
                }

                Integer parentId = null;

                if (parentIdText != null
                        && !parentIdText.trim().isEmpty()) {
                    parentId = Integer.parseInt(parentIdText);
                }

                if (parentId != null) {
                    if (parentId == id
                            || dao.getById(parentId) == null) {

                        forwardEditWithError(
                                request, response, dao, currentCategory,
                                "Danh mục cha không hợp lệ.",
                                name
                        );
                        return;
                    }

                    if (isDescendant(dao, parentId, id)) {
                        forwardEditWithError(
                                request, response, dao, currentCategory,
                                "Không thể chọn danh mục con làm danh mục cha.",
                                name
                        );
                        return;
                    }
                }

                Category category = new Category(
                        id, name, parentId
                );

                int result = dao.edit(category);

                if (result > 0) {

                    User loggedInUser
                            = (User) request.getSession()
                                    .getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                    auditLogService.log(
                            loggedInUser,
                            "UPDATE_CATEGORY",
                            "CATEGORY",
                            null,
                            "Updated category: " + name,
                            request
                    );

                    response.sendRedirect(
                            contextPath + "/category?view=list"
                    );
                } else {
                    forwardEditWithError(
                            request, response, dao, currentCategory,
                            "Không thể cập nhật danh mục. Vui lòng thử lại.",
                            name
                    );
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {
                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Cannot edit category",
                        e
                );

                if (id > 0) {
                    Category currentCategory = dao.getById(id);

                    if (currentCategory == null) {
                        response.sendRedirect(
                                contextPath + "/category?view=list"
                        );
                        return;
                    }

                    forwardEditWithError(
                            request, response, dao, currentCategory,
                            "Đã xảy ra lỗi khi cập nhật danh mục.",
                            request.getParameter("name")
                    );
                } else {
                    response.sendRedirect(
                            contextPath + "/category?view=list"
                    );
                }
            }

        } else if ("delete".equals(action)) {

            String idText = request.getParameter("id");
            int id;

            try {
                id = Integer.parseInt(idText);

                if (id <= 0) {
                    throw new NumberFormatException();
                }
            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                response.sendRedirect(
