                startDateParam = today;
            }

            if (endDateParam == null
                    || endDateParam.trim().isEmpty()) {
                endDateParam = today;
            }

           
            LocalDate startDate = null;
            LocalDate endDate = null;
            String filterError = null;

            try {
                startDate = LocalDate.parse(startDateParam);
                endDate = LocalDate.parse(endDateParam);

                if (startDate.isAfter(endDate)) {
                    filterError =
                            "Start date cannot be after end date.";
                }

            } catch (DateTimeParseException e) {
                filterError =
                        "Invalid date format. Please select valid dates.";
            }

           
            BigDecimal totalRevenue = BigDecimal.ZERO;

            int completedOrders = 0;

            int totalProductsSold = 0;

            BigDecimal averageOrderValue = BigDecimal.ZERO;

            List<Object[]> revenueByDate =
                    new ArrayList<>();

            List<Object[]> orderStatusStats =
                    new ArrayList<>();

            List<Object[]> topSellingProducts =
                    new ArrayList<>();

          
            if (filterError == null) {

                totalRevenue =
                        reportDAO.getTotalRevenueByRange(
                                startDate, endDate
                        );

                completedOrders =
                        reportDAO.getCompletedOrdersByRange(
                                startDate, endDate
                        );

                totalProductsSold =
                        reportDAO.getTotalProductsSoldByRange(
                                startDate, endDate
                        );

                revenueByDate =
                        reportDAO.getRevenueByDateRange(
                                startDate, endDate
                        );

                averageOrderValue =
                        reportDAO.getAverageOrderValueByRange(
                                startDate, endDate
                        );

                orderStatusStats =
                        reportDAO.getOrderStatusByRange(
                                startDate, endDate
                        );

                topSellingProducts =
                        reportDAO.getTopSellingProductsByRange(
                                startDate, endDate
                        );
            }

            
            request.setAttribute(
                    "totalRevenue", totalRevenue
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "completedOrders", completedOrders
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "totalProductsSold", totalProductsSold
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "averageOrderValue", averageOrderValue
            );

            
            request.setAttribute(
                    "revenueByDate", revenueByDate
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "orderStatusStats", orderStatusStats
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "topSellingProducts", topSellingProducts
            );

           
            request.setAttribute(
                    "startDate", startDateParam
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "endDate", endDateParam
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "filterError", filterError
            );

          
            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/admin/report.jsp"
            ).forward(request, response);

        } catch (Exception e) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error loading Report page",
                    e
            );

            throw new ServletException(
                    "Cannot load Report page.", e
            );
        }
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.UserDAO;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import model.PasswordResetToken;
import model.User;
import service.AuditLogService;
import service.PasswordResetService;

@WebServlet(name = "ResetPasswordServlet", urlPatterns = {"/reset-password"})
public class ResetPasswordServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(ResetPasswordServlet.class.getName());

    private final PasswordResetService passwordResetService
            = new PasswordResetService();

    private final AuditLogService auditLogService
            = new AuditLogService();

   
    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        String token = request.getParameter("token");

        if (token == null || token.trim().isEmpty()) {

            request.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu không hợp lệ!"
            );

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/reset-password.jsp")
                    .forward(request, response);

            return;
        }

        try {

            PasswordResetToken resetToken
                    = passwordResetService.validateToken(token);

            if (resetToken == null) {

                request.setAttribute(
                        "errorMessage",
                        "Liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu không hợp lệ "
                        + "hoặc đã hết hạn!"
                );

                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/reset-password.jsp")
                        .forward(request, response);

                return;
            }

            request.setAttribute("token", token);

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/reset-password.jsp")
                    .forward(request, response);

        } catch (Exception ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi kiểm tra reset token!",
                    ex
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Đã xảy ra lỗi. Vui lòng thử lại sau!"
            );

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/reset-password.jsp")
                    .forward(request, response);
        }
    }

    
    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        String token = request.getParameter("token");
        String newPassword = request.getParameter("newPassword");
        String confirmPassword = request.getParameter("confirmPassword");

       
        if (token == null || token.trim().isEmpty()) {

            request.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu không hợp lệ!"
            );

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/reset-password.jsp")
                    .forward(request, response);

            return;
        }

      
        if (newPassword == null
                || newPassword.trim().isEmpty()
                || confirmPassword == null
                || confirmPassword.trim().isEmpty()) {

            request.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Vui lòng nhập đầy đủ mật khẩu mới!"
            );

            request.setAttribute("token", token);

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/reset-password.jsp")
                    .forward(request, response);

            return;
        }

       
        if (newPassword.length() < 6) {

            request.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Mật khẩu phải có ít nhất 6 ký tự!"
            );

            request.setAttribute("token", token);

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/reset-password.jsp")
                    .forward(request, response);

            return;
        }

       
        if (!newPassword.equals(confirmPassword)) {

            request.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Mật khẩu xác nhận không khớp!"
            );

            request.setAttribute("token", token);

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/reset-password.jsp")
                    .forward(request, response);

            return;
        }

        try {

            
            PasswordResetToken resetToken
                    = passwordResetService.validateToken(token);

            if (resetToken == null) {

                request.setAttribute(
                        "errorMessage",
                        "Liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu không hợp lệ "
                        + "hoặc đã hết hạn!"
                );

                request.getRequestDispatcher(
                        "/WEB-INF/reset-password.jsp"
                ).forward(request, response);

                return;
            }

            boolean success
                    = passwordResetService.resetPassword(
                            token,
                            newPassword
                    );

            if (!success) {

                request.setAttribute(
                        "errorMessage",
                        "Liên kết đặt lại mật khẩu không hợp lệ "
                        + "hoặc đã hết hạn!"
                );

                request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/reset-password.jsp")
                        .forward(request, response);

                return;
            }

          
            HttpSession session = request.getSession();

            session.setAttribute(
                    "resetPasswordMessage",
                    "Đặt lại mật khẩu thành công. "
                    + "Bạn có thể đăng nhập bằng mật khẩu mới."
            );

            UserDAO userDAO = new UserDAO();
            User user = userDAO.getUserById(
                    resetToken.getUserId()
            );

            auditLogService.log(
                    user,
                    "RESET_PASSWORD",
                    "USER",
                    (long) user.getUserId(),
                    "Reset account password successfully",
                    request
            );

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/login"
            );

        } catch (Exception ex) {

            LOGGER.log(
                    Level.SEVERE,
                    "Lỗi đặt lại mật khẩu!",
                    ex
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "errorMessage",
                    "Đã xảy ra lỗi. Vui lòng thử lại sau!"
            );

            request.setAttribute("token", token);

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/reset-password.jsp")
                    .forward(request, response);
        }
    }
}

package controller;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

import model.User;
import service.ReturnExchangeService;

@WebServlet(name = "ReturnExchangeServlet", urlPatterns = {"/return-exchange"})
public class ReturnExchangeServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private final ReturnExchangeService returnExchangeService =
            new ReturnExchangeService();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        User user = getLoggedInUser(request);

        if (user == null || !user.isCustomer()) {
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/login");
            return;
        }

        int orderId;

        try {
            orderId = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("orderId"));

            if (orderId <= 0) {
                throw new NumberFormatException();
            }
        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/my-orders");
            return;
        }

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        String successMessage =
                (String) session.getAttribute("returnSuccessMessage");

        Integer successOrderId =
                (Integer) session.getAttribute("returnSuccessOrderId");

        if (successMessage != null && successOrderId != null
                && successOrderId == orderId) {

            request.setAttribute("successMessage", successMessage);
            request.setAttribute("orderId", orderId);

            session.removeAttribute("returnSuccessMessage");
            session.removeAttribute("returnSuccessOrderId");

            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/customer-orders/return-exchange.jsp")
                    .forward(request, response);
            return;
        }

        try {
            loadFormData(request, orderId, user.getUserId());

            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/customer-orders/return-exchange.jsp")
                    .forward(request, response);

        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath()
                    + "/my-orders?message="
                    + URLEncoder.encode(
                            ex.getMessage(),
                            StandardCharsets.UTF_8));

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            throw new ServletException(
                    "Không thể tải dữ liệu đổi/trả hàng.", ex);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        User user = getLoggedInUser(request);

        if (user == null || !user.isCustomer()) {
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/login");
            return;
        }

        int orderId;

        try {
            orderId = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("orderId"));

            if (orderId <= 0) {
                throw new NumberFormatException();
            }
        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/my-orders");
            return;
        }

        String requestType = request.getParameter("requestType");
        String reason = request.getParameter("reason");
        String[] selectedItems = request.getParameterValues("orderItemId");

        List<Map<String, Integer>> items = new ArrayList<>();

        try {
            if (selectedItems == null || selectedItems.length == 0) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Vui lòng chọn ít nhất một sản phẩm.");
            }

            for (String selectedItem : selectedItems) {
                int orderItemId = Integer.parseInt(selectedItem);

                if (orderItemId <= 0) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Sản phẩm được chọn không hợp lệ.");
                }

                String quantityParam =
                        request.getParameter("quantity_" + orderItemId);

                int quantity = Integer.parseInt(quantityParam);

                Map<String, Integer> item = new HashMap<>();
                item.put("orderItemId", orderItemId);
                item.put("quantity", quantity);

                String exchangeSkuParam =
                        request.getParameter("exchangeSkuId_" + orderItemId);

                if ("EXCHANGE".equals(requestType)) {
                    if (exchangeSkuParam == null
                            || exchangeSkuParam.trim().isEmpty()) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Vui lòng chọn SKU muốn đổi cho mỗi sản phẩm.");
                    }

                    int exchangeSkuId = Integer.parseInt(exchangeSkuParam);

                    if (exchangeSkuId <= 0) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "SKU thay thế không hợp lệ.");
                    }

                    item.put("exchangeSkuId", exchangeSkuId);

                } else if ("RETURN".equals(requestType)) {
                    item.put("exchangeSkuId", null);

                } else {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Loại yêu cầu không hợp lệ.");
                }

                items.add(item);
            }

            int requestId = returnExchangeService.createRequest(
                    orderId,
                    user.getUserId(),
                    requestType,
                    reason,
                    items
            );

            HttpSession session = request.getSession();

            session.setAttribute(
                    "returnSuccessMessage",
                    "Gửi yêu cầu đổi/trả hàng #" + requestId
                    + " thành công!");

            session.setAttribute("returnSuccessOrderId", orderId);

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath()
                    + "/return-exchange?orderId=" + orderId);

        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
            showFormError(
                    request,
                    response,
                    orderId,
                    user.getUserId(),
                    "Số lượng hoặc thông tin sản phẩm không hợp lệ.");

        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            showFormError(
                    request,
                    response,
                    orderId,
                    user.getUserId(),
                    ex.getMessage());

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            throw new ServletException(
                    "Không thể tạo yêu cầu đổi/trả hàng.", ex);
        }
    }

    private void loadFormData(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            int orderId,
            int userId) throws SQLException {

        if (!returnExchangeService.canRequest(orderId, userId)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Đơn hàng chưa giao thành công hoặc đã quá hạn 7 ngày.");
        }

        List<Map<String, Object>> orderItems =
                returnExchangeService.getOrderItems(orderId, userId);

        Map<Integer, List<Map<String, Object>>> exchangeSkus =
                new HashMap<>();

        for (Map<String, Object> item : orderItems) {
            int orderItemId = (Integer) item.get("orderItemId");

            exchangeSkus.put(
                    orderItemId,
                    returnExchangeService.getExchangeSkus(
                            orderId,
                            orderItemId,
                            userId));
        }

        request.setAttribute("orderId", orderId);
        request.setAttribute("orderItems", orderItems);
        request.setAttribute("exchangeSkus", exchangeSkus);
    }

    private void showFormError(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            int orderId,
            int userId,
            String message)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        try {
            loadFormData(request, orderId, userId);
            request.setAttribute("errorMessage", message);

            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/customer-orders/return-exchange.jsp")
                    .forward(request, response);

        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/my-orders");

        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            throw new ServletException(
                    "Không thể tải lại biểu mẫu đổi/trả hàng.", ex);
        }
    }

    private User getLoggedInUser(HttpServletRequest request) {
        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null) {
            return null;
        }

        Object loggedInUser = session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        if (loggedInUser instanceof User) {
            return (User) loggedInUser;
        }

        return null;
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.ReviewReportDAO;
import model.User;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.sql.SQLException;

@WebServlet(name = "ReviewReportServlet", urlPatterns = {"/review/report"})
public class ReviewReportServlet extends HttpServlet {

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        String contextPath = request.getContextPath();
        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null
                || !(session.getAttribute("loggedInUser") instanceof User)) {
            response.sendRedirect(contextPath + "/login");
            return;
        }

        User user = (User) session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        if (!user.isCustomer()) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN);
            return;
        }

        String expected
                = (String) session.getAttribute("reviewCsrfToken");
        String actual = request.getParameter("csrfToken");

        if (expected == null || !expected.equals(actual)) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN,
                    "Phiên làm việc không hợp lệ.");
            return;
        }

        int reviewId;
        int productId;

        try {
            reviewId = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("reviewId"));
            productId = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("productId"));
            if (reviewId <= 0 || productId <= 0) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath + "/shop");
                return;
            }

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            response.sendRedirect(contextPath + "/shop");
            return;
        }

        String reason = request.getParameter("reason");

        if (reason == null
                || reason.trim().isEmpty()
                || reason.trim().length() > 500) {
            response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                    + "/shop?action=detail&id=" + productId
                    + "&report=INVALID#reviews");
            return;
        }

        try {
            String result = new ReviewReportDAO().createReport(
                    reviewId,
                    productId,
                    user.getUserId(),
                    reason.trim()
            );

            response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                    + "/shop?action=detail&id=" + productId
                    + "&report=" + result + "#reviews");

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new ServletException(
                    "Không thể gửi báo cáo đánh giá.", e
            );
        }
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.ProductReviewDAO;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.MultipartConfig;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;
import jakarta.servlet.http.Part;
import model.ProductReview;
import model.User;

import java.io.File;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.UUID;

@WebServlet(name = "ReviewServlet", urlPatterns = {"/review"})
public class ReviewServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private ProductReviewDAO reviewDAO;

    @Override
    public void init() throws ServletException {
        reviewDAO = new ProductReviewDAO();
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        User loggedInUser = getLoggedInUser(request);

        if (loggedInUser == null) {
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/login");
            return;
        }

        String view = request.getParameter("view");

        if (view == null || view.trim().isEmpty()) {
            view = "create";
        }

        if ("create".equals(view)) {
            showCreate(request, response, loggedInUser);
        } else if ("edit".equals(view)) {
            showEdit(request, response, loggedInUser);
        } else if ("delete".equals(view)) {
            showDelete(request, response, loggedInUser);
        } else {
            redirectOrders(request, response);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        User loggedInUser = getLoggedInUser(request);

        if (loggedInUser == null) {
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/login");
            return;
        }

        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        if ("create".equals(action)) {
            createReview(request, response, loggedInUser);
        } else if ("update".equals(action)) {
            updateReview(request, response, loggedInUser);
        } else if ("delete".equals(action)) {
            deleteReview(request, response, loggedInUser);
        } else {
            redirectOrders(request, response);
        }
    }

   
    private User getLoggedInUser(HttpServletRequest request) {
        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null) {
            return null;
        }

        return (User) session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");
    }

   
    private void showCreate(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        try {
            String orderItemIdParam = request.getParameter("orderItemId");

            if (orderItemIdParam == null || orderItemIdParam.trim().isEmpty()) {
                setError(request, "Thiếu Order Item.");
                redirectOrders(request, response);
                return;
            }

            int orderItemId = Integer.parseInt(orderItemIdParam);

            ProductReview existingReview
                    = reviewDAO.getReviewByOrderItemIdAndUserId(
                            orderItemId,
                            user.getUserId()
                    );

            if (existingReview != null) {

                request.setAttribute("review", existingReview);

                request.getRequestDispatcher(
                        "/WEB-INF/review/detail.jsp"
                ).forward(request, response);

                return;
            }

            int skuId = reviewDAO.getSkuIdByOrderItemId(orderItemId);

            if (skuId <= 0) {
                setError(request, "Không tìm thấy sản phẩm.");
                redirectOrders(request, response);
                return;
            }

            boolean canReview = reviewDAO.canReview(user.getUserId(), orderItemId, skuId);

            if (!canReview) {
                setError(request, "Bạn không thể đánh giá sản phẩm này.");
                redirectOrders(request, response);
                return;
            }

            request.setAttribute("orderItemId", orderItemId);
            request.setAttribute("skuId", skuId);

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/review/create.jsp").forward(request, response);

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            setError(request, "Order Item không hợp lệ.");
            redirectOrders(request, response);
        }
    }

    
    private void createReview(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user)
            throws IOException, ServletException {

        try {
            String orderItemIdParam = request.getParameter("orderItemId");
            String ratingParam = request.getParameter("rating");

            if (orderItemIdParam == null || ratingParam == null) {
                setError(request, "Thiếu thông tin đánh giá.");
                redirectOrders(request, response);
                return;
            }

            int orderItemId = Integer.parseInt(orderItemIdParam);
            int rating = Integer.parseInt(ratingParam);
            String comment = request.getParameter("comment");

            if (rating < 1 || rating > 5) {
                setError(request, "Số sao phải từ 1 đến 5.");
                redirectCreate(request, response, orderItemId);
                return;
            }

            if (comment != null && comment.length() > 2000) {
                setError(request, "Nội dung đánh giá tối đa 2000 ký tự.");
                redirectCreate(request, response, orderItemId);
                return;
            }
            if (containsSpam(comment)) {
                setError(request,
                        "Nội dung đánh giá có dấu hiệu spam hoặc chứa liên kết quảng cáo.");
                redirectCreate(request, response, orderItemId);
                return;
            }

            int skuId = reviewDAO.getSkuIdByOrderItemId(orderItemId);

            if (skuId <= 0) {
                setError(request, "Không tìm thấy sản phẩm.");
                redirectOrders(request, response);
                return;
            }

            boolean canReview = reviewDAO.canReview(user.getUserId(), orderItemId, skuId);

            if (!canReview) {
                setError(request, "Bạn không có quyền đánh giá sản phẩm này hoặc sản phẩm đã được đánh giá.");
                redirectOrders(request, response);
                return;
            }
            
            
           
            if (containsSpam(comment)) {
                setError(request,
                        "Bình luận chứa liên kết quảng cáo "
                        + "hoặc có dấu hiệu spam.");
                redirectCreate(request, response, orderItemId);
                return;
            }

            int recentReviews =
                    reviewDAO.countRecentReviews(user.getUserId());

            if (recentReviews >= 3) {
                setError(request,
                        "Bạn đã gửi quá nhiều đánh giá "
                        + "trong 10 phút. Vui lòng thử lại sau.");
                redirectCreate(request, response, orderItemId);
                return;
            }
            ProductReview review = new ProductReview();
            review.setUserId(user.getUserId());
            review.setOrderItemId(orderItemId);
            review.setSkuId(skuId);
            review.setRating(rating);
            review.setComment(comment);

            int reviewId = reviewDAO.insertReview(review);

            if (reviewId <= 0) {
                setError(request, "Không thể tạo đánh giá.");
                redirectCreate(request, response, orderItemId);
                return;
            }

            saveReviewImages(request, reviewId);
            setSuccess(request, "Đánh giá sản phẩm thành công.");
            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath()
                    + "/review?view=create&orderItemId="
                    + orderItemId
            );

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            setError(request, "Dữ liệu đánh giá không hợp lệ.");
            redirectOrders(request, response);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
            setError(request, "Có lỗi xảy ra khi tạo đánh giá.");
            redirectOrders(request, response);
        }
    }

    
    private void showEdit(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        try {
            int reviewId = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("id"));
            ProductReview review = reviewDAO.getReviewByIdAndUserId(reviewId, user.getUserId());

            if (review == null) {
                setError(request, "Không tìm thấy đánh giá hoặc bạn không có quyền chỉnh sửa.");
                redirectOrders(request, response);
                return;
            }

            request.setAttribute("review", review);
            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/review/edit.jsp").forward(request, response);

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            setError(request, "Review ID không hợp lệ.");
            redirectOrders(request, response);
        }
    }

  
    private void updateReview(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user)
            throws IOException {

        try {
            int reviewId = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("reviewId"));
            int rating = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("rating"));
            String comment = request.getParameter("comment");

            if (rating < 1 || rating > 5) {
                setError(request, "Số sao phải từ 1 đến 5.");
                redirectEdit(request, response, reviewId);
                return;
            }

            if (comment != null && comment.length() > 2000) {
                setError(request, "Nội dung đánh giá tối đa 2000 ký tự.");
                redirectEdit(request, response, reviewId);
                return;
            }
            if (containsSpam(comment)) {
                setError(request,
                        "Nội dung đánh giá có dấu hiệu spam hoặc chứa liên kết quảng cáo.");
                redirectEdit(request, response, reviewId);
                return;
            }

            ProductReview oldReview = reviewDAO.getReviewByIdAndUserId(reviewId, user.getUserId());

            if (oldReview == null) {
                setError(request, "Bạn không có quyền sửa đánh giá này.");
                redirectOrders(request, response);
                return;
            }

            oldReview.setRating(rating);
            oldReview.setComment(comment);

            boolean success = reviewDAO.updateReview(oldReview);

            if (success) {
                setSuccess(request, "Cập nhật đánh giá thành công.");
            } else {
                setError(request, "Cập nhật đánh giá thất bại.");
            }

            redirectOrders(request, response);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
            setError(request, "Có lỗi xảy ra khi cập nhật đánh giá.");
            redirectOrders(request, response);
        }
    }

    
    private void showDelete(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        try {
            int reviewId = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("id"));
            ProductReview review = reviewDAO.getReviewByIdAndUserId(reviewId, user.getUserId());

            if (review == null) {
                setError(request, "Không tìm thấy đánh giá hoặc bạn không có quyền xóa.");
                redirectOrders(request, response);
                return;
            }

            request.setAttribute("review", review);
            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/review/delete.jsp").forward(request, response);

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            setError(request, "Review ID không hợp lệ.");
            redirectOrders(request, response);
        }
    }

   
    private void deleteReview(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            User user)
            throws IOException {

        try {
            int reviewId = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("reviewId"));
            ProductReview review = reviewDAO.getReviewByIdAndUserId(reviewId, user.getUserId());

            if (review == null) {
                setError(request, "Bạn không có quyền xóa đánh giá này.");
                redirectOrders(request, response);
                return;
            }

            boolean success = reviewDAO.deleteReview(reviewId, user.getUserId());

            if (success) {
                setSuccess(request, "Xóa đánh giá thành công.");
            } else {
                setError(request, "Không thể xóa đánh giá.");
            }

            redirectOrders(request, response);

        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
            setError(request, "Có lỗi xảy ra khi xóa đánh giá.");
            redirectOrders(request, response);
        }
    }

    
    private void saveReviewImages(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            int reviewId)
            throws IOException, ServletException {

        int imageCount = 0;

        for (Part part : request.getParts()) {

            if (!"images".equals(part.getName())) {
                continue;
            }

            if (part.getSize() <= 0) {
                continue;
            }

            if (imageCount >= 3) {
                break;
            }

            String originalName = part.getSubmittedFileName();

            if (originalName == null || originalName.trim().isEmpty()) {
                continue;
            }

            String extension = getFileExtension(originalName);

            if (!isAllowedImage(extension)) {
                continue;
            }

            String fileName = UUID.randomUUID().toString() + extension;
            String uploadPath = getServletContext().getRealPath("/uploads/reviews");

            if (uploadPath == null) {
                throw new IOException("Không xác định được thư mục upload.");
            }

            File uploadFolder = new File(uploadPath);

            if (!uploadFolder.exists() && !uploadFolder.mkdirs()) {
                throw new IOException("Không thể tạo thư mục upload.");
            }

            File savedFile = new File(uploadFolder, fileName);
            part.write(savedFile.getAbsolutePath());

            String imageUrl = "/uploads/reviews/" + fileName;
            reviewDAO.insertReviewImage(reviewId, imageUrl);

            imageCount++;
        }
    }

    
    private String getFileExtension(String fileName) {
        int dot = fileName.lastIndexOf('.');

        if (dot < 0) {
            return "";
        }

        return fileName.substring(dot).toLowerCase();
    }


    private boolean isAllowedImage(String extension) {
        return ".jpg".equals(extension)
                || ".jpeg".equals(extension)
                || ".png".equals(extension)
                || ".webp".equals(extension);
    }

    
    private void setSuccess(HttpServletRequest request, String message) {
        request.getSession().setAttribute("successMessage", message);
    }

   
    private void setError(HttpServletRequest request, String message) {
        request.getSession().setAttribute("errorMessage", message);
    }

    
    private void redirectCreate(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            int orderItemId)
            throws IOException {

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath()
                + "/review?view=create&orderItemId="
                + orderItemId
        );
    }

    
    private void redirectEdit(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response,
            int reviewId)
            throws IOException {

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath()
                + "/review?view=edit&id="
                + reviewId
        );
    }

    
    private void redirectOrders(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        response.sendRedirect(
                request.getContextPath() + "/my-orders"
        );
    }

    private boolean containsSpam(String comment) {

        if (comment == null || comment.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }

        String text = comment.trim();

        if (text.matches("(?is).*\\b(?:https?://|www\\.).*")) {
            return true;
        }

        if (text.matches("(?s).*(.)\\1{29,}.*")) {
            return true;
        }

        return false;
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.ShopDAO;
import model.Product;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import java.io.IOException;
import java.io.PrintWriter;
import java.util.List;

@WebServlet(name = "SearchApiServlet", urlPatterns = {"/api/search"})
public class SearchApiServlet extends HttpServlet {

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        response.setContentType("application/json");
        response.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        String keyword = request.getParameter("q");
        PrintWriter out = response.getWriter();

        if (keyword == null || keyword.trim().isEmpty()) {
            out.write("[]"); 
            return;
        }

        ShopDAO shopDao = new ShopDAO();
        List<Product> products = shopDao.searchProducts(keyword.trim());

        StringBuilder json = new StringBuilder("[");
        for (int i = 0; i < products.size(); i++) {
            Product p = products.get(i);

            String safeName = p.getProductName() != null ? p.getProductName().replace("\"", "\\\"") : "";
            String safeImageUrl = p.getImageUrl() != null ? p.getImageUrl().replace("\"", "\\\"").replace("\\", "\\\\") : "";

            json.append("{");
            json.append("\"id\":").append(p.getProductId()).append(",");
            json.append("\"name\":\"").append(safeName).append("\",");
            json.append("\"price\":").append(p.getMinPrice()).append(",");
            json.append("\"imageUrl\":\"").append(safeImageUrl).append("\""); 
            json.append("}");

            if (i < products.size() - 1) {
                json.append(",");
            }
        }
        json.append("]");

        out.write(json.toString());
        out.flush();
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.ShopDAO;
import dao.ProductReviewDAO;
import model.Product;
import model.ProductSku;
import model.ProductSpec;
import model.ProductReview;
import model.ProductImage;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Comparator;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

@WebServlet(name = "ShopServlet", urlPatterns = {"/shop"})
public class ShopServlet extends HttpServlet {

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        String action = request.getParameter("action");
        ShopDAO shopDao = new ShopDAO();

        if ("detail".equals(action)) {
            try {
                int id = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("id"));
                Product product = shopDao.getProductDetail(id);

                if (product != null) {
                    
                    List<ProductImage> galleryImages = shopDao.getProductImages(id);
                    product.setGalleryImages(galleryImages);

                    List<ProductSku> skus = shopDao.getProductSkus(id);
                    List<ProductSpec> specs = shopDao.getProductSpecs(id);

                    ProductReviewDAO reviewDao = new ProductReviewDAO();

                    List<ProductReview> reviews
                            = reviewDao.getReviewsByProductId(id);
                    System.out.println("========== REVIEW DEBUG ==========");
                    System.out.println("Product ID: " + id);
                    System.out.println("Total reviews: " + reviews.size());

                    for (ProductReview review : reviews) {
                        System.out.println(
                                "Review ID: " + review.getReviewId()
                                + " | SKU ID: " + review.getSkuId()
                                + " | Rating: " + review.getRating()
                        );
                    }

                    System.out.println("==================================");

                    int purchaseCount = reviewDao.getPurchaseCountByProductId(id);
                    int totalReviews = reviews.size();
                    int ratingSum = 0;

                    for (ProductReview review : reviews) {
                        ratingSum += review.getRating();
                    }

                    double averageRating = totalReviews > 0
                            ? (double) ratingSum / totalReviews
                            : 0.0;

                    request.setAttribute("product", product);
                    request.setAttribute("skus", skus);
                    request.setAttribute("specs", specs);
                    request.setAttribute("purchaseCount", purchaseCount);

                    request.setAttribute("reviews", reviews);
                    request.setAttribute("totalReviews", totalReviews);
                    request.setAttribute("averageRating", averageRating);

                    if (request.getSession().getAttribute("reviewCsrfToken") == null) {
                        request.getSession().setAttribute(
                                "reviewCsrfToken",
                                UUID.randomUUID().toString()
                        );
                    }

                    request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/shop/detail.jsp").forward(request, response);

                } else {
                    response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/shop");
                }

            } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
                response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/shop");
            }

        } else {
           
            String keyword = request.getParameter("keyword");
            String[] categoryIds = request.getParameterValues("categoryId");
            String priceRange = request.getParameter("priceRange");
            String sort = request.getParameter("sort");

            List<Product> catalog = shopDao.getFilteredCatalog(keyword, categoryIds, priceRange, sort);

            request.setAttribute("catalog", catalog);
            request.setAttribute("searchKeyword", keyword);

            if (categoryIds != null) {
                request.setAttribute("selectedCats", Arrays.asList(categoryIds));
            }
            request.setAttribute("selectedPrice", priceRange);
            request.setAttribute("selectedSort", sort);

            request.getRequestDispatcher("/WEB-INF/shop/catalog.jsp").forward(request, response);
        }
    }
}
package controller;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.net.URLEncoder;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

import model.User;
import service.ReturnExchangeService;

@WebServlet(
        name = "StaffReturnExchangeServlet",
        urlPatterns = {"/staff/return-exchange"}
)
public class StaffReturnExchangeServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER =
            Logger.getLogger(StaffReturnExchangeServlet.class.getName());

    private final ReturnExchangeService returnExchangeService =
            new ReturnExchangeService();

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        String contextPath = request.getContextPath();
        String view = request.getParameter("view");

        try {
            if ("detail".equals(view)) {
                int requestId = parseRequestId(
                        request.getParameter("id"));

                List<Map<String, Object>> requests =
                        returnExchangeService.getAllRequests();

                Map<String, Object> selectedRequest = null;

                for (Map<String, Object> item : requests) {
                    if (((Number) item.get("requestId")).intValue()
                            == requestId) {
                        selectedRequest = item;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                if (selectedRequest == null) {
                    response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                            + "/staff/return-exchange?error=notFound");
                    return;
                }

                request.setAttribute("selectedRequest", selectedRequest);
                request.setAttribute(
                        "requestItems",
                        returnExchangeService.getRequestItems(requestId));

                request.getRequestDispatcher(
                        "/WEB-INF/staff/return-exchange/detail.jsp")
                        .forward(request, response);
                return;
            }

            request.setAttribute(
                    "requestList",
                    returnExchangeService.getAllRequests());

            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/staff/return-exchange/list.jsp")
                    .forward(request, response);

        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
            response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                    + "/staff/return-exchange?error=invalidId");
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot load return/exchange requests", ex);
            throw new ServletException(
                    "Không thể tải danh sách yêu cầu đổi/trả hàng.", ex);
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        String contextPath = request.getContextPath();
        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);
        User staff = session == null
                ? null
                : (User) session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        if (staff == null || !staff.isStaff()) {
            response.sendRedirect(contextPath + "/login");
            return;
        }

        int requestId;

        try {
            requestId = parseRequestId(request.getParameter("id"));
        } catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
            response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                    + "/staff/return-exchange?error=invalidId");
            return;
        }

        String newStatus;

        if ("approve".equals(action)) {
            newStatus = "APPROVED";
        } else if ("reject".equals(action)) {
            newStatus = "REJECTED";
        } else {
            response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                    + "/staff/return-exchange?error=invalidAction");
            return;
        }

        String staffNote = request.getParameter("staffNote");
        staffNote = staffNote == null ? "" : staffNote.trim();

        if ("REJECTED".equals(newStatus) && staffNote.isEmpty()) {
            response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                    + "/staff/return-exchange?view=detail&id="
                    + requestId + "&error=noteRequired");
            return;
        }

        try {
            boolean updated = returnExchangeService.reviewRequest(
                    requestId,
                    staff.getUserId(),
                    newStatus,
                    staffNote);

            if (!updated) {
                response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                        + "/staff/return-exchange?view=detail&id="
                        + requestId + "&error=alreadyReviewed");
                return;
            }

            String message = "APPROVED".equals(newStatus)
                    ? "approved"
                    : "rejected";

            response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                    + "/staff/return-exchange?view=detail&id="
                    + requestId + "&message="
                    + URLEncoder.encode(
                            message, StandardCharsets.UTF_8));

        } catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
            response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                    + "/staff/return-exchange?view=detail&id="
                    + requestId + "&error=invalid");
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Cannot review return/exchange request", ex);

            response.sendRedirect(contextPath
                    + "/staff/return-exchange?view=detail&id="
                    + requestId + "&error=system");
        }
    }

    private int parseRequestId(String value) {
        int requestId = Integer.parseInt(value);

        if (requestId <= 0) {
            throw new NumberFormatException();
        }

        return requestId;
    }
}package controller;

import dao.StaffReviewDAO;
import dao.ReviewReportDAO;
import model.User;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.UUID;

@WebServlet(name = "StaffReviewServlet", urlPatterns = {"/staff/reviews"})
public class StaffReviewServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private User getStaff(HttpServletRequest request,
                          HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null
                || !(session.getAttribute("loggedInUser") instanceof User)) {
            response.sendRedirect(request.getContextPath() + "/login");
            return null;
        }

        User user = (User) session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        if (!user.isStaff()) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN);
            return null;
        }

        return user;
    }

    private String ensureToken(HttpSession session) {
        String token = (String) session.getAttribute("reviewCsrfToken");

        if (token == null) {
            token = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
            session.setAttribute("reviewCsrfToken", token);
        }

        return token;
    }

    private boolean validToken(HttpServletRequest request) {
        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null) {
            return false;
        }

        String expected =
                (String) session.getAttribute("reviewCsrfToken");
        String actual = request.getParameter("csrfToken");

        return expected != null && expected.equals(actual);
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request,
                         HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        User user = getStaff(request, response);

        if (user == null) {
            return;
        }

        HttpSession session = request.getSession();
        ensureToken(session);

        try {
            StaffReviewDAO reviewDAO = new StaffReviewDAO();
            ReviewReportDAO reportDAO = new ReviewReportDAO();

            request.setAttribute(
                    "reviews", reviewDAO.getAllReviewsForStaff()
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "reports", reportDAO.getAllReports()
            );

            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/review/staff-list.jsp"
            ).forward(request, response);

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new ServletException(
                    "Không thể tải dữ liệu đánh giá.", e
            );
        }
    }

    @Override
    protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request,
                          HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        User user = getStaff(request, response);

        if (user == null) {
            return;
        }

        if (!validToken(request)) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_FORBIDDEN,
                    "Phiên làm việc không hợp lệ. Vui lòng tải lại trang.");
            return;
        }

        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        try {
            if ("visibility".equals(action)) {
                int reviewId = Integer.parseInt(
                        request.getParameter("reviewId")
                );

                boolean hidden = Boolean.parseBoolean(
                        request.getParameter("hidden")
                );

                new StaffReviewDAO().setReviewHidden(reviewId, hidden);

            } else if ("resolveReport".equals(action)) {
                int reportId = Integer.parseInt(
                        request.getParameter("reportId")
                );

                String decision = request.getParameter("decision");

                new ReviewReportDAO().resolveReport(
                        reportId, user.getUserId(), decision
                );

            } else {
                response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST);
                return;
            }

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/staff/reviews"
            );

        } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
            response.sendError(HttpServletResponse.SC_BAD_REQUEST,
                    "ID không hợp lệ.");

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new ServletException(
                    "Không thể cập nhật đánh giá hoặc báo cáo.", e
            );
        }
    }
}package controller;

import dao.UserDAO;
import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;
import model.User;
import service.AuditLogService;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

@WebServlet(name = "UserServlet", urlPatterns = {"/user"})
public class UserServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(UserServlet.class.getName());
    private final AuditLogService auditLogService = new AuditLogService();


    private boolean checkPermission(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        HttpSession session = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null) {
            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/login"
            );
            return false;
        }

        User loggedInUser
                = (User) session.getAttribute("loggedInUser");

        if (loggedInUser == null) {
            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/login"
            );
            return false;
        }

        if (!loggedInUser.isAdmin()) {
            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath() + "/home"
            );
            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

   
    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        if (!checkPermission(request, response)) {
            return;
        }

        String view = request.getParameter("view");

        UserDAO dao = new UserDAO();
        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

     
        if (view == null || "list".equals(view)) {

            String keyword = request.getParameter("keyword");

            List<User> userList
                    = dao.getAllUsers(keyword);

            request.setAttribute(
                    "userList",
                    userList
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "keyword",
                    keyword
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "message",
                    session.getAttribute("message")
            );

            request.setAttribute(
                    "error",
                    session.getAttribute("error")
            );

            session.removeAttribute("message");
            session.removeAttribute("error");

            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/user/list.jsp"
            ).forward(request, response);

        } else if ("create".equals(view)) {

            request.setAttribute(
                    "roleList",
                    dao.getAllRoles()
            );

            request.getRequestDispatcher(
                    "/WEB-INF/user/create.jsp"
            ).forward(request, response);

        } else {

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath()
                    + "/user?view=list"
            );
        }
    }

  
    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding("UTF-8");

        if (!checkPermission(request, response)) {
            return;
        }

        String action = request.getParameter("action");

        UserDAO dao = new UserDAO();
        HttpSession session = request.getSession();

        
        if ("create".equals(action)) {

            String username
                    = request.getParameter("username");

            String email
                    = request.getParameter("email");

            String password
                    = request.getParameter("password");

            String phone
                    = request.getParameter("phone");

            String roleIdParam
                    = request.getParameter("roleId");

            username = username != null
                    ? username.trim()
                    : "";

            email = email != null
                    ? email.trim()
                    : "";

            phone = phone != null
                    ? phone.trim()
                    : "";

            try {

                if (username.isEmpty()
                        || email.isEmpty()
                        || password == null
                        || password.isEmpty()
                        || roleIdParam == null
                        || roleIdParam.isEmpty()) {

                    session.setAttribute(
                            "error",
                            "Vui lòng nhập đầy đủ thông tin!"
                    );

                    response.sendRedirect(
                            request.getContextPath()
                            + "/user?view=create"
                    );

                    return;
                }

                int roleId
                        = Integer.parseInt(roleIdParam);

                if (dao.checkUserExist(
                        username,
                        email)) {

                    session.setAttribute(
                            "error",
                            "Username hoặc Email đã tồn tại!"
                    );

                    response.sendRedirect(
                            request.getContextPath()
                            + "/user?view=create"
                    );

                    return;
                }

                User newUser = new User();

                newUser.setUsername(username);
                newUser.setEmail(email);
                newUser.setPhone(phone);
                newUser.setRoleId(roleId);

                boolean success
                        = dao.createUser(
                                newUser,
                                password
                        );

                if (success) {

                    session.setAttribute(
                            "message",
                            "Tạo tài khoản thành công!"
                    );

                    User loggedInUser
                            = (User) request.getSession().getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                    auditLogService.log(
                            loggedInUser,
                            "CREATE_USER",
                            "USER",
                            null,
                            "Created new user account: " + username,
                            request
                    );

                    response.sendRedirect(
                            request.getContextPath()
                            + "/user?view=list"
                    );

                } else {

                    session.setAttribute(
                            "error",
                            "Tạo tài khoản thất bại!"
                    );

                    response.sendRedirect(
                            request.getContextPath()
                            + "/user?view=create"
                    );
                }

            } catch (Exception e) {

                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Lỗi khi tạo User!",
                        e
                );

                session.setAttribute(
                        "error",
                        "Lỗi khi tạo tài khoản!"
                );

                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath()
                        + "/user?view=create"
                );
            }

        } else if ("toggleStatus".equals(action)) {

            try {

                int id = Integer.parseInt(
                        request.getParameter("id")
                );

                boolean active
                        = Boolean.parseBoolean(
                                request.getParameter("active")
                        );

                User loggedInUser
                        = (User) session.getAttribute(
                                "loggedInUser"
                        );

                if (loggedInUser != null
                        && loggedInUser.getUserId() == id) {

                    session.setAttribute(
                            "error",
                            "Không thể khóa tài khoản "
                            + "đang đăng nhập!"
                    );

                    response.sendRedirect(
                            request.getContextPath()
                            + "/user?view=list"
                    );

                    return;
                }

                User selectedUser
                        = dao.getUserById(id);

                if (selectedUser == null) {

                    session.setAttribute(
                            "error",
                            "Không tìm thấy tài khoản!"
                    );

                    response.sendRedirect(
                            request.getContextPath()
                            + "/user?view=list"
                    );

                    return;
                }

                boolean success
                        = dao.updateUserStatus(
                                id,
                                active
                        );

                if (success) {

                    if (active) {

                        session.setAttribute(
                                "message",
                                "Mở khóa tài khoản thành công!"
                        );

                        auditLogService.log(
                                loggedInUser,
                                "UNLOCK_USER",
                                "USER",
                                (long) id,
                                "Unlocked user account: "
                                + selectedUser.getUsername(),
                                request
                        );

                    } else {

                        session.setAttribute(
                                "message",
                                "Khóa tài khoản thành công!"
                        );

                        auditLogService.log(
                                loggedInUser,
                                "LOCK_USER",
                                "USER",
                                (long) id,
                                "Locked user account: "
                                + selectedUser.getUsername(),
                                request
                        );
                    }

                } else {

                    session.setAttribute(
                            "error",
                            "Cập nhật trạng thái tài khoản thất bại!"
                    );
                }

                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath()
                        + "/user?view=list"
                );

            } catch (Exception e) {

                LOGGER.log(
                        Level.SEVERE,
                        "Lỗi cập nhật trạng thái User!",
                        e
                );

                session.setAttribute(
                        "error",
                        "Lỗi khi cập nhật trạng thái tài khoản!"
                );

                response.sendRedirect(
                        request.getContextPath()
                        + "/user?view=list"
                );
            }

        } else {

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath()
                    + "/user?view=list"
            );
        }
    }
}
package controller;

import dao.VoucherDAO;
import model.User;
import service.AuditLogService;

import jakarta.servlet.ServletException;
import jakarta.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;

import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpSession;

import model.User;
import model.Voucher;

import java.io.IOException;

import java.sql.Timestamp;

import java.time.LocalDateTime;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;

@WebServlet(
        name = "VoucherServlet",
        urlPatterns = {"/staff/voucher"}
)
public class VoucherServlet extends HttpServlet {

    private final AuditLogService auditLogService
            = new AuditLogService();

    private VoucherDAO voucherDAO;

    private final DateTimeFormatter formatter
            = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern(
                    "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm"
            );

   
    @Override
    public void init()
            throws ServletException {

        voucherDAO
                = new VoucherDAO();
    }

    @Override
    protected void doGet(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding(
                "UTF-8"
        );

        if (!checkStaff(
                request,
                response
        )) {

            return;
        }

        String view
                = request.getParameter(
                        "view"
                );

        if (view == null
                || view.trim().isEmpty()) {

            view = "list";
        }

        switch (view) {

            case "create":

                showCreate(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;

            case "edit":

                showEdit(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;

            case "delete":

                showDelete(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;
            case "usage":

                showUsage(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;

            case "list":

            default:

                showList(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;
        }
    }

    
    @Override
    protected void doPost(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setCharacterEncoding(
                "UTF-8"
        );

        if (!checkStaff(
                request,
                response
        )) {

            return;
        }

        String action
                = request.getParameter(
                        "action"
                );

        if (action == null
                || action.trim().isEmpty()) {

            redirectList(
                    request,
                    response
            );

            return;
        }

        switch (action) {

            case "create":

                createVoucher(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;

            case "update":

                updateVoucher(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;

            case "delete":

                deleteVoucher(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;

            default:

                redirectList(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                break;
        }
    }

   
    private boolean checkStaff(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        HttpSession session
                = request.getSession(false);

        if (session == null) {

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath()
                    + "/login"
            );

            return false;
        }

        Object value
                = session.getAttribute(
                        "loggedInUser"
                );

        if (!(value instanceof User)) {

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath()
                    + "/login"
            );

            return false;
        }

        User loggedInUser
                = (User) value;

        if (!loggedInUser.isStaff()) {

            session.setAttribute(
                    "toastMessage",
                    "Chỉ Staff mới có quyền quản lý Voucher!"
            );

            session.setAttribute(
                    "toastType",
                    "error"
            );

            response.sendRedirect(
                    request.getContextPath()
                    + "/home"
            );

            return false;
        }

        return true;
    }

    
    private void showList(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setAttribute(
                "vouchers",
                voucherDAO.getAllVouchers()
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "usedVoucherCount",
                voucherDAO.countUsedVouchers()
        );

        request.setAttribute(
                "recentVoucherUsages",
                voucherDAO.getRecentVoucherUsages()
        );

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/voucher/list.jsp"
        ).forward(
                request,
                response
        );
    }

    private void showUsage(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.setAttribute(
                "voucherUsages",
                voucherDAO.getAllVoucherUsages()
        );

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/voucher/usage.jsp"
        ).forward(
                request,
                response
        );
    }

    private void showCreate(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws ServletException, IOException {

        request.getRequestDispatcher(
                "/WEB-INF/voucher/create.jsp"
        ).forward(
                request,
                response
        );
    }

  
    private void createVoucher(
            HttpServletRequest request,
            HttpServletResponse response)
            throws IOException {

        try {

            Voucher voucher
                    = getVoucherFromRequest(
                            request
                    );

            String error
                    = validateVoucher(
                            voucher,
                            false
                    );

            if (error != null) {

                setErrorMessage(
                        request,
                        error
                );

                redirectCreate(
                        request,
                        response
                );

                return;
            }

            boolean success
                    = voucherDAO
                            .insertVoucher(
                                    voucher
                            );

            if (success) {

                setSuccessMessage(
                        request,
                        "Tạo Voucher thành công."
                );

                User loggedInUser
                        = (User) request.getSession()
                                .getAttribute("loggedInUser");

                auditLogService.log(
                        loggedInUser,
                        "CREATE_VOUCHER",
                        "VOUCHER",
