        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException(
                        "Khong ket noi duoc database."
                );
            }

            return findIdByToken(conn, userId, checkoutToken);
        }
    }

    public Order findByIdAndUser(
            int orderId,
            int userId
    ) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "SELECT * FROM dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "WHERE order_id = ? AND user_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException(
                        "Khong ket noi duoc database."
                );
            }

            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                ps.setInt(1, orderId);
                ps.setInt(2, userId);

                try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                    if (rs.next()) {
                        return mapOrder(rs);
                    }

                    return null;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public List<Order> findByUser(
            Connection conn,
            int userId
    ) throws SQLException {

        List<Order> orders = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT * FROM dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY created_at DESC, order_id DESC";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    orders.add(mapOrder(rs));
                }
            }
        }

        return orders;
    }

    private Order mapOrder(ResultSet rs) throws SQLException {
        Order order = new Order();

        order.setOrderId(rs.getInt("order_id"));
        order.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));
        order.setAddressId(rs.getInt("address_id"));

        order.setShippingPartnerId(
                (Integer) rs.getObject("shipping_partner_id")
        );

        order.setTotalAmount(rs.getBigDecimal("total_amount"));
        order.setShippingFee(rs.getBigDecimal("shipping_fee"));
        order.setDiscountAmount(rs.getBigDecimal("discount_amount"));

        order.setOrderStatus(rs.getString("order_status"));
        order.setPaymentMethod(rs.getString("payment_method"));
        order.setPaymentStatus(rs.getString("payment_status"));

        order.setRecipientName(rs.getString("recipient_name"));
        order.setRecipientPhone(rs.getString("recipient_phone"));
        order.setShippingAddress(rs.getString("shipping_address"));

        order.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));
        order.setPaymentExpiresAt(
                rs.getTimestamp(
                        "payment_expires_at",
                        java.util.Calendar.getInstance(
                                java.util.TimeZone.getTimeZone("UTC")
                        )
                )
        );

        return order;
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> findItems(int orderId, int userId) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT i.order_item_id, i.sku_id, i.price, i.quantity, s.sku_code, p.product_name, p.image_url "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM i JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON o.order_id = i.order_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s ON s.sku_id = i.sku_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON p.product_id = s.product_id "
                + "WHERE o.order_id = ? AND o.user_id = ? ORDER BY i.order_item_id";
        List<Map<String, Object>> items = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> item = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    item.put("orderItemId", rs.getInt("order_item_id"));
                    item.put("skuId", rs.getInt("sku_id"));
                    item.put("imageUrl", rs.getString("image_url"));
                    item.put("skuCode", rs.getString("sku_code"));
                    item.put("productName", rs.getString("product_name"));
                    item.put("price", rs.getBigDecimal("price"));
                    item.put("quantity", rs.getInt("quantity"));
                    items.add(item);
                }
            }
        }
        return items;
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> findHistory(int orderId, int userId) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT h.status, h.updated_at FROM dbo.ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY h "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON o.order_id = h.order_id "
                + "WHERE o.order_id = ? AND o.user_id = ? ORDER BY h.updated_at, h.status_id";
        List<Map<String, Object>> history = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> entry = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    entry.put("status", rs.getString("status"));
                    entry.put("updatedAt", rs.getTimestamp("updated_at"));
                    history.add(entry);
                }
            }
        }
        return history;
    }
}
package dao;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.time.ZoneOffset;
import java.time.ZoneId;
import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;

public class OrderPolicyDAO {
    public void lockCustomer(Connection connection, int userId) throws SQLException {
        try (PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(
                "SELECT user_id FROM dbo.[USER] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) WHERE user_id = ?")) {
            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (!rs.next()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Không tìm thấy khách hàng.");
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public void requireAllowed(Connection connection, int userId) throws SQLException {
        String message = restriction(connection, userId);
        if (message != null) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(message);
        }
    }

    public String restriction(Connection connection, int userId) throws SQLException {
        try (PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(
                "SELECT violation_count, blocked_until FROM dbo.ORDER_CUSTOMER_POLICY "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? AND (violation_count >= 3 OR blocked_until > SYSUTCDATETIME())")) {
            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (!rs.next()) {
                    return null;
                }
                if (rs.getInt("violation_count") >= 3) {
                    return "Bạn đã bị khóa đặt hàng vĩnh viễn do vi phạm chính sách hủy đơn lần thứ 3.";
                }
                Timestamp until = rs.getTimestamp("blocked_until");
                String local = until.toLocalDateTime().atOffset(ZoneOffset.UTC)
                        .atZoneSameInstant(ZoneId.of("Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh"))
                        .format(DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm"));
                return "Bạn đang bị khóa đặt hàng đến " + local
                        + " (giờ Việt Nam) do hủy hơn 5 sản phẩm trong 7 ngày.";
            }
        }
    }

    public void recordCancellation(Connection connection, int userId, int orderId) throws SQLException {
        try (PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(
                "INSERT INTO dbo.ORDER_CUSTOMER_CANCELLATION (order_id, user_id, quantity) "
                + "SELECT o.order_id, o.user_id, SUM(CAST(i.quantity AS bigint)) "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o JOIN dbo.ORDER_ITEM i ON i.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "WHERE o.order_id = ? AND o.user_id = ? AND o.order_status = 'CANCELLED' "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ORDER_CUSTOMER_CANCELLATION WHERE order_id = ?) "
                + "GROUP BY o.order_id, o.user_id")) {
            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);
            ps.setInt(3, orderId);
            if (ps.executeUpdate() == 0) {
                return;
            }
        }
        try (PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(
                "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ORDER_CUSTOMER_POLICY WHERE user_id = ?) "
                + "INSERT INTO dbo.ORDER_CUSTOMER_POLICY (user_id) VALUES (?)")) {
            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);
            ps.executeUpdate();
        }
        try (PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(
                "UPDATE p SET violation_count = violation_count + 1, "
                + "blocked_until = CASE violation_count WHEN 0 THEN DATEADD(DAY,3,SYSUTCDATETIME()) "
                + "WHEN 1 THEN DATEADD(DAY,7,SYSUTCDATETIME()) ELSE NULL END "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_CUSTOMER_POLICY p WHERE p.user_id = ? AND violation_count < 3 "
                + "AND (blocked_until IS NULL OR blocked_until <= SYSUTCDATETIME()) "
                + "AND (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(c.quantity),0) FROM dbo.ORDER_CUSTOMER_CANCELLATION c "
                + "WHERE c.user_id = p.user_id AND c.cancelled_at > DATEADD(DAY,-7,SYSUTCDATETIME()) "
                + "AND (p.blocked_until IS NULL OR c.cancelled_at >= p.blocked_until)) > 5")) {
            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            ps.executeUpdate();
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import model.PasswordResetToken;

public class PasswordResetDAO {

    public boolean createToken(PasswordResetToken token) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "INSERT INTO PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN "
                + "(user_id, token_hash, expires_at) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection connection = new DBContext().getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, token.getUserId());
            ps.setString(2, token.getTokenHash());
            ps.setTimestamp(3, token.getExpiresAt());

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        }
    }

   
    public PasswordResetToken findValidToken(String tokenHash)
            throws SQLException {

        String sql = "SELECT reset_id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, used_at, created_at "
                + "FROM PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN "
                + "WHERE token_hash = ? "
                + "AND used_at IS NULL "
                + "AND expires_at > GETDATE()";

        try (Connection connection = new DBContext().getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(1, tokenHash);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    PasswordResetToken token = new PasswordResetToken();

                    token.setResetId(rs.getInt("reset_id"));
                    token.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));
                    token.setTokenHash(rs.getString("token_hash"));
                    token.setExpiresAt(rs.getTimestamp("expires_at"));
                    token.setUsedAt(rs.getTimestamp("used_at"));
                    token.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

                    return token;
                }
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    
    public boolean markAsUsed(int resetId) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "UPDATE PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN "
                + "SET used_at = GETDATE() "
                + "WHERE reset_id = ? "
                + "AND used_at IS NULL";

        try (Connection connection = new DBContext().getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, resetId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        }
    }

   
    public void invalidateOldTokens(int userId) throws SQLException {

        String sql = "UPDATE PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN "
                + "SET used_at = GETDATE() "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? "
                + "AND used_at IS NULL";

        try (Connection connection = new DBContext().getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            ps.executeUpdate();
        }
    }
}package dao;

import db.CheckoutConnectionFactory;
import db.DBContext;
import payment.PaymentGateway;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

public class PaymentDAO {

    private final CheckoutConnectionFactory connections;

    public PaymentDAO() {
        this(() -> new DBContext().getConnection());
    }

    public PaymentDAO(CheckoutConnectionFactory connections) {
        this.connections = connections;
    }

    private Connection open() throws SQLException {
        Connection connection = connections.open();

        if (connection == null) {
            throw new SQLException(
                    "Không kết nối được database."
            );
        }

        return connection;
    }

    public static final class Attempt {

        public final String ref;
        public final String method;
        public final String url;
        public final BigDecimal amount;
        public final long seconds;

        public Attempt(
                String ref,
                String method,
                String url,
                BigDecimal amount,
                long seconds
        ) {
            this.ref = ref;
            this.method = method;
            this.url = url;
            this.amount = amount;
            this.seconds = seconds;
        }
    }

    private static final class LockedOrder {

        int id;
        int owner;
        String status;
        String method;
        String payment;
        BigDecimal amount;
        long seconds;
        boolean restored;
    }

    private LockedOrder lock(
            Connection connection,
            int orderId
    ) throws SQLException {

        String sql =
                "SELECT *, "
                + "DATEDIFF_BIG(SECOND, SYSUTCDATETIME(), "
                + "payment_expires_at) AS seconds_left "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE order_id = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps =
                connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (!rs.next()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                    );
                }

                LockedOrder order = new LockedOrder();

                order.id = orderId;
                order.owner = rs.getInt("user_id");
                order.status = rs.getString("order_status");
                order.method = rs.getString("payment_method");
                order.payment = rs.getString("payment_status");
                order.amount = rs.getBigDecimal("total_amount");
                order.seconds = rs.getLong("seconds_left");
                order.restored =
                        rs.getTimestamp("stock_restored_at") != null;

                return order;
            }
        }
    }

    private static int update(
            Connection connection,
            String sql,
            Object... values
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (PreparedStatement ps =
                connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            for (int i = 0; i < values.length; i++) {
                ps.setObject(i + 1, values[i]);
            }

            return ps.executeUpdate();
        }
    }

    private void history(
            Connection connection,
            int orderId,
            String status
    ) throws SQLException {

        update(
                connection,
                "INSERT INTO dbo.ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY "
                + "(order_id, status) VALUES (?, ?)",
                orderId,
                status
        );
    }

    private static void rollback(
            Connection connection,
            Exception original
    ) {
        try {
            connection.rollback();
        } catch (SQLException rollbackError) {
            original.addSuppressed(rollbackError);
        }
    }

    private boolean expire(
            Connection connection,
            LockedOrder order
    ) throws SQLException {

        if (!"PENDING_PAYMENT".equals(order.status)
                || order.seconds > 0
                || "PAID".equals(order.payment)) {
            return false;
        }

        cancel(connection, order);
        return true;
    }

    private void cancel(
            Connection connection,
            LockedOrder order
    ) throws SQLException {

        if (!order.restored) {
            List<int[]> items = new ArrayList<>();

            String sql =
                    "SELECT sku_id, SUM(quantity) AS qty "
                    + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM "
                    + "WHERE order_id = ? "
                    + "GROUP BY sku_id "
                    + "ORDER BY sku_id";

            try (PreparedStatement ps =
                    connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                ps.setInt(1, order.id);

                try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                    while (rs.next()) {
                        items.add(new int[]{
                            rs.getInt("sku_id"),
                            rs.getInt("qty")
                        });
                    }
                }
            }

            if (items.isEmpty()) {
                throw new SQLException(
                        "Đơn hàng không có chi tiết."
                );
            }

            for (int[] item : items) {
                if (item[1] <= 0) {
                    throw new SQLException(
                            "Số lượng sản phẩm không hợp lệ."
                    );
                }

                int affected = update(
                        connection,
                        "UPDATE dbo.PRODUCT_SKU "
                        + "SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + ? "
                        + "WHERE sku_id = ?",
                        item[1],
                        item[0]
                );

                if (affected != 1) {
                    throw new SQLException(
                            "Không hoàn được tồn kho."
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        update(
                connection,
                "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "SET order_status = 'CANCELLED', "
                + "payment_status = 'UNPAID', "
                + "stock_restored_at = COALESCE("
                + "stock_restored_at, SYSUTCDATETIME()) "
                + "WHERE order_id = ?",
                order.id
        );

        update(
                connection,
                "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                + "SET status = 'EXPIRED' "
                + "WHERE order_id = ? AND status = 'PENDING'",
                order.id
        );

        history(connection, order.id, "CANCELLED");

        order.status = "CANCELLED";
        order.restored = true;
    }

    public Attempt begin(
            int userId,
            int orderId
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection connection = open()) {
            connection.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                LockedOrder order = lock(connection, orderId);

                if (order.owner != userId) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                    );
                }

                if (expire(connection, order)) {
                    connection.commit();

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Đơn đã hết 15 phút thanh toán "
                            + "và được hủy."
                    );
                }

                if (!"PENDING_PAYMENT".equals(order.status)
                        || "PAID".equals(order.payment)
                        || order.restored) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Đơn không còn chờ thanh toán."
                    );
                }

                PaymentGateway.requireConfigured(order.method);

                String sql =
                        "SELECT TOP 1 transaction_code, pay_url, "
                        + "DATEDIFF(SECOND, created_at, "
                        + "SYSUTCDATETIME()) AS age "
                        + "FROM dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "WHERE order_id = ? "
                        + "AND payment_method = ? "
                        + "AND status = 'PENDING' "
                        + "ORDER BY transaction_id DESC";

                try (PreparedStatement ps =
                        connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, orderId);
                    ps.setString(2, order.method);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (rs.next()) {
                            String url = rs.getString("pay_url");

                            if (url != null) {
                                Attempt attempt = new Attempt(
                                        rs.getString("transaction_code"),
                                        order.method,
                                        url,
                                        order.amount,
                                        order.seconds
                                );

                                connection.commit();
                                return attempt;
                            }

                            if (rs.getInt("age") < 30) {
                                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                        "Đang tạo thanh toán. "
                                        + "Chờ vài giây rồi thử lại."
                                );
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                update(
                        connection,
                        "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "SET status = 'EXPIRED' "
                        + "WHERE order_id = ? AND status = 'PENDING'",
                        orderId
                );

                String ref = "OECS"
                        + orderId
                        + UUID.randomUUID()
                                .toString()
                                .replace("-", "");

                update(
                        connection,
                        "INSERT INTO dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "(order_id, payment_method, amount, "
                        + "transaction_code) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)",
                        orderId,
                        order.method,
                        order.amount,
                        ref
                );

                connection.commit();

                return new Attempt(
                        ref,
                        order.method,
                        null,
                        order.amount,
                        order.seconds
                );

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                rollback(connection, e);
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    public void saveUrl(
            String ref,
            String url
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection connection = open()) {
            update(
                    connection,
                    "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                    + "SET pay_url = ? "
                    + "WHERE transaction_code = ? "
                    + "AND status = 'PENDING'",
                    url,
                    ref
            );
        }
    }

    public void changeOrCancel(
            int userId,
            int orderId,
            boolean toCod
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection connection = open()) {
            connection.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                OrderPolicyDAO policy = new OrderPolicyDAO();
                policy.lockCustomer(connection, userId);
                LockedOrder order = lock(connection, orderId);

                if (order.owner != userId) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                    );
                }

                if (expire(connection, order)) {
                    connection.commit();
                    return;
                }

                if (toCod
                        && "COD".equals(order.method)
                        && "PENDING_CONFIRMATION".equals(order.status)) {

                    connection.commit();
                    return;
                }

                if (!toCod && "CANCELLED".equals(order.status)) {
                    connection.commit();
                    return;
                }

                if (!"PENDING_PAYMENT".equals(order.status)
                        || "PAID".equals(order.payment)
                        || order.restored) {

                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Đơn không còn chờ thanh toán. "
                            + "Hãy tải lại trang."
                    );
                }

                if (toCod) {
                    update(
                            connection,
                            "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                            + "SET payment_method = 'COD', "
                            + "payment_expires_at = NULL, "
                            + "order_status = 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION', "
                            + "payment_status = 'UNPAID' "
                            + "WHERE order_id = ?",
                            orderId
                    );

                    update(
                            connection,
                            "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                            + "SET status = 'CANCELLED' "
                            + "WHERE order_id = ? "
                            + "AND status = 'PENDING'",
                            orderId
                    );

                    history(
                            connection,
                            orderId,
                            "PENDING_CONFIRMATION"
                    );

                } else {
                    cancel(connection, order);
                    policy.recordCancellation(connection, userId, orderId);
                }

                connection.commit();

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                rollback(connection, e);
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    public String settle(
            String method,
            String ref,
            BigDecimal amount,
            String providerId,
            String code,
            boolean success
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection connection = open()) {
            connection.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                int orderId;

                String sql =
                        "SELECT order_id "
                        + "FROM dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "WHERE transaction_code = ? "
                        + "AND payment_method = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps =
                        connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                    ps.setString(1, ref);
                    ps.setString(2, method);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            connection.rollback();
                            return "01";
                        }

                        orderId = rs.getInt("order_id");
                    }
                }

                LockedOrder order = lock(connection, orderId);

                long transactionId;
                String transactionStatus;
                BigDecimal expectedAmount;

                sql =
                        "SELECT transaction_id, status, amount "
                        + "FROM dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE transaction_code = ? "
                        + "AND payment_method = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps =
                        connection.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                    ps.setString(1, ref);
                    ps.setString(2, method);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Không tìm thấy giao dịch."
                            );
                        }

                        transactionId = rs.getLong("transaction_id");
                        transactionStatus = rs.getString("status");
                        expectedAmount = rs.getBigDecimal("amount");
                    }
                }

                if (expectedAmount.compareTo(amount) != 0
                        || order.amount.compareTo(amount) != 0) {

                    connection.rollback();
                    return "04";
                }

                if ("SUCCESS".equals(transactionStatus)) {
                    connection.commit();
                    return "02";
                }

                if (success
                        && (providerId == null
                        || providerId.isEmpty()
                        || "0".equals(providerId))) {

                    connection.rollback();
                    return "99";
                }

                expire(connection, order);

                if (!success) {
                    update(
                            connection,
                            "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                            + "SET status = 'FAILED', "
                            + "provider_response_code = ?, "
                            + "completed_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() "
                            + "WHERE transaction_id = ? "
                            + "AND status <> 'SUCCESS'",
                            code,
                            transactionId
                    );

                    connection.commit();
                    return "00";
                }

                update(
                        connection,
                        "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                        + "SET status = 'SUCCESS', "
                        + "provider_transaction_id = ?, "
                        + "provider_response_code = ?, "
                        + "completed_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() "
                        + "WHERE transaction_id = ?",
                        providerId,
                        code,
                        transactionId
                );

                boolean canConfirm =
                        "PENDING_PAYMENT".equals(order.status)
                        && !"PAID".equals(order.payment)
                        && !order.restored
                        && method.equals(order.method)
                        && order.seconds > 0;

                if (canConfirm) {
                    update(
                            connection,
                            "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                            + "SET payment_status = 'PAID', "
                            + "order_status = 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION', "
                            + "payment_expires_at = NULL "
                            + "WHERE order_id = ?",
                            orderId
                    );

                    update(
                            connection,
                            "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION "
                            + "SET status = 'CANCELLED' "
                            + "WHERE order_id = ? "
                            + "AND transaction_id <> ? "
                            + "AND status = 'PENDING'",
                            orderId,
                            transactionId
                    );

                    history(
                            connection,
                            orderId,
                            "PENDING_CONFIRMATION"
                    );

                } else {
                    update(
                            connection,
                            "INSERT INTO dbo.PAYMENT_REFUND "
                            + "(transaction_id, refund_amount, reason) "
                            + "VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                            transactionId,
                            amount,
                            "Thanh toán về trễ, đổi COD hoặc "
                            + "thanh toán trùng; cần đối soát "
                            + "và hoàn tiền."
                    );

                    if ("CANCELLED".equals(order.status)) {
                        update(
                                connection,
                                "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                                + "SET payment_status = 'REFUND_PENDING' "
                                + "WHERE order_id = ?",
                                orderId
                        );
                    }
                }

                connection.commit();
                return "00";

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                rollback(connection, e);
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    public void expireOrder(
            int userId,
            int orderId
    ) throws SQLException {

        try (Connection connection = open()) {
            connection.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                LockedOrder order = lock(connection, orderId);

                if (order.owner != userId) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                    );
                }

                expire(connection, order);
                connection.commit();

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                rollback(connection, e);
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    public void expireBatch() throws SQLException {
        List<int[]> orders = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql =
                "SELECT TOP 200 order_id, user_id "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] "
                + "WHERE order_status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' "
                + "AND payment_expires_at <= SYSUTCDATETIME() "
                + "ORDER BY order_id";

        try (
                Connection connection = open();
                PreparedStatement ps =
                        connection.prepareStatement(sql);
                ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()
        ) {
            while (rs.next()) {
                orders.add(new int[]{
                    rs.getInt("order_id"),
                    rs.getInt("user_id")
                });
            }
        }

        for (int[] order : orders) {
            expireOrder(order[1], order[0]);
        }
    }
}package dao;

import db.CheckoutConnectionFactory;
import db.DBContext;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class PaymentRefundDAO {
    private final CheckoutConnectionFactory connections;

    public PaymentRefundDAO() {
        this(() -> new DBContext().getConnection());
    }

    public PaymentRefundDAO(CheckoutConnectionFactory connections) {
        this.connections = connections;
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> findForCustomer(int orderId, int userId) throws SQLException {
        return find("WHERE t.order_id = ? AND o.user_id = ? ORDER BY r.refund_id DESC", orderId, userId);
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> findPage(int page) throws SQLException {
        return find("ORDER BY r.requested_at DESC, r.refund_id DESC OFFSET ? ROWS FETCH NEXT 50 ROWS ONLY",
                (page - 1) * 50);
    }

    private List<Map<String, Object>> find(String suffix, int... parameters) throws SQLException {
        String sql = "SELECT r.*, t.order_id, t.transaction_code, t.payment_method, "
                + "t.provider_transaction_id FROM dbo.PAYMENT_REFUND r "
                + "JOIN dbo.PAYMENT_TRANSACTION t ON t.transaction_id = r.transaction_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON o.order_id = t.order_id " + suffix;
        List<Map<String, Object>> rows = new ArrayList<>();
        try (Connection c = connections.open(); PreparedStatement ps = c.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            for (int i = 0; i < parameters.length; i++) {
                ps.setInt(i + 1, parameters[i]);
            }
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> row = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    row.put("id", rs.getLong("refund_id"));
                    row.put("orderId", rs.getInt("order_id"));
                    row.put("transactionCode", rs.getString("transaction_code"));
                    row.put("providerTransactionId", rs.getString("provider_transaction_id"));
                    row.put("method", rs.getString("payment_method"));
                    row.put("amount", rs.getBigDecimal("refund_amount"));
                    row.put("status", rs.getString("refund_status"));
                    row.put("statusLabel", statusLabel(rs.getString("refund_status")));
                    row.put("reference", rs.getString("provider_refund_id"));
                    row.put("reason", rs.getString("reason"));
                    row.put("requestedAt", rs.getTimestamp("requested_at"));
                    row.put("completedAt", rs.getTimestamp("completed_at"));
                    rows.add(row);
                }
            }
        }
        return rows;
    }

    private static String statusLabel(String status) {
        switch (status) {
            case "PENDING": return "Chờ đối soát";
            case "PROCESSING": return "Đang xử lý";
            case "SUCCESS": return "Đã hoàn tiền";
            case "FAILED": return "Hoàn tiền chưa thành công";
            default: return status;
        }
    }

    public void updateStatus(long refundId, String expectedStatus, String nextStatus,
            String reference, int staffId) throws SQLException {
        boolean start = ("PENDING".equals(expectedStatus) || "FAILED".equals(expectedStatus))
                && "PROCESSING".equals(nextStatus);
        boolean finish = "PROCESSING".equals(expectedStatus)
                && ("SUCCESS".equals(nextStatus) || "FAILED".equals(nextStatus));
        if (refundId <= 0 || staffId <= 0 || (!start && !finish)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Chuyển trạng thái hoàn tiền không hợp lệ.");
        }
        String trimmed = reference == null ? "" : reference.trim();
        if (trimmed.length() > 150 || ("SUCCESS".equals(nextStatus) && trimmed.isEmpty())) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Cần mã tham chiếu hoàn tiền thực tế, tối đa 150 ký tự.");
        }
        String sql = "UPDATE dbo.PAYMENT_REFUND SET refund_status = ?, "
                + "provider_refund_id = CASE WHEN ? = 'SUCCESS' THEN ? ELSE provider_refund_id END, "
                + "completed_at = CASE WHEN ? = 'SUCCESS' THEN SYSUTCDATETIME() ELSE NULL END, "
                + "processed_by = ?, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() "
                + "WHERE refund_id = ? AND refund_status = ?";
        try (Connection c = connections.open(); PreparedStatement ps = c.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setString(1, nextStatus);
            ps.setString(2, nextStatus);
            ps.setString(3, trimmed);
            ps.setString(4, nextStatus);
            ps.setInt(5, staffId);
            ps.setLong(6, refundId);
            ps.setString(7, expectedStatus);
            if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Yêu cầu đã được cập nhật. Hãy tải lại trang.");
            }
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Brand;
import model.Category;
import model.Product;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class ProductDAO extends DBContext {

    public List<Product> getList() {
        List<Product> list = new ArrayList<>();
        String sql = "SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.created_at, p.image_url, "
                + "c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_id, "
                + "b.brand_id, b.brand_name, b.logo_url "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "ORDER BY p.product_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                Category category = new Category(
                        rs.getInt("category_id"),
                        rs.getString("category_name"),
                        rs.getObject("parent_id") != null ? rs.getInt("parent_id") : null
                );

                Brand brand = new Brand(
                        rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                        rs.getString("brand_name"),
                        rs.getString("logo_url")
                );

                Product product = new Product(
                        rs.getInt("product_id"),
                        rs.getInt("category_id"),
                        rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                        rs.getString("product_name"),
                        rs.getString("description"),
                        rs.getTimestamp("created_at"),
                        rs.getString("image_url"),
                        category,
                        brand
                );

                list.add(product);
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ProductDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi lấy danh sách Product!", ex);
        }
        return list;
    }

    public int insert(Product product) {
        String sql = "INSERT INTO PRODUCT (product_name, description, category_id, brand_id, image_url) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            statement.setString(1, product.getProductName());
            statement.setString(2, product.getDescription());
            statement.setInt(3, product.getCategoryId());
            statement.setInt(4, product.getBrandId());
            statement.setString(5, product.getImageUrl()); // Lưu đường dẫn ảnh

            return statement.executeUpdate();
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            ex.printStackTrace();
            return 0;
        }
    }

    
    public int insertReturnId(Product product) {
        String sql = "INSERT INTO PRODUCT (product_name, description, category_id, brand_id, image_url) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql, PreparedStatement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {

            statement.setString(1, product.getProductName());
            statement.setString(2, product.getDescription());
            statement.setInt(3, product.getCategoryId());
            statement.setInt(4, product.getBrandId());
            statement.setString(5, product.getImageUrl());

            int affectedRows = statement.executeUpdate();

            if (affectedRows > 0) {
                try (ResultSet rs = statement.getGeneratedKeys()) {
                    if (rs.next()) {
                        return rs.getInt(1); 
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ProductDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi insertReturnId Product!", ex);
        }
        return 0;
    }

    public int update(Product product) {
        String sql = "UPDATE PRODUCT SET product_name=?, description=?, category_id=?, brand_id=?, image_url=COALESCE(?, image_url) WHERE product_id=?";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            statement.setString(1, product.getProductName());
            statement.setString(2, product.getDescription());
            statement.setInt(3, product.getCategoryId());
            statement.setInt(4, product.getBrandId());
            statement.setString(5, product.getImageUrl());
            statement.setInt(6, product.getProductId());

            return statement.executeUpdate();
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            ex.printStackTrace();
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public int delete(int productId) {
        String sql = "DELETE FROM PRODUCT WHERE product_id = ?";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            statement.setInt(1, productId);
            return statement.executeUpdate();
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ProductDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi xóa Product!", ex);
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public Product getById(int id) {
        String sql = "SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.created_at, p.image_url, "
                + "c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_id, "
                + "b.brand_id, b.brand_name, b.logo_url "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "WHERE p.product_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            statement.setInt(1, id);

            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    Category category = new Category(
                            rs.getInt("category_id"),
                            rs.getString("category_name"),
                            rs.getObject("parent_id") != null ? rs.getInt("parent_id") : null
                    );

                    Brand brand = new Brand(
                            rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                            rs.getString("brand_name"),
                            rs.getString("logo_url")
                    );

                    return new Product(
                            rs.getInt("product_id"),
                            rs.getInt("category_id"),
                            rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                            rs.getString("product_name"),
                            rs.getString("description"),
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at"),
                            rs.getString("image_url"),
                            category,
                            brand
                    );
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ProductDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi lấy Product theo ID!", ex);
        }
        return null;
    }

   
    public List<Product> searchProducts(String keyword) {
        List<Product> list = new ArrayList<>();
        String sql = "SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.created_at, p.image_url, "
                + "c.category_id, c.category_name, c.parent_id, "
                + "b.brand_id, b.brand_name, b.logo_url "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "WHERE p.product_name LIKE ? OR c.category_name LIKE ? OR b.brand_name LIKE ? "
                + "ORDER BY p.product_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            String searchPattern = "%" + keyword + "%";
            statement.setNString(1, searchPattern);
            statement.setNString(2, searchPattern);
            statement.setNString(3, searchPattern);

            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Category category = new Category(
                            rs.getInt("category_id"),
                            rs.getString("category_name"),
                            rs.getObject("parent_id") != null ? rs.getInt("parent_id") : null
                    );

                    Brand brand = new Brand(
                            rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                            rs.getString("brand_name"),
                            rs.getString("logo_url")
                    );

                    Product product = new Product(
                            rs.getInt("product_id"),
                            rs.getInt("category_id"),
                            rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                            rs.getString("product_name"),
                            rs.getString("description"),
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at"),
                            rs.getString("image_url"),
                            category,
                            brand
                    );
                    list.add(product);
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ProductDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi tìm kiếm Product!", ex);
        }
        return list;
    }
    
    public boolean checkProductNameExists(String productName) {
        String sql = "SELECT 1 FROM PRODUCT WHERE product_name = ?";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            statement.setString(1, productName);
            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next(); 
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ProductDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi kiểm tra trùng tên Product!", ex);
        }
        return false;
    }

    public boolean checkProductNameExistsForUpdate(String productName, int excludeProductId) {
        String sql = "SELECT 1 FROM PRODUCT WHERE product_name = ? AND product_id != ?";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            statement.setString(1, productName);
            statement.setInt(2, excludeProductId);
            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ProductDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi kiểm tra trùng tên Product lúc Edit!", ex);
        }
        return false;
    }

    public void insertGalleryImages(int productId, List<String> imageUrls) {
        if (imageUrls == null || imageUrls.isEmpty()) {
            return;
        }
        String sql = "INSERT INTO PRODUCT_IMAGES (product_id, image_url) VALUES (?, ?)";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement stm = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            for (String url : imageUrls) {
                stm.setInt(1, productId);
                stm.setString(2, url);
                stm.addBatch();
            }
            stm.executeBatch();
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            ex.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

    public void deleteGalleryImages(int productId) {
        String sql = "DELETE FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES WHERE product_id = ?";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement stm = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            stm.setInt(1, productId);
            stm.executeUpdate();
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            ex.printStackTrace();
        }
    }

   
    public List<model.ProductImage> getProductImages(int productId) {
        List<model.ProductImage> list = new ArrayList<>();
        String sql = "SELECT image_id, product_id, image_url FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES WHERE product_id = ?";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement stm = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            stm.setInt(1, productId);
            try (ResultSet rs = stm.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(new model.ProductImage(
                            rs.getInt("image_id"),
                            rs.getInt("product_id"),
                            rs.getString("image_url")
                    ));
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
        return list;
    }

    public void deleteGalleryImageById(int imageId) {
        String sql = "DELETE FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES WHERE image_id = ?";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement stm = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            stm.setInt(1, imageId);
            stm.executeUpdate();
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            ex.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.ProductReview;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;

public class ProductReviewDAO extends DBContext {

    public int getSkuIdByOrderItemId(int orderItemId) {

        String sql = "SELECT sku_id "
                + "FROM ORDER_ITEM "
                + "WHERE order_item_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderItemId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt("sku_id");
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return -1;
    }

    
    public boolean canReview(
            int userId,
            int orderItemId,
            int skuId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "ON oi.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "WHERE oi.order_item_id = ? "
                + "AND oi.sku_id = ? "
                + "AND o.user_id = ? "
                + "AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.order_status))) "
                + "IN ('COMPLETED', 'DELIVERED') "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS ( "
                + "SELECT 1 "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS pr "
                + "WHERE pr.order_item_id = oi.order_item_id "
                + ")";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderItemId);
            ps.setInt(2, skuId);
            ps.setInt(3, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            java.util.logging.Logger
                    .getLogger(ProductReviewDAO.class.getName())
                    .log(
                            java.util.logging.Level.SEVERE,
                            "Lỗi kiểm tra quyền đánh giá",
                            e
                    );
        }

        return false;
    }

    
    public boolean alreadyReviewed(int orderItemId) {

        String sql = "SELECT review_id "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS "

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderItemId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }

   
    public int insertReview(ProductReview review) {

        String sql = "INSERT INTO PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "(user_id, order_item_id, sku_id, rating, comment, created_at) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, GETDATE())";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql, Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {

            ps.setInt(1, review.getUserId());
            ps.setInt(2, review.getOrderItemId());
            ps.setInt(3, review.getSkuId());
            ps.setInt(4, review.getRating());
            ps.setString(5, review.getComment());

            int rows = ps.executeUpdate();

            if (rows > 0) {
                try (ResultSet rs = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {
                    if (rs.next()) {
                        return rs.getInt(1);
                    }
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return -1;
    }

   
    public boolean insertReviewImage(int reviewId, String imageUrl) {

        String sql = "INSERT INTO REVIEW_IMAGES (review_id, image_url) VALUES (?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, reviewId);
            ps.setString(2, imageUrl);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }

    
    public ProductReview getReviewByIdAndUserId(int reviewId, int userId) {

        String sql = "SELECT review_id, user_id, order_item_id, sku_id, "
                + "rating, comment, created_at "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "WHERE review_id = ? "
                + "AND user_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, reviewId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    ProductReview review = mapReview(rs);
                    review.setImages(getReviewImages(reviewId));
                    return review;
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return null;
    }

    
    public List<String> getReviewImages(int reviewId) {

        List<String> images = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT image_url "
                + "FROM REVIEW_IMAGES "
                + "WHERE review_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY image_id ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, reviewId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    images.add(rs.getString("image_url"));
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return images;
    }

    
    public boolean updateReview(ProductReview review) {

        String sql = "UPDATE PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "SET rating = ?, comment = ? "
                + "WHERE review_id = ? "
                + "AND user_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, review.getRating());
            ps.setString(2, review.getComment());
            ps.setInt(3, review.getReviewId());
            ps.setInt(4, review.getUserId());

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return false;
    }

   
    public boolean deleteReview(int reviewId, int userId) {

        String deleteImagesSql = "DELETE FROM REVIEW_IMAGES WHERE review_id = ?";
        String deleteReviewSql = "DELETE FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS WHERE review_id = ? AND user_id = ?";

        Connection conn = null;

        try {
            conn = getConnection();
            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try (PreparedStatement psImages = conn.prepareStatement(deleteImagesSql)) {
                psImages.setInt(1, reviewId);
                psImages.executeUpdate();
            }

            int rows;
            try (PreparedStatement psReview = conn.prepareStatement(deleteReviewSql)) {
                psReview.setInt(1, reviewId);
                psReview.setInt(2, userId);

                rows = psReview.executeUpdate();
            }

            if (rows > 0) {
                conn.commit();
                return true;
            }

            conn.rollback();

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            if (conn != null) {
                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackException) {
                    rollbackException.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
            e.printStackTrace();

        } finally {
            if (conn != null) {
                try {
                    conn.setAutoCommit(true);
                    conn.close();
                } catch (SQLException closeException) {
                    closeException.printStackTrace();
                }
            }
        }

        return false;
    }

    
    public List<ProductReview> getReviewsBySkuId(int skuId) {

        List<ProductReview> reviews = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT review_id, user_id, order_item_id, sku_id, "
                + "rating, comment, created_at "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "WHERE sku_id = ? "
                + "AND is_hidden = 0 "
                + "ORDER BY created_at DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    ProductReview review = mapReview(rs);
                    review.setImages(getReviewImages(review.getReviewId()));
                    reviews.add(review);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return reviews;
    }

    
    public List<ProductReview> getReviewsByProductId(int productId) {

        List<ProductReview> reviews = new ArrayList<>();

       
        String debugSql
                = "SELECT pr.review_id, pr.sku_id, "
                + "pr.rating, pr.is_hidden, ps.product_id "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS pr "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU ps "
                + "ON pr.sku_id = ps.sku_id "
                + "WHERE ps.product_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY pr.review_id";

        String sql
                = "SELECT pr.review_id, pr.user_id, "
                + "pr.order_item_id, pr.sku_id, "
                + "pr.rating, pr.comment, pr.created_at "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS pr "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU ps "
                + "ON pr.sku_id = ps.sku_id "
                + "WHERE ps.product_id = ? "
                + "AND pr.is_hidden = 0 "
                + "ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC, pr.review_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                    "SELECT SERVERPROPERTY('ServerName') AS server_name, "
                    + "DB_NAME() AS database_name"); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {
                    System.out.println(
                            "JAVA SERVER: " + rs.getString("server_name"));
                    System.out.println(
                            "JAVA DATABASE: " + rs.getString("database_name"));
                }
            }

            System.out.println("===== ALL REVIEWS IN DATABASE =====");
            System.out.println("Product ID: " + productId);

            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(debugSql)) {

                ps.setInt(1, productId);

                try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                    while (rs.next()) {
                        System.out.println(
                                "Review ID: " + rs.getInt("review_id")
                                + " | SKU: " + rs.getInt("sku_id")
                                + " | Rating: " + rs.getInt("rating")
                                + " | Hidden: " + rs.getObject("is_hidden")
                        );
                    }
                }
            }

            System.out.println("===== VISIBLE REVIEWS =====");

            try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                ps.setInt(1, productId);

                try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                    while (rs.next()) {

                        ProductReview review = mapReview(rs);
                        reviews.add(review);

                        System.out.println(
                                "Visible Review ID: " + review.getReviewId()
                        );
                    }
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Lỗi tải đánh giá cho sản phẩm ID " + productId, e);
        }

        for (ProductReview review : reviews) {
            review.setImages(
                    getReviewImages(review.getReviewId())
            );
        }

        System.out.println("TOTAL VISIBLE REVIEWS: " + reviews.size());
        System.out.println("=================================");

        return reviews;
    }

    public double getAverageRating(int skuId) {

        String sql = "SELECT AVG(CAST(rating AS FLOAT)) AS average_rating "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "WHERE sku_id = ? "
                + "AND is_hidden = 0";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, skuId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getDouble("average_rating");
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return 0;
    }

            ps.setInt(1, skuId);

                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
