        }

        return 0;
    }

    
    public int getPurchaseCountByProductId(int productId) {

        String sql = "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_item_id) AS purchase_count "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU ps "
                + "ON oi.sku_id = ps.sku_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "ON oi.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "WHERE ps.product_id = ? "
                + "AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.order_status))) "
                + "IN ('COMPLETED', 'DELIVERED')";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt("purchase_count");
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return 0;
    }

    
    private ProductReview mapReview(ResultSet rs) throws SQLException {

        ProductReview review = new ProductReview();

        review.setReviewId(rs.getInt("review_id"));
        review.setUserId(rs.getInt("user_id"));
        review.setOrderItemId(rs.getInt("order_item_id"));
        review.setSkuId(rs.getInt("sku_id"));
        review.setRating(rs.getInt("rating"));
        review.setComment(rs.getString("comment"));
        review.setCreatedAt(rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));

        return review;
    }

    public ProductReview getReviewByOrderItemIdAndUserId(
            int orderItemId,
            int userId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT pr.review_id, pr.user_id, "
                + "pr.order_item_id, pr.sku_id, "
                + "pr.rating, pr.comment, pr.created_at "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS pr "
                + "JOIN dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "ON oi.order_item_id = pr.order_item_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "ON o.order_id = oi.order_id "
                + "WHERE pr.order_item_id = ? "
                + "AND pr.user_id = ? "
                + "AND o.user_id = ?";

        ProductReview review = null;

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderItemId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);
            ps.setInt(3, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    review = mapReview(rs);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Không thể tải đánh giá sản phẩm", e
            );
        }

        if (review != null) {
            review.setImages(
                    getReviewImages(review.getReviewId())
            );
        }

        return review;
    }

    public int countRecentReviews(int userId) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "WHERE user_id = ? "
                + "AND created_at >= DATEADD(MINUTE, -10, GETDATE())";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt("total");
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            throw new IllegalStateException(
                    "Không thể kiểm tra tần suất đánh giá", e);
        }

        return 0;
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.ProductSku;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class ProductSkuDAO extends DBContext {

    public List<ProductSku> getByProductId(int productId) {
        List<ProductSku> list = new ArrayList<>();
        String sql = "SELECT sku_id, product_id, sku_code, price, stock_quantity "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE product_id = ? ORDER BY sku_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, productId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(new ProductSku(
                            rs.getInt("sku_id"),
                            rs.getInt("product_id"),
                            rs.getString("sku_code"),
                            rs.getDouble("price"),
                            rs.getInt("stock_quantity")
                    ));
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ProductSkuDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, null, ex);
        }
        return list;
    }

    public int insert(ProductSku sku) {
        String sql = "INSERT INTO PRODUCT_SKU (product_id, sku_code, price, stock_quantity) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, sku.getProductId());
            ps.setString(2, sku.getSkuCode());
            ps.setDouble(3, sku.getPrice());
            ps.setInt(4, sku.getStockQuantity());

            return ps.executeUpdate();
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ProductSkuDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, null, ex);
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public int delete(int skuId) {
        String sql = "DELETE FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE sku_id = ?";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, skuId);
            return ps.executeUpdate();
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ProductSkuDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, null, ex);
            return 0;
        }
    }

    public boolean checkSkuCodeExists(String skuCode) {
        String sql = "SELECT 1 FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE sku_code = ?";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setString(1, skuCode);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next(); 
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ProductSkuDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, null, ex);
        }
        return false;
    }

    public boolean checkSkuCodeExistsForUpdate(String skuCode, int excludeSkuId) {
        String sql = "SELECT 1 FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE sku_code = ? AND sku_id != ?";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setString(1, skuCode);
            ps.setInt(2, excludeSkuId);
            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ProductSkuDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, null, ex);
        }
        return false;
    }

    public int update(ProductSku sku) {
        String sql = "UPDATE PRODUCT_SKU SET sku_code = ?, price = ?, stock_quantity = ? WHERE sku_id = ?";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setString(1, sku.getSkuCode());
            ps.setDouble(2, sku.getPrice());
            ps.setInt(3, sku.getStockQuantity());
            ps.setInt(4, sku.getSkuId());
            return ps.executeUpdate();
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ProductSkuDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, null, ex);
            return 0;
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;

public class ReportDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final Logger LOGGER
            = Logger.getLogger(ReportDAO.class.getName());

    private static final String COMPLETED_CONDITION
            = " o.order_status = 'COMPLETED' ";

    public BigDecimal getTotalRevenueByRange(
            LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT ISNULL(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS total_revenue "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.created_at >= ? "
                + "AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "AND " + COMPLETED_CONDITION;

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            setDateRange(ps, startDate, endDate);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    BigDecimal result
                            = rs.getBigDecimal("total_revenue");

                    return result != null
                            ? result : BigDecimal.ZERO;
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting total revenue", e);
        }

        return BigDecimal.ZERO;
    }

    public int getCompletedOrdersByRange(
            LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.created_at >= ? "
                + "AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "AND " + COMPLETED_CONDITION;

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            setDateRange(ps, startDate, endDate);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt("total_orders");
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting completed orders", e);
        }

        return 0;
    }

   
    public int getTotalProductsSoldByRange(
            LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate) {

        String sql
                = "SELECT ISNULL(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) AS total_products "
                + "FROM ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "INNER JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "ON oi.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "WHERE o.created_at >= ? "
                + "AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "AND " + COMPLETED_CONDITION;

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            setDateRange(ps, startDate, endDate);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    return rs.getInt("total_products");
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting products sold", e);
        }

        return 0;
    }

    
    public List<Object[]> getRevenueByDateRange(
            LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate) {

        List<Object[]> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT CAST(o.created_at AS DATE) AS report_date, "
                + "SUM(o.total_amount) AS revenue, "
                + "COUNT(*) AS order_count "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.created_at >= ? "
                + "AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "AND " + COMPLETED_CONDITION
                + " GROUP BY CAST(o.created_at AS DATE) "
                + "ORDER BY report_date DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            setDateRange(ps, startDate, endDate);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(new Object[]{
                        rs.getDate("report_date"),
                        rs.getBigDecimal("revenue"),
                        rs.getInt("order_count")
                    });
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting revenue by date", e);
        }

        return list;
    }

    
    public BigDecimal getAverageOrderValueByRange(
            LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate) {

        BigDecimal revenue
                = getTotalRevenueByRange(startDate, endDate);

        int orders
                = getCompletedOrdersByRange(startDate, endDate);

        if (orders == 0) {
            return BigDecimal.ZERO;
        }

        return revenue.divide(
                BigDecimal.valueOf(orders),
                2,
                RoundingMode.HALF_UP
        );
    }

    
    public List<Object[]> getOrderStatusByRange(
            LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate) {

        List<Object[]> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT o.order_status, COUNT(*) AS total "
                + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.created_at >= ? "
                + "AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "GROUP BY o.order_status "
                + "ORDER BY total DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            setDateRange(ps, startDate, endDate);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(new Object[]{
                        rs.getString("order_status"),
                        rs.getInt("total")
                    });
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting order statuses", e);
        }

        return list;
    }

   
    public List<Object[]> getTopSellingProductsByRange(
            LocalDate startDate, LocalDate endDate) {

        List<Object[]> list = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT TOP 5 "
                + "p.product_name, "
                + "SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_sold "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "INNER JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "ON oi.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "INNER JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU ps "
                + "ON oi.sku_id = ps.sku_id "
                + "INNER JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p "
                + "ON ps.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "WHERE o.created_at >= ? "
                + "AND o.created_at < ? "
                + "AND o.order_status = 'COMPLETED' "
                + "GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name "
                + "ORDER BY total_sold DESC, p.product_name ASC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            setDateRange(ps, startDate, endDate);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {

                    Object[] row = new Object[2];

                    row[0] = rs.getString("product_name");
                    row[1] = rs.getInt("total_sold");

                    list.add(row);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {
            LOGGER.log(Level.SEVERE,
                    "Error getting top selling products", e);
        }

        return list;
    }

    
    private void setDateRange(
            PreparedStatement ps,
            LocalDate startDate,
            LocalDate endDate) throws SQLException {

        ps.setDate(1, java.sql.Date.valueOf(startDate));

        ps.setDate(2,
                java.sql.Date.valueOf(endDate.plusDays(1)));
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import db.CheckoutConnectionFactory;

import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Statement;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class ReturnExchangeDAO {

    private final CheckoutConnectionFactory connections;

    public ReturnExchangeDAO() {
        this(() -> new DBContext().getConnection());
    }

    public ReturnExchangeDAO(CheckoutConnectionFactory connections) {
        this.connections = connections;
    }

    private Connection getConnection() throws SQLException {
        Connection conn = connections.open();

        if (conn == null) {
            throw new SQLException("Không kết nối được database.");
        }

        return conn;
    }


    public boolean canRequest(int orderId, int userId) throws SQLException {
        String sql
                = "SELECT 1 FROM dbo.[ORDER] o "
                + "WHERE o.order_id = ? AND o.user_id = ? "
                + "AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(o.order_status))) = 'COMPLETED' "
                + "AND o.delivered_at IS NOT NULL "
                + "AND o.delivered_at <= SYSDATETIME() "
                + "AND o.delivered_at >= DATEADD(DAY, -7, SYSDATETIME()) "
                + "AND NOT EXISTS ("
                + "    SELECT 1 FROM dbo.RETURN_REQUEST r "
                + "    WHERE r.order_id = o.order_id "
                + "    AND r.user_id = o.user_id "
                + "    AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(r.request_status))) "
                + "        IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED')"
                + ")";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                return rs.next();
            }
        }
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getOrderItems(
            int orderId, int userId) throws SQLException {

        List<Map<String, Object>> items = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT oi.order_item_id, oi.sku_id, oi.quantity, "
                + "oi.price, s.sku_code, s.product_id, p.product_name "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s ON s.sku_id = oi.sku_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p ON p.product_id = s.product_id "
                + "WHERE o.order_id = ? AND o.user_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY oi.order_item_id";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> item = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    item.put("orderItemId", rs.getInt("order_item_id"));
                    item.put("skuId", rs.getInt("sku_id"));
                    item.put("quantity", rs.getInt("quantity"));
                    item.put("price", rs.getBigDecimal("price"));
                    item.put("skuCode", rs.getString("sku_code"));
                    item.put("productId", rs.getInt("product_id"));
                    item.put("productName", rs.getString("product_name"));
                    items.add(item);
                }
            }
        }

        return items;
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getExchangeSkus(
            int orderItemId, int userId) throws SQLException {

        List<Map<String, Object>> skus = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT target.sku_id, target.sku_code, "
                + "target.price, target.stock_quantity "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "JOIN dbo.[ORDER] o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU original "
                + "ON original.sku_id = oi.sku_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU target "
                + "ON target.product_id = original.product_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p "
                + "ON p.product_id = target.product_id "
                + "WHERE oi.order_item_id = ? AND o.user_id = ? "
                + "AND target.sku_id <> original.sku_id "
                + "AND target.stock_quantity > 0 "
                + "ORDER BY target.sku_code";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderItemId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> sku = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                    sku.put("skuId", rs.getInt("sku_id"));
                    sku.put("skuCode", rs.getString("sku_code"));
                    sku.put("price", rs.getBigDecimal("price"));
                    sku.put("stockQuantity", rs.getInt("stock_quantity"));
                    skus.add(sku);
                }
            }
        }

        return skus;
    }


    public int createRequest(
            int orderId,
            int userId,
            String requestType,
            String reason,
            List<Map<String, Integer>> items) throws SQLException {

        if (!"RETURN".equals(requestType)
                && !"EXCHANGE".equals(requestType)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Loại yêu cầu không hợp lệ.");
        }

        if (reason == null || reason.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Vui lòng nhập lý do.");
        }

        if (items == null || items.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Vui lòng chọn sản phẩm.");
        }

        String orderSql
                = "SELECT order_id FROM dbo.[ORDER] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE order_id = ? AND user_id = ? "
                + "AND UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(order_status))) = 'COMPLETED' "
                + "AND delivered_at IS NOT NULL "
                + "AND delivered_at <= SYSDATETIME() "
                + "AND delivered_at >= DATEADD(DAY, -7, SYSDATETIME())";

        String itemSql
                = "SELECT oi.quantity, oi.sku_id, original.product_id "
                + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU original "
                + "ON original.sku_id = oi.sku_id "
                + "WHERE oi.order_item_id = ? AND oi.order_id = ?";

        String exchangeSql
                = "SELECT product_id, stock_quantity FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU "
                + "WHERE sku_id = ?";

        String insertRequestSql
                = "INSERT INTO dbo.RETURN_REQUEST "
                + "(order_id, user_id, request_type, reason, request_status) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, 'PENDING')";

        String insertItemSql
                = "INSERT INTO dbo.RETURN_REQUEST_ITEM "
                + "(request_id, order_item_id, quantity, exchange_sku_id) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)";

        String historySql
                = "INSERT INTO dbo.RETURN_REQUEST_HISTORY "
                + "(request_id, status, updated_by, note) "
                + "VALUES (?, 'PENDING', ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(orderSql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, orderId);
                    ps.setInt(2, userId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Đơn hàng không hợp lệ hoặc đã quá hạn 7 ngày.");
                        }
                    }
                }

                int requestId;

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(
                        insertRequestSql, Statement.RETURN_GENERATED_KEYS)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, orderId);
                    ps.setInt(2, userId);
                    ps.setString(3, requestType);
                    ps.setString(4, reason.trim());
                    ps.executeUpdate();

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.getGeneratedKeys()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Không tạo được mã yêu cầu.");
                        }

                        requestId = rs.getInt(1);
                    }
                }

                for (Map<String, Integer> item : items) {
                    if (item == null
                            || item.get("orderItemId") == null
                            || item.get("quantity") == null) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Thông tin sản phẩm không hợp lệ.");
                    }

                    int orderItemId = item.get("orderItemId");
                    int quantity = item.get("quantity");
                    Integer exchangeSkuId = item.get("exchangeSkuId");

                    if (quantity <= 0) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Số lượng phải lớn hơn 0.");
                    }

                    int originalQuantity;
                    int originalProductId;

                    try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(itemSql)) {
                        ps.setInt(1, orderItemId);
                        ps.setInt(2, orderId);

                        try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                            if (!rs.next()) {
                                throw new SQLException(
                                        "Sản phẩm không thuộc đơn hàng.");
                            }

                            originalQuantity = rs.getInt("quantity");
                            originalProductId = rs.getInt("product_id");
                        }
                    }

                    if (quantity > originalQuantity) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Số lượng yêu cầu vượt quá số lượng đã mua.");
                    }

                    String usedSql
                            = "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ri.quantity), 0) "
                            + "FROM dbo.RETURN_REQUEST_ITEM ri "
                            + "JOIN dbo.RETURN_REQUEST r "
                            + "ON r.request_id = ri.request_id "
                            + "WHERE ri.order_item_id = ? "
                            + "AND r.request_status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED')";

                    try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(usedSql)) {
                        ps.setInt(1, orderItemId);

                        try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                            if (rs.next()
                                    && rs.getInt(1) + quantity > originalQuantity) {
                                throw new SQLException(
                                        "Số lượng đã được yêu cầu trả/đổi trước đó.");
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if ("EXCHANGE".equals(requestType)) {
                        if (exchangeSkuId == null) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                    "Vui lòng chọn SKU muốn đổi.");
                        }

                        try (PreparedStatement ps
                                = conn.prepareStatement(exchangeSql)) {
                            ps.setInt(1, exchangeSkuId);

                            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                                if (!rs.next()
                                        || rs.getInt("product_id") != originalProductId
                                        || exchangeSkuId
                                        == getOriginalSkuId(conn, orderItemId)) {
                                    throw new SQLException(
                                            "SKU đổi phải là phiên bản khác của cùng sản phẩm.");
                                }

                                if (rs.getInt("stock_quantity") <= 0) {
                                    throw new SQLException(
                                            "SKU đổi hiện không còn hàng.");
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    } else if (exchangeSkuId != null) {
                        throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                "Yêu cầu trả hàng không cần chọn SKU đổi.");
                    }

                    try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(insertItemSql)) {
                        ps.setInt(1, requestId);
                        ps.setInt(2, orderItemId);
                        ps.setInt(3, quantity);

                        if (exchangeSkuId == null) {
                            ps.setNull(4, java.sql.Types.INTEGER);
                        } else {
                            ps.setInt(4, exchangeSkuId);
                        }

                        ps.executeUpdate();
                    }
                }

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(historySql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, requestId);
                    ps.setInt(2, userId);
                    ps.setString(3, "Khách hàng gửi yêu cầu.");
                    ps.executeUpdate();
                }

                conn.commit();
                return requestId;

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException ex) {
                conn.rollback();
                throw ex;
            } finally {
                conn.setAutoCommit(true);
            }
        }
    }

    private int getOriginalSkuId(
            Connection conn, int orderItemId) throws SQLException {

        String sql
                = "SELECT sku_id FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM WHERE order_item_id = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, orderItemId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (!rs.next()) {
                    throw new SQLException("Không tìm thấy sản phẩm trong đơn.");
                }

                return rs.getInt("sku_id");
            }
        }
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getAllRequests() throws SQLException {
        List<Map<String, Object>> requests = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT r.request_id, r.order_id, r.user_id, "
                + "u.username, r.request_type, r.reason, "
                + "r.request_status, r.created_at, "
                + "r.reviewed_at, r.staff_note "
                + "FROM dbo.RETURN_REQUEST r "
                + "JOIN dbo.[USER] u ON u.user_id = r.user_id "
                + "ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.request_status = 'PENDING' "
                + "THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, r.created_at DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                Map<String, Object> item = new LinkedHashMap<>();
                item.put("requestId", rs.getInt("request_id"));
                item.put("orderId", rs.getInt("order_id"));
                item.put("userId", rs.getInt("user_id"));
                item.put("username", rs.getString("username"));
                item.put("requestType", rs.getString("request_type"));
                item.put("reason", rs.getString("reason"));
                item.put("requestStatus", rs.getString("request_status"));
                item.put("createdAt", rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));
                item.put("reviewedAt", rs.getTimestamp("reviewed_at"));
                item.put("staffNote", rs.getString("staff_note"));
                requests.add(item);
            }
        }

        return requests;
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getRequestItems(
            int requestId) throws SQLException {

        List<Map<String, Object>> items = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT ri.request_item_id, ri.order_item_id, "
                + "ri.quantity, ri.exchange_sku_id, "
                + "oi.price, "
                + "p.product_name, original.sku_code AS original_sku_code, "
                + "target.sku_code AS exchange_sku_code "
                + "FROM dbo.RETURN_REQUEST_ITEM ri "
                + "JOIN dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "ON oi.order_item_id = ri.order_item_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU original "
                + "ON original.sku_id = oi.sku_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p "
                + "ON p.product_id = original.product_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU target "
                + "ON target.sku_id = ri.exchange_sku_id "
                + "WHERE ri.request_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY ri.request_item_id";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, requestId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> item = new LinkedHashMap<>();

                    item.put("requestItemId",
                            rs.getInt("request_item_id"));

                    item.put("orderItemId",
                            rs.getInt("order_item_id"));

                    item.put("quantity",
                            rs.getInt("quantity"));

                    item.put("price",
                            rs.getBigDecimal("price"));

                    item.put("exchangeSkuId",
                            rs.getObject("exchange_sku_id"));

                    item.put("productName",
                            rs.getString("product_name"));

                    item.put("originalSkuCode",
                            rs.getString("original_sku_code"));

                    item.put("exchangeSkuCode",
                            rs.getString("exchange_sku_code"));

                    items.add(item);
                }
            }
        }

        return items;
    }

    public boolean reviewRequest(
            int requestId,
            int staffId,
            String newStatus,
            String staffNote) throws SQLException {

        if (!"APPROVED".equals(newStatus)
                && !"REJECTED".equals(newStatus)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Trạng thái duyệt không hợp lệ.");
        }

        String lockRequestSql
                = "SELECT request_type, request_status, user_id, order_id "
                + "FROM dbo.RETURN_REQUEST WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE request_id = ?";

        String getItemsSql
                = "SELECT ri.quantity, ri.exchange_sku_id, "
                + "oi.sku_id AS original_sku_id, "
                + "original.product_id AS original_product_id "
                + "FROM dbo.RETURN_REQUEST_ITEM ri "
                + "JOIN dbo.ORDER_ITEM oi "
                + "ON oi.order_item_id = ri.order_item_id "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU original "
                + "ON original.sku_id = oi.sku_id "
                + "WHERE ri.request_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY ri.request_item_id";

        String getTargetSql
                = "SELECT product_id "
                + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_SKU WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE sku_id = ?";

        String addStockSql
                = "UPDATE dbo.PRODUCT_SKU "
                + "SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + ? "
                + "WHERE sku_id = ?";

        String subtractStockSql
                = "UPDATE dbo.PRODUCT_SKU "
                + "SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - ? "
                + "WHERE sku_id = ? AND stock_quantity >= ?";

        String updateRequestSql
                = "UPDATE dbo.RETURN_REQUEST "
                + "SET request_status = ?, reviewed_by = ?, "
                + "reviewed_at = SYSDATETIME(), staff_note = ? "
                + "WHERE request_id = ? AND request_status = 'PENDING'";

        String historySql
                = "INSERT INTO dbo.RETURN_REQUEST_HISTORY "
                + "(request_id, status, updated_by, note) "
                + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {
            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                String requestType;
                String currentStatus;
                int customerId;
                int orderId;

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(lockRequestSql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, requestId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return false;
                        }

                        requestType = rs.getString("request_type");
                        currentStatus = rs.getString("request_status");
                        customerId = rs.getInt("user_id");
                        orderId = rs.getInt("order_id");
                    }
                }

                if (!"PENDING".equals(currentStatus)) {
                    conn.rollback();
                    return false;
                }

                if ("APPROVED".equals(newStatus)) {
                    if (!"RETURN".equals(requestType)
                            && !"EXCHANGE".equals(requestType)) {
                        throw new SQLException(
                                "Loại yêu cầu không hợp lệ.");
                    }

                    List<Map<String, Object>> items
                            = new ArrayList<>();

                    try (PreparedStatement ps
                            = conn.prepareStatement(getItemsSql)) {
                        ps.setInt(1, requestId);

                        try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                            while (rs.next()) {
                                Map<String, Object> item
                                        = new LinkedHashMap<>();

                                item.put("quantity",
                                        rs.getInt("quantity"));
                                item.put("exchangeSkuId",
                                        (Integer) rs.getObject(
                                                "exchange_sku_id"));
                                item.put("originalSkuId",
                                        rs.getInt("original_sku_id"));
                                item.put("originalProductId",
                                        rs.getInt("original_product_id"));

                                items.add(item);
                            }
                        }
                    }

                    if (items.isEmpty()) {
                        throw new SQLException(
                                "Yêu cầu không có sản phẩm.");
                    }

                    for (Map<String, Object> item : items) {
                        int quantity = (Integer) item.get("quantity");
                        int originalSkuId
                                = (Integer) item.get("originalSkuId");
                        int originalProductId
                                = (Integer) item.get("originalProductId");

                        if (quantity <= 0) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Số lượng sản phẩm không hợp lệ.");
                        }

                        if ("RETURN".equals(requestType)) {
                            try (PreparedStatement ps
                                    = conn.prepareStatement(addStockSql)) {
                                ps.setInt(1, quantity);
                                ps.setInt(2, originalSkuId);

                                if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                                    throw new SQLException(
                                            "Không cập nhật được tồn kho hàng trả.");
                                }
                            }
                        } else {
                            Integer exchangeSkuId
                                    = (Integer) item.get("exchangeSkuId");

                            if (exchangeSkuId == null
                                    || exchangeSkuId == originalSkuId) {
                                throw new SQLException(
                                        "SKU đổi không hợp lệ.");
                            }

                            try (PreparedStatement ps
                                    = conn.prepareStatement(getTargetSql)) {
                                ps.setInt(1, exchangeSkuId);

                                try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                                    if (!rs.next()
                                            || rs.getInt("product_id")
                                            != originalProductId) {
                                        throw new SQLException(
                                                "SKU đổi phải thuộc cùng sản phẩm.");
                                    }
                                }
                            }

                            try (PreparedStatement ps
                                    = conn.prepareStatement(subtractStockSql)) {
                                ps.setInt(1, quantity);
                                ps.setInt(2, exchangeSkuId);
                                ps.setInt(3, quantity);

                                if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                                    throw new SQLException(
                                            "SKU đổi không đủ tồn kho.");
                                }
                            }

                            try (PreparedStatement ps
                                    = conn.prepareStatement(addStockSql)) {
                                ps.setInt(1, quantity);
                                ps.setInt(2, originalSkuId);

                                if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                                    throw new SQLException(
                                            "Không cập nhật được tồn kho SKU cũ.");
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(updateRequestSql)) {
                    ps.setString(1, newStatus);
                    ps.setInt(2, staffId);
                    ps.setString(3, staffNote == null
                            ? null : staffNote.trim());
                    ps.setInt(4, requestId);

                    if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                        throw new SQLException(
                                "Không cập nhật được trạng thái yêu cầu.");
                    }
                }

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(historySql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, requestId);
                    ps.setString(2, newStatus);
                    ps.setInt(3, staffId);
                    ps.setString(4, staffNote == null
                            ? "" : staffNote.trim());
                    ps.executeUpdate();
                }

                NotificationDAO notificationDAO = new NotificationDAO();

                notificationDAO.createReturnExchangeNotification(
                        conn,
                        customerId,
                        orderId,
                        requestType,
                        newStatus
                );

                conn.commit();
                return true;

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException ex) {
                conn.rollback();
                throw ex;
            } finally {
                conn.setAutoCommit(true);
            }
        }
    }

    public Map<String, Object> getLatestRequestByOrder(
            int orderId, int userId) throws SQLException {

        String sql
                = "SELECT TOP 1 request_id, request_type, "
                + "request_status, reason, created_at, "
                + "reviewed_at, staff_note "
                + "FROM dbo.RETURN_REQUEST "
                + "WHERE order_id = ? AND user_id = ? "
                + "ORDER BY created_at DESC, request_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setInt(1, orderId);
            ps.setInt(2, userId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    Map<String, Object> request = new LinkedHashMap<>();

                    request.put("requestId", rs.getInt("request_id"));
                    request.put("requestType", rs.getString("request_type"));
                    request.put("requestStatus", rs.getString("request_status"));
                    request.put("reason", rs.getString("reason"));
                    request.put("createdAt", rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));
                    request.put("reviewedAt", rs.getTimestamp("reviewed_at"));
                    request.put("staffNote", rs.getString("staff_note"));

                    return request;
                }
            }
        }

        return null;
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class ReviewReportDAO extends DBContext {

    private static final int MAX_REPORTS_PER_DAY = 5;

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getAllReports()
            throws SQLException {

        List<Map<String, Object>> reports = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT rr.report_id, rr.review_id, "
                + "rr.reported_by, reporter.username AS reporter_name, "
                + "rr.reason, rr.report_status, rr.created_at, "
                + "rr.resolved_by, resolver.username AS resolver_name, "
                + "rr.resolved_at, "
                + "author.username AS review_author, "
                + "pr.rating, pr.comment, pr.is_hidden, "
                + "p.product_name, ps.sku_code "
                + "FROM dbo.REVIEW_REPORTS rr "
                + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS pr "
                + "ON rr.review_id = pr.review_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.[USER] reporter "
                + "ON rr.reported_by = reporter.user_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.[USER] resolver "
                + "ON rr.resolved_by = resolver.user_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.[USER] author "
                + "ON pr.user_id = author.user_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU ps "
                + "ON pr.sku_id = ps.sku_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN dbo.PRODUCT p "
                + "ON ps.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "ORDER BY CASE WHEN rr.report_status = 'PENDING' "
                + "THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, rr.created_at DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {

                Map<String, Object> report = new HashMap<>();

                report.put("reportId", rs.getInt("report_id"));
                report.put("reviewId", rs.getInt("review_id"));
                report.put("reporterName",
                        rs.getString("reporter_name"));
                report.put("reason", rs.getString("reason"));
                report.put("status", rs.getString("report_status"));
                report.put("createdAt",
                        rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));
                report.put("resolverName",
                        rs.getString("resolver_name"));
                report.put("resolvedAt",
                        rs.getTimestamp("resolved_at"));
                report.put("reviewAuthor",
                        rs.getString("review_author"));
                report.put("rating", rs.getInt("rating"));
                report.put("comment", rs.getString("comment"));
                report.put("isHidden", rs.getBoolean("is_hidden"));
                report.put("productName",
                        rs.getString("product_name"));
                report.put("skuCode", rs.getString("sku_code"));

                reports.add(report);
            }
        }

        return reports;
    }

   
    public String createReport(
            int reviewId,
            int productId,
            int reportedBy,
            String reason) throws SQLException {

        if (reviewId <= 0
                || productId <= 0
                || reportedBy <= 0
                || reason == null
                || reason.trim().isEmpty()
                || reason.trim().length() > 500) {

            return "INVALID";
        }

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {

                
                String lockUserSql
                        = "SELECT user_id "
                        + "FROM dbo.[USER] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE user_id = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(lockUserSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, reportedBy);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return "INVALID";
                        }
                    }
                }

                
                String findReview
                        = "SELECT pr.user_id, pr.is_hidden "
                        + "FROM dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS pr "
                        + "WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU ps "
                        + "ON pr.sku_id = ps.sku_id "
                        + "WHERE pr.review_id = ? "
                        + "AND ps.product_id = ?";

                Integer ownerId = null;
                boolean isHidden = false;

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(findReview)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, reviewId);
                    ps.setInt(2, productId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                        if (rs.next()) {
                            ownerId = rs.getInt("user_id");
                            isHidden = rs.getBoolean("is_hidden");
                        }
                    }
                }

              
                if (ownerId == null || isHidden) {
                    conn.rollback();
                    return "NOT_FOUND";
                }

                
                if (ownerId == reportedBy) {
                    conn.rollback();
                    return "OWN_REVIEW";
                }

                
                String checkPending
                        = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total "
                        + "FROM dbo.REVIEW_REPORTS "
                        + "WHERE review_id = ? "
                        + "AND reported_by = ? "
                        + "AND report_status = 'PENDING'";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(checkPending)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, reviewId);
                    ps.setInt(2, reportedBy);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                        if (rs.next()
                                && rs.getInt("total") > 0) {

                            conn.rollback();
                            return "DUPLICATE";
                        }
                    }
                }

                
                String countReportsSql
                        = "SELECT COUNT(*) AS total "
                        + "FROM dbo.REVIEW_REPORTS "
                        + "WHERE reported_by = ? "
                        + "AND created_at >= "
                        + "DATEADD(HOUR, -24, GETDATE())";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(countReportsSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, reportedBy);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                        if (rs.next()) {

                            int totalReports
                                    = rs.getInt("total");

                            if (totalReports
                                    >= MAX_REPORTS_PER_DAY) {

                                conn.rollback();
                                return "RATE_LIMIT";
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                
                String insertSql
                        = "INSERT INTO dbo.REVIEW_REPORTS "
                        + "(review_id, reported_by, reason, "
                        + "report_status, created_at) "
                        + "VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'PENDING', GETDATE())";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(insertSql)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, reviewId);
                    ps.setInt(2, reportedBy);
                    ps.setString(3, reason.trim());

                    if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                        conn.rollback();
                        return "FAILED";
                    }
                }

                conn.commit();
                return "SUCCESS";

            } catch (SQLException e) {

                conn.rollback();

                if (e.getErrorCode() == 2601
                        || e.getErrorCode() == 2627) {

                    return "DUPLICATE";
                }

                throw e;

            } catch (RuntimeException e) {

                conn.rollback();
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    
    public boolean resolveReport(
            int reportId,
            int staffId,
            String decision) throws SQLException {

        String newStatus;

        if ("HIDE".equals(decision)) {
            newStatus = "RESOLVED";

        } else if ("DISMISS".equals(decision)) {
            newStatus = "REJECTED";

        } else {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Quyết định không hợp lệ.");
        }

        try (Connection conn = getConnection()) {

            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {

                int reviewId;

                String findReport
                        = "SELECT review_id "
                        + "FROM dbo.REVIEW_REPORTS "
                        + "WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE report_id = ? "
                        + "AND report_status = 'PENDING'";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(findReport)) {

                    ps.setInt(1, reportId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return false;
                        }

                        reviewId = rs.getInt("review_id");
                    }
                }

               
                if ("HIDE".equals(decision)) {

                    String hideSql
                            = "UPDATE dbo.PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                            + "SET is_hidden = 1 "
                            + "WHERE review_id = ?";

                    try (PreparedStatement ps
                            = conn.prepareStatement(hideSql)) {

                        ps.setInt(1, reviewId);

                        if (ps.executeUpdate() == 0) {
                            conn.rollback();
                            return false;
                        }
                    }
                }

               
                String updateReport
                        = "UPDATE dbo.REVIEW_REPORTS "
                        + "SET report_status = ?, "
                        + "resolved_by = ?, "
                        + "resolved_at = GETDATE() "
                        + "WHERE report_id = ? "
                        + "AND report_status = 'PENDING'";

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(updateReport)) {

                    ps.setString(1, newStatus);
                    ps.setInt(2, staffId);
                    ps.setInt(3, reportId);

                    if (ps.executeUpdate() == 0) {
                        conn.rollback();
                        return false;
                    }
                }

                conn.commit();
                return true;

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                conn.rollback();
                throw e;
            }
        }
    }
}
package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import model.Brand;
import model.Category;
import model.Product;
import model.ProductSku;
import model.ProductSpec;

import java.sql.Connection;

import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;

import java.util.List;
import java.util.logging.Level;
import java.util.logging.Logger;
import model.ProductImage;

public class ShopDAO extends DBContext {

    public List<Product> getCatalogProducts() {
        List<Product> list = new ArrayList<>();
        String sql = "SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.created_at, p.image_url, "
                + "c.category_id, c.category_name, "
                + "b.brand_id, b.brand_name, "
                + "(SELECT ISNULL(MIN(price), 0) FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE product_id = p.product_id) as min_price "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "ORDER BY p.product_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql); ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                Category category = new Category(rs.getInt("category_id"), rs.getString("category_name"), null);
                Brand brand = new Brand(rs.getInt("brand_id"), rs.getString("brand_name"), null);
                Product product = new Product(
                        rs.getInt("product_id"),
                        rs.getInt("category_id"),
                        rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                        rs.getString("product_name"),
                        rs.getString("description"),
                        rs.getTimestamp("created_at"),
                        category, brand
                );
                product.setImageUrl(rs.getString("image_url")); 
                product.setMinPrice(rs.getDouble("min_price"));
                list.add(product);
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ShopDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi lấy Catalog!", ex);
        }
        return list;
    }

    public Product getProductDetail(int id) {
        String sql = "SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.created_at, p.image_url, "
                + "c.category_id, c.category_name, b.brand_id, b.brand_name "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "WHERE p.product_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            statement.setInt(1, id);
            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                if (rs.next()) {
                    Category category = new Category(rs.getInt("category_id"), rs.getString("category_name"), null);
                    Brand brand = new Brand(rs.getInt("brand_id"), rs.getString("brand_name"), null);
                    Product product = new Product(
                            rs.getInt("product_id"), rs.getInt("category_id"), rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                            rs.getString("product_name"), rs.getString("description"),
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at"), category, brand
                    );
                    product.setImageUrl(rs.getString("image_url")); // Đồng bộ hình ảnh
                    return product;
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ShopDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi chi tiết SP!", ex);
        }
        return null;
    }

    public List<ProductSku> getProductSkus(int productId) {
        List<ProductSku> list = new ArrayList<>();
        String sql = "SELECT sku_id, product_id, sku_code, price, stock_quantity FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE product_id = ? ORDER BY price ASC";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            statement.setInt(1, productId);
            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(new ProductSku(
                            rs.getInt("sku_id"), rs.getInt("product_id"),
                            rs.getString("sku_code"), rs.getDouble("price"),
                            rs.getInt("stock_quantity")
                    ));
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ShopDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi lấy SKU!", ex);
        }
        return list;
    }

    public List<ProductSpec> getProductSpecs(int productId) {
        List<ProductSpec> list = new ArrayList<>();
        String sql = "SELECT a.attribute_name, ps.value FROM PRODUCT_SPECIFICATION ps "
                + "INNER JOIN ATTRIBUTE a ON ps.attribute_id = a.attribute_id "
                + "WHERE ps.product_id = ?";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            statement.setInt(1, productId);
            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(new ProductSpec(rs.getString("attribute_name"), rs.getString("value")));
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ShopDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi lấy Specs!", ex);
        }
        return list;
    }

    public List<Product> searchProducts(String keyword) {
        List<Product> list = new ArrayList<>();
        String sql = "SELECT TOP 5 p.product_id, p.product_name, p.image_url, "
                + "(SELECT ISNULL(MIN(price), 0) FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE product_id = p.product_id) as min_price "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "WHERE p.product_name LIKE ? OR p.description LIKE ? OR b.brand_name LIKE ? "
                + "ORDER BY p.product_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            String searchPattern = "%" + keyword + "%";
            statement.setNString(1, searchPattern);
            statement.setNString(2, searchPattern);
            statement.setNString(3, searchPattern);

            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Product p = new Product();
                    p.setProductId(rs.getInt("product_id"));
                    p.setProductName(rs.getString("product_name"));
                    p.setImageUrl(rs.getString("image_url")); // Đồng bộ hình ảnh
                    p.setMinPrice(rs.getDouble("min_price"));
                    list.add(p);
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ShopDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi tìm kiếm sản phẩm!", ex);
        }
        return list;
    }

    public List<Product> searchFullCatalog(String keyword) {
        List<Product> list = new ArrayList<>();
        String sql = "SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.created_at, p.image_url, "
                + "c.category_id, c.category_name, "
                + "b.brand_id, b.brand_name, "
                + "(SELECT ISNULL(MIN(price), 0) FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE product_id = p.product_id) as min_price "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "WHERE p.product_name LIKE ? OR c.category_name LIKE ? "
                + "ORDER BY p.product_id DESC";

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement statement = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            String searchPattern = "%" + keyword + "%";
            statement.setNString(1, searchPattern);
            statement.setNString(2, searchPattern);

            try (ResultSet rs = statement.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Category category = new Category(rs.getInt("category_id"), rs.getString("category_name"), null);
                    Brand brand = new Brand(rs.getInt("brand_id"), rs.getString("brand_name"), null);
                    Product product = new Product(
                            rs.getInt("product_id"), rs.getInt("category_id"), rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                            rs.getString("product_name"), rs.getString("description"),
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at"), category, brand
                    );
                    product.setImageUrl(rs.getString("image_url")); // Đồng bộ hình ảnh
                    product.setMinPrice(rs.getDouble("min_price"));
                    list.add(product);
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ShopDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi tìm kiếm danh mục/sản phẩm!", ex);
        }
        return list;
    }

  
    public List<Product> getFilteredCatalog(String keyword, String[] categoryIds, String priceRange, String sort) {
        List<Product> list = new ArrayList<>();
        StringBuilder sql = new StringBuilder(
                "SELECT p.product_id, p.product_name, p.description, p.created_at, p.image_url, "
                + "c.category_id, c.category_name, b.brand_id, b.brand_name, "
                + "(SELECT ISNULL(MIN(price), 0) FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE product_id = p.product_id) as min_price "
                + "FROM PRODUCT p "
                + "INNER JOIN CATEGORY c ON p.category_id = c.category_id "
                + "INNER JOIN BRAND b ON p.brand_id = b.brand_id "
                + "WHERE 1=1 "
        );

        List<Object> parameters = new ArrayList<>();

        if (keyword != null && !keyword.trim().isEmpty()) {
            sql.append("AND (p.product_name LIKE ? OR p.description LIKE ? OR c.category_name LIKE ? OR b.brand_name LIKE ?) ");
            String searchPattern = "%" + keyword.trim() + "%";
            parameters.add(searchPattern);
            parameters.add(searchPattern);
            parameters.add(searchPattern);
            parameters.add(searchPattern);
        }

        if (categoryIds != null && categoryIds.length > 0) {
            sql.append("AND (");
            for (int i = 0; i < categoryIds.length; i++) {
                sql.append("c.category_id = ? OR c.parent_id = ?");
                parameters.add(Integer.parseInt(categoryIds[i]));
                parameters.add(Integer.parseInt(categoryIds[i]));
                if (i < categoryIds.length - 1) {
                    sql.append(" OR ");
                }
            }
            sql.append(") ");
        }

        if (priceRange != null) {
            if ("under5".equals(priceRange)) {
                sql.append("AND (SELECT ISNULL(MIN(price), 0) FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE product_id = p.product_id) > 0 ");
                sql.append("AND (SELECT ISNULL(MIN(price), 0) FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE product_id = p.product_id) < 5000000 ");
            } else if ("5to15".equals(priceRange)) {
                sql.append("AND (SELECT ISNULL(MIN(price), 0) FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE product_id = p.product_id) BETWEEN 5000000 AND 15000000 ");
            } else if ("over15".equals(priceRange)) {
                sql.append("AND (SELECT ISNULL(MIN(price), 0) FROM PRODUCT_SKU WHERE product_id = p.product_id) > 15000000 ");
            }
        }

        if ("priceAsc".equals(sort)) {
            sql.append("ORDER BY min_price ASC ");
        } else if ("priceDesc".equals(sort)) {
            sql.append("ORDER BY min_price DESC ");
        } else {
            sql.append("ORDER BY p.product_id DESC "); 
        }

        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql.toString())) {

            for (int i = 0; i < parameters.size(); i++) {
                if (parameters.get(i) instanceof String) {
                    ps.setNString(i + 1, (String) parameters.get(i));
                } else if (parameters.get(i) instanceof Integer) {
                    ps.setInt(i + 1, (Integer) parameters.get(i));
                }
            }

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    Category cat = new Category(rs.getInt("category_id"), rs.getString("category_name"), null);
                    Brand brand = new Brand(rs.getInt("brand_id"), rs.getString("brand_name"), null);
                    Product product = new Product(
                            rs.getInt("product_id"), rs.getInt("category_id"), rs.getInt("brand_id"),
                            rs.getString("product_name"), rs.getString("description"),
                            rs.getTimestamp("created_at"), cat, brand
                    );
                    product.setImageUrl(rs.getString("image_url")); 
                    product.setMinPrice(rs.getDouble("min_price"));
                    list.add(product);
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException ex) {
            Logger.getLogger(ShopDAO.class.getName()).log(Level.SEVERE, "Lỗi khi lọc sản phẩm!", ex);
        }
        return list;
    }

    public List<ProductImage> getProductImages(int productId) {
        List<ProductImage> list = new ArrayList<>();
        String sql = "SELECT image_id, product_id, image_url FROM PRODUCT_IMAGES WHERE product_id = ?";
        try (Connection conn = this.getConnection(); PreparedStatement stm = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            stm.setInt(1, productId);
            try (ResultSet rs = stm.executeQuery()) {
                while (rs.next()) {
                    list.add(new ProductImage(rs.getInt("image_id"), rs.getInt("product_id"), rs.getString("image_url")));
                }
            }
        } catch (SQLException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
        return list;
    }

package dao;

import db.DBContext;
import java.sql.Connection;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class StaffReviewDAO extends DBContext {

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getAllReviewsForStaff()
            throws SQLException {

        List<Map<String, Object>> reviews = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql = "SELECT pr.review_id, pr.user_id, "
                + "u.username AS reviewer_name, "
                + "pr.order_item_id, pr.sku_id, "
                + "ps.sku_code, p.product_name, "
                + "pr.rating, pr.comment, pr.created_at, "
                + "pr.is_hidden "
                + "FROM PRODUCT_REVIEWS pr "
                + "LEFT JOIN [USER] u ON pr.user_id = u.user_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_SKU ps ON pr.sku_id = ps.sku_id "
                + "LEFT JOIN PRODUCT p ON ps.product_id = p.product_id "
                + "ORDER BY pr.created_at DESC";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql);
             ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {

            while (rs.next()) {
                Map<String, Object> review = new HashMap<>();

                review.put("reviewId", rs.getInt("review_id"));
                review.put("userId", rs.getInt("user_id"));
                review.put("reviewerName", rs.getString("reviewer_name"));
                review.put("orderItemId", rs.getInt("order_item_id"));
                review.put("skuId", rs.getInt("sku_id"));
                review.put("skuCode", rs.getString("sku_code"));
                review.put("productName", rs.getString("product_name"));
                review.put("rating", rs.getInt("rating"));
                review.put("comment", rs.getString("comment"));
                review.put("createdAt", rs.getTimestamp("created_at"));
                review.put("isHidden", rs.getBoolean("is_hidden"));

                reviews.add(review);
            }
        }

        return reviews;
    }

    public boolean setReviewHidden(int reviewId, boolean hidden)
            throws SQLException {

        String sql = "UPDATE PRODUCT_REVIEWS "
                + "SET is_hidden = ? "
                + "WHERE review_id = ?";

        try (Connection conn = getConnection();
             PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setBoolean(1, hidden);
            ps.setInt(2, reviewId);

            return ps.executeUpdate() > 0;
        }
    }

    public List<Voucher> getAvailableVouchers(
            double orderTotal,
            int userId) {

        List<Voucher> list
                = new ArrayList<>();

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "v.voucher_id, "
                + "v.code, "
                + "v.min_order_value, "
                + "v.valid_from, "
                + "v.valid_to, "
                + "v.discount_type, "
                + "v.discount_value, "
                + "v.max_discount, "
                + "v.usage_limit, "
                + "v.per_user_limit "
                + "FROM VOUCHER v "
                + "WHERE v.valid_from <= GETDATE() "
                + "AND v.valid_to >= GETDATE() "
                + "AND v.min_order_value <= ? "
                + "AND ( "
                + "v.usage_limit IS NULL "
                + "OR ( "
                + "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM VOUCHER_USAGES vu "
                + "WHERE vu.voucher_id = v.voucher_id "
                + ") < v.usage_limit "
                + ") "
                + "AND ( "
                + "v.per_user_limit IS NULL "
                + "OR ( "
                + "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM VOUCHER_USAGES vu2 "
                + "WHERE vu2.voucher_id = v.voucher_id "
                + "AND vu2.user_id = ? "
                + ") < v.per_user_limit "
                + ") "
                + "ORDER BY v.discount_value DESC";

        try (
                Connection conn
                = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setDouble(
                    1,
                    orderTotal
            );

            ps.setInt(
                    2,
                    userId
            );

            try (
                    ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                while (rs.next()) {

                    list.add(
                            mapVoucher(rs)
                    );
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {

            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return list;
    }

    public Voucher getValidVoucher(
            String code,
            double orderTotal,
            int userId) {

        if (code == null
                || code.trim().isEmpty()) {

            return null;
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT "
                + "v.voucher_id, "
                + "v.code, "
                + "v.min_order_value, "
                + "v.valid_from, "
                + "v.valid_to, "
                + "v.discount_type, "
                + "v.discount_value, "
                + "v.max_discount, "
                + "v.usage_limit, "
                + "v.per_user_limit "
                + "FROM VOUCHER v "
                + "WHERE UPPER(v.code) = UPPER(?) "
                + "AND v.valid_from <= GETDATE() "
                + "AND v.valid_to >= GETDATE() "
                + "AND v.min_order_value <= ? "
                + "AND ( "
                + "v.usage_limit IS NULL "
                + "OR ( "
                + "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM VOUCHER_USAGES vu "
                + "WHERE vu.voucher_id = v.voucher_id "
                + ") < v.usage_limit "
                + ") "
                + "AND ( "
                + "v.per_user_limit IS NULL "
                + "OR ( "
                + "SELECT COUNT(*) "
                + "FROM VOUCHER_USAGES vu2 "
                + "WHERE vu2.voucher_id = v.voucher_id "
                + "AND vu2.user_id = ? "
                + ") < v.per_user_limit "
                + ")";

        try (
                Connection conn
                = getConnection(); PreparedStatement ps
                = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

            ps.setString(
                    1,
                    code.trim()
            );

            ps.setDouble(
                    2,
                    orderTotal
            );

            ps.setInt(
                    3,
                    userId
            );

            try (
                    ResultSet rs
                    = ps.executeQuery()) {

                if (rs.next()) {

                    return mapVoucher(rs);
                }
            }

        } catch (SQLException e) {

            e.printStackTrace();
        }

        return null;
    }

    public Voucher getAvailableVoucherById(

            int userId) {

        Voucher voucher
                = getVoucherById(

                );

        if (voucher == null) {

            return null;

        return getValidVoucher(
                voucher.getCode(),
                orderTotal,
                userId
        );
    }
