    public int placeOrder(
            int userId,
            int addressId,
            String checkoutToken,
            String voucherCode,
            List<Integer> selectedCartItemIds,
            String paymentMethod
    ) throws SQLException {

        PaymentGateway.requireConfigured(paymentMethod);

        if (userId <= 0
                || addressId <= 0
                || checkoutToken == null
                || !checkoutToken.matches("[0-9a-fA-F-]{36}")) {

            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Yêu cầu đặt hàng không hợp lệ. "
                    + "Vui lòng tải lại Checkout."
            );
        }

        boolean selectedMode = selectedCartItemIds != null;
        List<Integer> selectedIds = new ArrayList<>();

        if (selectedMode) {
            for (Integer id : selectedCartItemIds) {
                if (id != null
                        && id > 0
                        && !selectedIds.contains(id)) {
                    selectedIds.add(id);
                }
            }

            if (selectedIds.isEmpty()) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                        "Vui lòng chọn sản phẩm để đặt hàng."
                );
            }
        }

        try (Connection conn = connections.open()) {
            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException(
                        "Không kết nối được database."
                );
            }

            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                policy.lockCustomer(conn, userId);
                int cartId;

                String sql
                        = "SELECT cart_id "
                        + "FROM dbo.CART WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE user_id = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, userId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                    "Giỏ hàng không tồn tại."
                            );
                        }

                        cartId = rs.getInt("cart_id");
                    }
                }

                Integer existingOrderId = orderDAO.findIdByToken(
                        conn,
                        userId,
                        checkoutToken
                );

                if (existingOrderId != null) {
                    conn.commit();
                    return existingOrderId;
                }

                policy.requireAllowed(conn, userId);

                Order order = new Order();
                order.setUserId(userId);
                order.setAddressId(addressId);

                sql
                        = "SELECT recipient_name, phone_number, address_line "
                        + "FROM dbo.ADDRESSBOOK WITH (HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE address_id = ? "
                        + "AND user_id = ? "
                        + "AND is_deleted = 0";

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, addressId);
                    ps.setInt(2, userId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                    "Địa chỉ không tồn tại hoặc đã bị xóa."
                            );
                        }

                        order.setRecipientName(
                                rs.getString("recipient_name")
                        );
                        order.setRecipientPhone(
                                rs.getString("phone_number")
                        );
                        order.setShippingAddress(
                                rs.getString("address_line")
                        );
                    }
                }

                List<CartLine> lines = new ArrayList<>();
                BigDecimal subtotal = BigDecimal.ZERO;

                StringBuilder itemsSql = new StringBuilder(
                        "SELECT ci.cart_item_id, ci.sku_id, "
                        + "ci.quantity, s.price "
                        + "FROM dbo.CART_ITEMS ci "
                        + "WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "JOIN dbo.PRODUCT_SKU s "
                        + "WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "ON s.sku_id = ci.sku_id "
                        + "WHERE ci.cart_id = ? "
                );

                if (selectedMode) {
                    itemsSql.append("AND ci.cart_item_id IN (");

                    for (int i = 0; i < selectedIds.size(); i++) {
                        if (i > 0) {
                            itemsSql.append(",");
                        }

                        itemsSql.append("?");
                    }

                    itemsSql.append(") ");
                }

                itemsSql.append("ORDER BY ci.cart_item_id");

                try (PreparedStatement ps
                        = conn.prepareStatement(itemsSql.toString())) {

                    int index = 1;
                    ps.setInt(index++, cartId);

                    if (selectedMode) {
                        for (Integer id : selectedIds) {
                            ps.setInt(index++, id);
                        }
                    }

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        while (rs.next()) {
                            int cartItemId = rs.getInt("cart_item_id");
                            int skuId = rs.getInt("sku_id");
                            int quantity = rs.getInt("quantity");
                            BigDecimal price = rs.getBigDecimal("price");

                            if (quantity <= 0
                                    || price == null
                                    || price.signum() < 0) {

                                throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                        "Sản phẩm trong giỏ hàng "
                                        + "không hợp lệ."
                                );
                            }

                            lines.add(new CartLine(
                                    cartItemId,
                                    skuId,
                                    quantity,
                                    price
                            ));

                            subtotal = subtotal.add(
                                    price.multiply(
                                            BigDecimal.valueOf(quantity)
                                    )
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (lines.isEmpty()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            selectedMode
                                    ? "Không tìm thấy sản phẩm đã chọn."
                                    : "Giỏ hàng đang trống."
                    );
                }

                if (selectedMode && lines.size() != selectedIds.size()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Một số sản phẩm đã chọn "
                            + "không còn trong giỏ hàng."
                    );
                }

                long totalQuantity = 0;
                for (CartLine line : lines) {
                    totalQuantity += line.quantity;
                }
                if (totalQuantity > 5) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException("Mỗi đơn được mua tối đa 5 sản phẩm tính theo tổng số lượng.");
                }

                VoucherResult voucher = lockAndCalculateVoucher(
                        conn,
                        userId,
                        voucherCode,
                        subtotal
                );

                BigDecimal shippingFee = calculateShippingFee(subtotal);

                BigDecimal totalAmount = subtotal
                        .add(shippingFee)
                        .subtract(voucher.discount)
                        .max(BigDecimal.ZERO);

                sql
                        = "UPDATE dbo.PRODUCT_SKU "
                        + "SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity - ? "
                        + "WHERE sku_id = ? "
                        + "AND stock_quantity >= ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                    for (CartLine line : lines) {
                        ps.setInt(1, line.quantity);
                        ps.setInt(2, line.skuId);
                        ps.setInt(3, line.quantity);

                        if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                    "Sản phẩm SKU " + line.skuId
                                    + " không đủ số lượng tồn kho."
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }

                order.setShippingFee(shippingFee);
                order.setDiscountAmount(voucher.discount);
                order.setTotalAmount(totalAmount);
                order.setPaymentMethod(paymentMethod);

                boolean pendingPayment
                        = !"COD".equals(paymentMethod)
                        && totalAmount.signum() > 0;

                order.setOrderStatus(
                        pendingPayment
                                ? "PENDING_PAYMENT"
                                : "PENDING_CONFIRMATION"
                );

                order.setPaymentStatus(
                        totalAmount.signum() == 0
                        ? "PAID"
                        : "UNPAID"
                );

                int orderId = orderDAO.insert(
                        conn,
                        order,
                        checkoutToken
                );

                if (orderId <= 0) {
                    throw new SQLException(
                            "Không thể tạo đơn hàng."
                    );
                }

                if (pendingPayment) {
                    sql
                            = "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                            + "SET payment_expires_at = "
                            + "DATEADD(MINUTE, 15, SYSUTCDATETIME()) "
                            + "WHERE order_id = ?";

                    try (PreparedStatement ps
                            = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                        ps.setInt(1, orderId);

                        if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Không lưu được hạn thanh toán."
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }

                for (CartLine line : lines) {
                    orderDAO.insertItem(
                            conn,
                            orderId,
                            line.skuId,
                            line.price,
                            line.quantity
                    );
                }

                orderDAO.addHistory(
                        conn,
                        orderId,
                        order.getOrderStatus()
                );

                if (voucher.id != null) {
                    sql
                            = "INSERT INTO dbo.VOUCHER_USAGES "
                            + "(voucher_id, order_id, user_id) "
                            + "VALUES (?, ?, ?)";

                    try (PreparedStatement ps
                            = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {

                        ps.setInt(1, voucher.id);
                        ps.setInt(2, orderId);
                        ps.setInt(3, userId);

                        if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Không lưu được lượt sử dụng voucher."
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }

                sql
                        = "DELETE FROM dbo.CART_ITEMS "
                        + "WHERE cart_id = ? AND cart_item_id = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                    for (CartLine line : lines) {
                        ps.setInt(1, cartId);
                        ps.setInt(2, line.cartItemId);

                        if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Không xóa được sản phẩm "
                                    + "đã đặt khỏi giỏ hàng."
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }

                conn.commit();
                return orderId;

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackError) {
                    e.addSuppressed(rollbackError);
                }

                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    private VoucherResult lockAndCalculateVoucher(
            Connection conn,
            int userId,
            String voucherCode,
            BigDecimal subtotal
    ) throws SQLException {

        if (voucherCode == null || voucherCode.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return new VoucherResult(null, BigDecimal.ZERO);
        }

        String sql
                = "SELECT voucher_id, discount_type, discount_value, "
                + "max_discount, usage_limit, per_user_limit "
                + "FROM dbo.VOUCHER WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                + "WHERE UPPER(code) = UPPER(?) "
                + "AND GETDATE() BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to "
                + "AND min_order_value <= ?";

        int voucherId;
        String discountType;
        BigDecimal discountValue;
        BigDecimal maxDiscount;
        Integer usageLimit;
        Integer perUserLimit;

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setString(1, voucherCode.trim());
            ps.setBigDecimal(2, subtotal);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                if (!rs.next()) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Voucher hết hạn hoặc đơn hàng "
                            + "chưa đủ điều kiện áp dụng."
                    );
                }

                voucherId = rs.getInt("voucher_id");
                discountType = rs.getString("discount_type");
                discountValue = rs.getBigDecimal("discount_value");
                maxDiscount = rs.getBigDecimal("max_discount");

                Object usageValue = rs.getObject("usage_limit");

                usageLimit = usageValue == null
                        ? null
                        : ((Number) usageValue).intValue();

                Object perUserValue = rs.getObject("per_user_limit");

                perUserLimit = perUserValue == null
                        ? null
                        : ((Number) perUserValue).intValue();
            }
        }

        if (discountValue == null || discountValue.signum() <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Voucher có giá trị giảm không hợp lệ."
            );
        }

        sql
                = "SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_used, "
                + "COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN user_id = ? "
                + "THEN CAST(1 AS bigint) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS user_used "
                + "FROM dbo.VOUCHER_USAGES "
                + "WHERE voucher_id = ?";

        try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
            ps.setInt(1, userId);
            ps.setInt(2, voucherId);

            try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                rs.next();

                long totalUsed = rs.getLong("total_used");
                long userUsed = rs.getLong("user_used");

                if (usageLimit != null && totalUsed >= usageLimit) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Voucher đã hết lượt sử dụng."
                    );
                }

                if (perUserLimit != null && userUsed >= perUserLimit) {
                    throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                            "Bạn đã dùng hết lượt của voucher này."
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        BigDecimal discount;

        if ("AMOUNT".equalsIgnoreCase(discountType)) {
            discount = discountValue;

        } else if ("PERCENT".equalsIgnoreCase(discountType)) {
            discount = subtotal
                    .multiply(discountValue)
                    .divide(
                            BigDecimal.valueOf(100),
                            2,
                            RoundingMode.HALF_UP
                    );

            if (maxDiscount != null) {
                discount = discount.min(maxDiscount);
            }

        } else {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Loại voucher không được hỗ trợ."
            );
        }

        discount = discount
                .max(BigDecimal.ZERO)
                .min(subtotal)
                .setScale(2, RoundingMode.HALF_UP);

        return new VoucherResult(voucherId, discount);
    }

    public boolean cancelOrderByCustomer(
            int userId,
            int orderId
    ) throws SQLException {

        if (userId <= 0 || orderId <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Mã đơn hàng không hợp lệ."
            );
        }

        try (Connection conn = connections.open()) {
            if (conn == null) {
                throw new SQLException(
                        "Không kết nối được database."
                );
            }

            conn.setAutoCommit(false);

            try {
                policy.lockCustomer(conn, userId);
                String sql
                        = "SELECT order_status, payment_method, "
                        + "payment_status, total_amount, stock_restored_at "
                        + "FROM dbo.[ORDER] WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK) "
                        + "WHERE order_id = ? AND user_id = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, orderId);
                    ps.setInt(2, userId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        if (!rs.next()) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                    "Không tìm thấy đơn hàng."
                            );
                        }

                        String status = normalizeStatus(
                                rs.getString("order_status")
                        );

                        if ("CANCELLED".equals(status)) {
                            conn.commit();
                            return false;
                        }

                        if (!"PENDING_CONFIRMATION".equals(status)) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                    "Chỉ được hủy đơn trước khi "
                                    + "nhân viên xác nhận."
                            );
                        }

                        boolean isCod = "COD".equalsIgnoreCase(
                                rs.getString("payment_method")
                        );

                        boolean paidPositiveAmount
                                = "PAID".equalsIgnoreCase(
                                        rs.getString("payment_status")
                                )
                                && rs.getBigDecimal("total_amount")
                                        .signum() > 0;

                        if (!isCod || paidPositiveAmount) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                    "Đơn này cần được hỗ trợ "
                                    + "xử lý thanh toán trước khi hủy."
                            );
                        }

                        if (rs.getTimestamp("stock_restored_at") != null) {
                            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                                    "Đơn đã được hoàn kho. "
                                    + "Vui lòng liên hệ hỗ trợ."
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }

                List<int[]> quantities = new ArrayList<>();

                sql
                        = "SELECT sku_id, SUM(quantity) AS quantity "
                        + "FROM dbo.ORDER_ITEM "
                        + "WHERE order_id = ? "
                        + "GROUP BY sku_id ORDER BY sku_id";

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, orderId);

                    try (ResultSet rs = ps.executeQuery()) {
                        while (rs.next()) {
                            int quantity = rs.getInt("quantity");

                            if (quantity <= 0) {
                                throw new SQLException(
                                        "Số lượng đơn hàng không hợp lệ."
                                );
                            }

                            quantities.add(new int[]{
                                rs.getInt("sku_id"),
                                quantity
                            });
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (quantities.isEmpty()) {
                    throw new SQLException(
                            "Đơn hàng không có chi tiết để hoàn kho."
                    );
                }

                sql
                        = "UPDATE dbo.PRODUCT_SKU "
                        + "SET stock_quantity = stock_quantity + ? "
                        + "WHERE sku_id = ?";

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                    for (int[] item : quantities) {
                        ps.setInt(1, item[1]);
                        ps.setInt(2, item[0]);

                        if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                            throw new SQLException(
                                    "Không hoàn được tồn kho."
                            );
                        }
                    }
                }

                sql
                        = "UPDATE dbo.[ORDER] "
                        + "SET order_status = 'CANCELLED', "
                        + "stock_restored_at = GETDATE() "
                        + "WHERE order_id = ? AND user_id = ? "
                        + "AND stock_restored_at IS NULL "
                        + "AND UPPER(order_status) "
                        + "IN ('PENDING_CONFIRMATION', 'PENDING')";

                try (PreparedStatement ps = conn.prepareStatement(sql)) {
                    ps.setInt(1, orderId);
                    ps.setInt(2, userId);

                    if (ps.executeUpdate() != 1) {
                        throw new SQLException(
                                "Trạng thái đơn hàng đã thay đổi."
                        );
                    }
                }

                orderDAO.addHistory(conn, orderId, "CANCELLED");
                policy.recordCancellation(conn, userId, orderId);

                conn.commit();
                return true;

            } catch (SQLException | RuntimeException e) {
                try {
                    conn.rollback();
                } catch (SQLException rollbackError) {
                    e.addSuppressed(rollbackError);
                }

                throw e;
            }
        }
    }

    public String orderingRestriction(int userId) throws SQLException {
        try (Connection conn = connections.open()) {
            return policy.restriction(conn, userId);
        }
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> findHistory(
            int orderId,
            int userId
    ) throws SQLException {

        List<Map<String, Object>> history
                = orderDAO.findHistory(orderId, userId);

        for (Map<String, Object> entry : history) {
            entry.put(
                    "label",
                    statusLabel((String) entry.get("status"))
            );
        }

        return history;
    }

    public static String normalizeStatus(String status) {
        if (status == null) {
            return "";
        }

        String value = status
                .trim()
                .toUpperCase(Locale.ROOT)
                .replace(' ', '_');

        return "PENDING".equals(value)
                ? "PENDING_CONFIRMATION"
                : value;
    }

    public static Map<String, String> statusLabels() {
        Map<String, String> labels = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        labels.put("PENDING_PAYMENT", "Chờ thanh toán");
        labels.put("PENDING_CONFIRMATION", "Chờ xác nhận");
        labels.put("CONFIRMED", "Đã xác nhận");
        labels.put("PACKING", "Đang đóng gói");
        labels.put("SHIPPING", "Đang giao hàng");
        labels.put("DELIVERED", "Đã giao hàng");
        labels.put("COMPLETED", "Hoàn tất");
        labels.put("CANCELLED", "Đã hủy");

        return labels;
    }

    public static String statusLabel(String status) {
        return statusLabels().getOrDefault(
                normalizeStatus(status),
                status
        );
    }

    public static Map<String, String> purchaseTabs() {
        Map<String, String> tabs = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        tabs.put("ALL", "Tất cả");
        tabs.put("PAYMENT", "Chờ thanh toán");
        tabs.put("PENDING", "Chờ xác nhận");
        tabs.put("PREPARING", "Đang chuẩn bị hàng");
        tabs.put("SHIPPING", "Đang giao");
        tabs.put("COMPLETED", "Hoàn thành");
        tabs.put("CANCELLED", "Đã hủy");

        return tabs;
    }

    public static List<String> statusesForTab(String tab) {
        switch (tab) {
            case "PAYMENT":
                return Collections.singletonList("PENDING_PAYMENT");

            case "PENDING":
                return Arrays.asList(
                        "PENDING",
                        "PENDING_CONFIRMATION"
                );

            case "PREPARING":
                return Arrays.asList("CONFIRMED", "PACKING");

            case "SHIPPING":
                return Collections.singletonList("SHIPPING");

            case "COMPLETED":
                return Arrays.asList("DELIVERED", "COMPLETED");

            case "CANCELLED":
                return Collections.singletonList("CANCELLED");

            default:
                return Collections.emptyList();
        }
    }

    public static Map<String, Long> purchaseTabCounts(
            Map<String, Long> statuses
    ) {
        Map<String, Long> counts = new LinkedHashMap<>();

        for (String tab : purchaseTabs().keySet()) {
            counts.put(tab, 0L);
        }

        for (Map.Entry<String, Long> entry : statuses.entrySet()) {
            counts.put(
                    "ALL",
                    counts.get("ALL") + entry.getValue()
            );

            for (String tab : purchaseTabs().keySet()) {
                if (statusesForTab(tab).contains(
                        normalizeStatus(entry.getKey())
                )) {
                    counts.put(
                            tab,
                            counts.get(tab) + entry.getValue()
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        return counts;
    }

    public static List<Map<String, Object>> trackingSteps(
            Order order,
            List<Map<String, Object>> history
    ) {
        List<String> states = Arrays.asList(
                "PENDING_CONFIRMATION",
                "CONFIRMED",
                "PACKING",
                "SHIPPING",
                "COMPLETED"
        );

        String status = normalizeStatus(order.getOrderStatus());

        int current = states.indexOf(
                "DELIVERED".equals(status)
                ? "COMPLETED"
                : status
        );

        if (current < 0) {
            return Collections.emptyList();
        }

        String[] labels = {
            "Đã đặt hàng",
            "Đã xác nhận",
            "Đang chuẩn bị",
            "Đang giao hàng",
            "Giao thành công"
        };

        String[] icons = {
            "receipt",
            "check2-circle",
            "box-seam",
            "truck",
            "house-check"
        };

        List<Map<String, Object>> steps = new ArrayList<>();

        for (int i = 0; i < states.size(); i++) {
            Map<String, Object> step = new LinkedHashMap<>();

            step.put("label", labels[i]);
            step.put("icon", icons[i]);
            step.put("done", i <= current);
            step.put("current", i == current);

            Object timestamp = i == 0
                    ? order.getCreatedAt()
                    : null;

            for (Map<String, Object> entry : history) {
                String recorded = normalizeStatus(
                        (String) entry.get("status")
                );

                if (states.get(i).equals(recorded)
                        || (i == 4 && "DELIVERED".equals(recorded))) {
                    timestamp = entry.get("updatedAt");
                }
            }

            step.put(
                    "at",
                    i <= current ? timestamp : null
            );

            steps.add(step);
        }

        return steps;
    }
}
package service;

import dao.PasswordResetDAO;
import dao.UserDAO;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
import java.security.MessageDigest;
import java.security.SecureRandom;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.util.Base64;
import model.PasswordResetToken;
import model.User;

public class PasswordResetService {

    private final UserDAO userDAO = new UserDAO();
    private final PasswordResetDAO passwordResetDAO = new PasswordResetDAO();

    private static final long TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES = 15;

    
    public String createResetToken(String email) throws Exception {

        if (email == null || email.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }

        User user = userDAO.findByEmail(email.trim());

        if (user == null) {
            return null;
        }

        passwordResetDAO.invalidateOldTokens(user.getUserId());

        String rawToken = generateToken();

        String tokenHash = hashToken(rawToken);

        long expireTime = System.currentTimeMillis()
                + TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES * 60 * 1000;

        Timestamp expiresAt = new Timestamp(expireTime);

        PasswordResetToken resetToken = new PasswordResetToken(
                user.getUserId(),
                tokenHash,
                expiresAt
        );

        boolean created = passwordResetDAO.createToken(resetToken);

        if (!created) {
            return null;
        }

        return rawToken;
    }

    public PasswordResetToken validateToken(String rawToken)
            throws Exception {

        if (rawToken == null || rawToken.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return null;
        }

        String tokenHash = hashToken(rawToken);

        return passwordResetDAO.findValidToken(tokenHash);
    }

    public boolean resetPassword(String rawToken, String newPassword)
            throws Exception {

        if (rawToken == null || rawToken.trim().isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }

        if (newPassword == null || newPassword.length() < 6) {
            return false;
        }

        PasswordResetToken token = validateToken(rawToken);

        if (token == null) {
            return false;
        }

        boolean passwordUpdated = userDAO.resetPassword(
                token.getUserId(),
                newPassword
        );

        if (!passwordUpdated) {
            return false;
        }

        return passwordResetDAO.markAsUsed(token.getResetId());
    }

    private String generateToken() {

        SecureRandom secureRandom = new SecureRandom();

        byte[] bytes = new byte[32];

        secureRandom.nextBytes(bytes);

        return Base64.getUrlEncoder()
                .withoutPadding()
                .encodeToString(bytes);
    }

    private String hashToken(String rawToken)
            throws Exception {

        MessageDigest digest =
                MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-256");

        byte[] hash = digest.digest(
                rawToken.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8)
        );

        StringBuilder result = new StringBuilder();

        for (byte b : hash) {
            result.append(String.format("%02x", b));
        }

        return result.toString();
    }
}

package service;

import dao.ReturnExchangeDAO;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;

public class ReturnExchangeService {

    private final ReturnExchangeDAO returnExchangeDAO;

    public ReturnExchangeService() {
        this.returnExchangeDAO = new ReturnExchangeDAO();
    }

    public ReturnExchangeService(ReturnExchangeDAO returnExchangeDAO) {
        this.returnExchangeDAO = returnExchangeDAO;
    }

    public boolean canRequest(int orderId, int userId) throws SQLException {
        return returnExchangeDAO.canRequest(orderId, userId);
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getOrderItems(
            int orderId, int userId) throws SQLException {

        if (!canRequest(orderId, userId)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Đơn hàng không đủ điều kiện đổi/trả hoặc đã quá hạn 7 ngày.");
        }

        return returnExchangeDAO.getOrderItems(orderId, userId);
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getExchangeSkus(
            int orderId, int orderItemId, int userId) throws SQLException {

        if (!canRequest(orderId, userId)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Đơn hàng không đủ điều kiện đổi/trả hoặc đã quá hạn 7 ngày.");
        }

        List<Map<String, Object>> orderItems =
                returnExchangeDAO.getOrderItems(orderId, userId);

        boolean itemBelongsToOrder = false;

        for (Map<String, Object> item : orderItems) {
            int currentOrderItemId = (Integer) item.get("orderItemId");

            if (currentOrderItemId == orderItemId) {
                itemBelongsToOrder = true;
                break;
            }
        }

        if (!itemBelongsToOrder) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Sản phẩm không thuộc đơn hàng này.");
        }

        return returnExchangeDAO.getExchangeSkus(orderItemId, userId);
    }

    public int createRequest(
            int orderId,
            int userId,
            String requestType,
            String reason,
            List<Map<String, Integer>> items) throws SQLException {

        if (!canRequest(orderId, userId)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Đơn hàng không đủ điều kiện đổi/trả hoặc đã quá hạn 7 ngày.");
        }

        if (requestType == null
                || (!requestType.equals("RETURN")
                && !requestType.equals("EXCHANGE"))) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Loại yêu cầu không hợp lệ.");
        }

        if (reason == null || reason.trim().isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Vui lòng nhập lý do đổi/trả hàng.");
        }

        if (items == null || items.isEmpty()) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
                    "Vui lòng chọn ít nhất một sản phẩm.");
        }

        return returnExchangeDAO.createRequest(
                orderId,
                userId,
                requestType,
                reason.trim(),
                items
        );
    }
    
    
    public List<Map<String, Object>> getAllRequests() throws SQLException {
        return returnExchangeDAO.getAllRequests();
    }

    public List<Map<String, Object>> getRequestItems(int requestId) throws SQLException {
        if (requestId <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Mã yêu cầu không hợp lệ.");
        }

        return returnExchangeDAO.getRequestItems(requestId);
    }

    public boolean reviewRequest(
            int requestId,
            int staffId,
            String newStatus,
            String staffNote) throws SQLException {

        if (requestId <= 0 || staffId <= 0) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Mã yêu cầu hoặc mã nhân viên không hợp lệ.");
        }

        if (!"APPROVED".equals(newStatus)
                && !"REJECTED".equals(newStatus)) {
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Trạng thái xử lý không hợp lệ.");
        }

        return returnExchangeDAO.reviewRequest(
                requestId, staffId, newStatus, staffNote);
    }

}

-- 1. USER AND ROLE MANAGEMENT
CREATE TABLE ROLES (
    role_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    role_name NVARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    description NVARCHAR(MAX)
);

CREATE TABLE [USER] (
    user_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    username VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    email VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
    phone VARCHAR(20),
    created_at DATETIME2 DEFAULT GETDATE(),
    is_active BIT NOT NULL CONSTRAINT DF_USER_IsActive DEFAULT (1)
);

CREATE TABLE USER_ROLES (
    user_id INT NOT NULL,
    role_id INT NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT PK_USER_ROLES PRIMARY KEY (user_id, role_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_UserRoles_User FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    CONSTRAINT FK_UserRoles_Role FOREIGN KEY (role_id)
        REFERENCES ROLES(role_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

CREATE TABLE STAFF (
    staff_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    department NVARCHAR(100),
    position NVARCHAR(100),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Staff_User FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- 2. ADDRESS BOOK

    address_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,

        CONSTRAINT DF_ADDRESSBOOK_is_deleted DEFAULT (0),
    CONSTRAINT FK_AddressBook_User FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- 3. PRODUCT CATALOG

    brand_name NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    logo_url VARCHAR(2048)

    CONSTRAINT FK_Product_Category FOREIGN KEY (category_id)
        REFERENCES CATEGORY(category_id),

        REFERENCES BRAND(brand_id)

);

    partner_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    partner_name NVARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    contact_phone VARCHAR(20)
);

-- 6. VOUCHER
CREATE TABLE VOUCHER (
    voucher_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    min_order_value DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL
        CONSTRAINT DF_Voucher_MinOrder DEFAULT (0),
    valid_from DATETIME2 NOT NULL,
    valid_to DATETIME2 NOT NULL,
    discount_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    discount_value DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL,
    max_discount DECIMAL(18,2) NULL,
    usage_limit INT NULL,
    per_user_limit INT NULL,

    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_DiscountType
        CHECK (discount_type IN ('AMOUNT', 'PERCENT')),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_DiscountValue
        CHECK (discount_value > 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_MinOrder
        CHECK (min_order_value >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_ValidDate
        CHECK (valid_to > valid_from),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_MaxDiscount
        CHECK (max_discount IS NULL OR max_discount > 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_UsageLimit
        CHECK (usage_limit IS NULL OR usage_limit > 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_PerUserLimit
        CHECK (per_user_limit IS NULL OR per_user_limit > 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_PerUserVsTotal
        CHECK (
            usage_limit IS NULL
            OR per_user_limit IS NULL
            OR per_user_limit <= usage_limit
        ),
    CONSTRAINT CK_Voucher_MaxDiscountType
        CHECK (discount_type = 'PERCENT' OR max_discount IS NULL)
);

-- 7. ORDER
CREATE TABLE [ORDER] (
    order_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    user_id INT NOT NULL,
    address_id INT NOT NULL,
    shipping_partner_id INT,
    total_amount DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL,
    shipping_fee DECIMAL(18,2) DEFAULT (0),
    created_at DATETIME2 DEFAULT GETDATE(),
    order_status VARCHAR(30) NULL,
    payment_method VARCHAR(20) NULL,
    payment_status VARCHAR(30) NULL,
    payment_expires_at DATETIME2 NULL,
    recipient_name NVARCHAR(100) NULL,
    recipient_phone VARCHAR(20) NULL,
    shipping_address NVARCHAR(MAX) NULL,
    discount_amount DECIMAL(18,2) NULL,
    stock_restored_at DATETIME2 NULL,
    checkout_token VARCHAR(64) NULL,
    delivered_at DATETIME2 NULL,

    CONSTRAINT FK_Order_User FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Order_Address FOREIGN KEY (address_id)
        REFERENCES ADDRESSBOOK(address_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_Order_ShippingPartner FOREIGN KEY (shipping_partner_id)
        REFERENCES SHIPPING_PARTNER(partner_id)
);

CREATE TABLE ORDER_ITEM (
    order_item_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,

    sku_id INT NOT NULL,

    user_id INT NOT NULL,

        REFERENCES PRODUCT_REVIEWS(review_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_REVIEW_REPORTS_reporter FOREIGN KEY (reported_by)

        REFERENCES [USER](user_id)
);

    ON REVIEW_REPORTS(report_status, created_at DESC);

    ON REVIEW_REPORTS(review_id, reported_by)
    WHERE report_status = 'PENDING';

    ON PRODUCT_REVIEWS(sku_id, is_hidden, created_at DESC);

-- 12. PAYMENT TRANSACTIONS
CREATE TABLE PAYMENT_TRANSACTION (
    transaction_id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1)
        CONSTRAINT PK_PAYMENT_TRANSACTION PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id INT NOT NULL,
    payment_method VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    amount DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL,
    transaction_code VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,
    provider_transaction_id VARCHAR(150) NULL,
    status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL
        CONSTRAINT DF_PaymentTransaction_Status DEFAULT ('PENDING'),
    provider_response_code VARCHAR(100) NULL,
    created_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL
        CONSTRAINT DF_PaymentTransaction_Created DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()),
    completed_at DATETIME2 NULL,
    pay_url NVARCHAR(2048) NULL,

    CONSTRAINT FK_PaymentTransaction_Order FOREIGN KEY (order_id)
        REFERENCES [ORDER](order_id),
    CONSTRAINT UQ_PaymentTransaction_Code UNIQUE (transaction_code),
    CONSTRAINT CK_PaymentTransaction_Method
        CHECK (payment_method IN ('VNPAY', 'MOMO')),
    CONSTRAINT CK_PaymentTransaction_Amount CHECK (amount >= 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_PaymentTransaction_Status
        CHECK (status IN ('PENDING', 'SUCCESS', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED'))
);

CREATE TABLE ORDER_CUSTOMER_POLICY (
    user_id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES [USER](user_id),
    violation_count INT NOT NULL DEFAULT (0),
    blocked_until DATETIME2 NULL,
    CONSTRAINT CK_OrderCustomerPolicy_Count CHECK (violation_count BETWEEN 0 AND 3)
);

CREATE TABLE ORDER_CUSTOMER_CANCELLATION (
    order_id INT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES [ORDER](order_id),
    user_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES [USER](user_id),
    quantity BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (quantity > 0),
    cancelled_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME())
);
CREATE INDEX IX_OrderCustomerCancellation_UserTime
    ON ORDER_CUSTOMER_CANCELLATION(user_id, cancelled_at) INCLUDE (quantity);


CREATE TABLE PAYMENT_REFUND (
    refund_id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1)
        CONSTRAINT PK_PAYMENT_REFUND PRIMARY KEY,
    transaction_id BIGINT NOT NULL,
    refund_amount DECIMAL(18,2) NOT NULL,
    refund_status VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL
        CONSTRAINT DF_PaymentRefund_Status DEFAULT ('PENDING'),
    provider_refund_id VARCHAR(150) NULL,
    processed_by INT NULL REFERENCES [USER](user_id),
    updated_at DATETIME2 NULL,
    reason NVARCHAR(500) NULL,
    requested_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL
        CONSTRAINT DF_PaymentRefund_Requested DEFAULT (SYSUTCDATETIME()),
    completed_at DATETIME2 NULL,

    CONSTRAINT FK_PaymentRefund_Transaction FOREIGN KEY (transaction_id)
        REFERENCES PAYMENT_TRANSACTION(transaction_id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_PaymentRefund_Amount CHECK (refund_amount > 0),
    CONSTRAINT CK_PaymentRefund_Status
        CHECK (refund_status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING', 'SUCCESS', 'FAILED'))
);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_Payment_Provider_Success
    ON PAYMENT_TRANSACTION(payment_method, provider_transaction_id)
    WHERE status = 'SUCCESS' AND provider_transaction_id IS NOT NULL;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_Payment_Refund_Transaction
    ON PAYMENT_REFUND(transaction_id);

CREATE INDEX IX_PaymentTransaction_Order
    ON PAYMENT_TRANSACTION(order_id, created_at DESC);

CREATE INDEX IX_Order_Expiry
    ON [ORDER](order_status, payment_expires_at);

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_Order_CheckoutToken
    ON [ORDER](checkout_token)
    WHERE checkout_token IS NOT NULL;

    token_hash VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    expires_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL,
    used_at DATETIME2 NULL,
    created_at DATETIME2 DEFAULT GETDATE(),
    CONSTRAINT FK_PasswordReset_User FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
);

-- 14. AUDIT LOG
CREATE TABLE AUDIT_LOG (
    log_id BIGINT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    actor_user_id INT NULL,
    actor_identifier VARCHAR(150) NULL,
    action VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    entity_type VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL,
    entity_id BIGINT NULL,
    description NVARCHAR(500) NULL,
    ip_address VARCHAR(45) NULL,
    created_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL
        CONSTRAINT DF_AuditLog_CreatedAt DEFAULT (GETDATE()),

    CONSTRAINT FK_AuditLog_Actor FOREIGN KEY (actor_user_id)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id) ON DELETE SET NULL
);

-- 15. BANNER
CREATE TABLE BANNER (
    banner_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    image_url NVARCHAR(2048) NOT NULL,
    alt_text NVARCHAR(255) NULL,
    target_url NVARCHAR(2048) NULL,
    is_active BIT NOT NULL DEFAULT (1),
    display_order INT NOT NULL DEFAULT (0),
    created_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL DEFAULT (SYSDATETIME())
);

-- 16. RETURN / EXCHANGE REQUEST
CREATE TABLE RETURN_REQUEST (
    request_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id INT NOT NULL,
    user_id INT NOT NULL,
    request_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    reason NVARCHAR(1000) NOT NULL,
    request_status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT ('PENDING'),
    created_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL DEFAULT (GETDATE()),
    reviewed_by INT NULL,
    reviewed_at DATETIME2 NULL,
    staff_note NVARCHAR(1000) NULL,

    CONSTRAINT FK_RETURN_REQUEST_ORDER FOREIGN KEY (order_id)
        REFERENCES [ORDER](order_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_RETURN_REQUEST_USER FOREIGN KEY (user_id)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_RETURN_REQUEST_REVIEWER FOREIGN KEY (reviewed_by)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_RETURN_REQUEST_TYPE
        CHECK (request_type IN ('RETURN', 'EXCHANGE')),
    CONSTRAINT CK_RETURN_REQUEST_STATUS
        CHECK (request_status IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED'))
);

CREATE TABLE RETURN_REQUEST_ITEM (
    request_item_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    request_id INT NOT NULL,
    order_item_id INT NOT NULL,
    quantity INT NOT NULL,
    exchange_sku_id INT NULL,

    CONSTRAINT FK_RETURN_REQUEST_ITEM_REQUEST FOREIGN KEY (request_id)
        REFERENCES RETURN_REQUEST(request_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_RETURN_REQUEST_ITEM_ORDER_ITEM FOREIGN KEY (order_item_id)
        REFERENCES ORDER_ITEM(order_item_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_RETURN_REQUEST_ITEM_EXCHANGE_SKU FOREIGN KEY (exchange_sku_id)
        REFERENCES PRODUCT_SKU(sku_id),
    CONSTRAINT CK_RETURN_REQUEST_ITEM_QUANTITY CHECK (quantity > 0)
);

CREATE TABLE RETURN_REQUEST_HISTORY (
    history_id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    request_id INT NOT NULL,
    status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL,
    updated_by INT NULL,
    note NVARCHAR(1000) NULL,
    updated_at DATETIME2 NOT NULL DEFAULT (GETDATE()),

    CONSTRAINT FK_RETURN_REQUEST_HISTORY_REQUEST FOREIGN KEY (request_id)
        REFERENCES RETURN_REQUEST(request_id),
    CONSTRAINT FK_RETURN_REQUEST_HISTORY_USER FOREIGN KEY (updated_by)
        REFERENCES [USER](user_id)
);
GO
USE OECS;
GO

-- 17. SYNCHRONIZE ORDER RECIPIENT INFORMATION
UPDATE o
SET
    o.recipient_name = a.recipient_name,
    o.recipient_phone = a.phone_number,
    o.shipping_address = a.address_line,
    o.payment_status = 'UNKNOWN'
FROM dbo.[ORDER] o
JOIN dbo.ADDRESSBOOK a ON a.address_id = o.address_id;

-- 18. SYNCHRONIZE ORDER STATUS FROM HISTORY
;WITH latest AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY order_id
            ORDER BY updated_at DESC, status_id DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM dbo.ORDER_STATUS_HISTORY
)
UPDATE o
SET o.order_status =
    CASE UPPER(l.status)
        WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION'
        WHEN 'SHIPPING' THEN 'SHIPPING'
        WHEN 'COMPLETED' THEN 'COMPLETED'
        WHEN 'CONFIRMED' THEN 'CONFIRMED'
        WHEN 'CANCELLED' THEN 'CANCELLED'
        ELSE 'PENDING_CONFIRMATION'
    END
FROM dbo.[ORDER] o
JOIN latest l ON l.order_id = o.order_id AND l.rn = 1;
GO

    (N'May anh Mirrorless', N'Sony', N'Sony Alpha A6400',
     N'<h2>Tốc độ bắt nét đỉnh cao</h2><p><strong>Sony Alpha A6400</strong> nổi tiếng với hệ thống lấy nét tự động siêu tốc chỉ 0.02 giây và tính năng Real-time Eye AF (lấy nét mắt theo thời gian thực). JOIN CATEGORY c ON c.category_name = v.category_name
JOIN BRAND b ON b.brand_name = v.brand_name
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM PRODUCT p
    WHERE p.product_name = v.product_name
);
GO

-- 24. PRODUCT IMAGES
UPDATE PRODUCT
SET image_url = CASE product_name
    WHEN N'iPhone 15 Pro' THEN 'assets/images/products/iphone_15_pro.png'
    WHEN N'iPhone 15 Pro Max' THEN 'assets/images/products/iphone-15-pro-max.png'
    WHEN N'iPhone 16 Pro' THEN 'assets/images/products/iphone-16-pro.png'
    WHEN N'iPhone 16 Pro Max' THEN 'assets/images/products/iphone-16-pro-max.png'
    WHEN N'Samsung Galaxy S24 Ultra' THEN 'assets/images/products/s24-ult
